papers.title: A Pfaffian quantum Hall state of ultracold bosons
papers.abstract: Fractional quantum Hall states are a cornerstone of topological physics, hosting fractionally charged quasiparticles with exotic statistics that promise to enable topologically protected quantum information processing. Among these, the Pfaffian state introduced by Moore and Read implements a p-wave pairing structure that supports excitations with non-Abelian exchange statistics. Despite extensive study in electronic systems, direct access to its pairing structure has remained limited. Here we realize a three-particle bosonic Pfaffian state of ultracold $^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$ atoms in an optical lattice subject to a Floquet-engineered synthetic magnetic field. Using a Bayesian-optimized adiabatic protocol, we prepare a state exhibiting Pfaffian pairing correlations. Site-resolved measurements of multi-point density correlations reveal a pronounced suppression of short-range three-body coincidences, reflecting the underlying pairing structure. We further probe the state's transport response through Hall drift measurements. Our results establish a bottom-up approach to engineering non-Abelian topological order and lay the groundwork for future explorations of anyonic braiding in synthetic matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：ultracold atoms, optical lattice, Floquet-engineered, site-resolved measurements, Hall drift measurements。；研究对象：超冷玻色子（$^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$ 原子）在光学晶格中，通过Floquet工程合成磁场实现的分数量子霍尔态，具体为三粒子玻色子Pfaffian态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验上成功制备并表征了一个超冷玻色子的Pfaffian量子霍尔态，通过多点密度关联测量观察到了短程三体重合的显著抑制，证实了其p波配对结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验上成功制备并表征了一个超冷玻色子的Pfaffian量子霍尔态，通过多点密度关联测量观察到了短程三体重合的显著抑制，证实了其p波配对结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于电子系统中对Pfaffian态配对结构直接探测的局限性，本工作首次在超冷原子体系中实现了对玻色子Pfaffian态配对关联的直接、位点分辨的测量。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用Floquet工程在光学晶格中为超冷$^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$原子合成人工磁场；采用贝叶斯优化的绝热协议制备目标量子态；通过位点分辨的多点密度关联测量探测配对结构；通过霍尔漂移测量探测输运响应。

papers.title: Gate-tunable spin-valley transport via carrier velocity in monolayer WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate spin- and valley-resolved quantum transport in monolayer tungsten diselenide (WSe$_2$) described by an effective massive Dirac Hamiltonian. Particular attention is devoted to a finite barrier region characterized by simultaneously modulated Fermi velocity and scalar potential. The barrier velocity $v_2$ is related to the external velocity $v_1$ through a velocity ratio $ξ=v_2/v_1$, motivated by an optical analogy with the Snell-Descartes law. The exact refraction condition depends on the full spin- and valley-resolved dispersion, and the simple ratio $ξ=v_2/v_1$ is recovered only in the massless, symmetric limit. The interplay of intrinsic spin-orbit coupling in the conduction and valence bands, quantified by $λ_c$ and $λ_v$, with spin- and valley-dependent Zeeman fields, $M_s$ and $M_v$, gives rise to substantial changes in the quasiparticle dispersion, leading to pronounced modifications of the transport characteristics. By solving the Dirac equation and enforcing current-conserving matching conditions at the interfaces, we compute the spin- and valley-dependent transmission probability and conductance. Our results demonstrate that the barrier velocity, scalar potential, incidence angle, incident energy, and barrier width serve as effective control parameters for transport, giving rise to strong anisotropy and resonant tunneling features. Furthermore, we show that both the magnitude and orientation of spin- and valley-polarized currents can be continuously tuned via velocity and potential modulation. These findings establish combined velocity and potential engineering as a powerful theoretical framework for controlling spin-valley physics in two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、effective massive Dirac Hamiltonian、solving the Dirac equation。；研究对象：单层二硒化钨（WSe₂）中的自旋-谷分辨量子输运现象，具体为通过载流子速度调控的自旋-谷输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时调控势垒区的费米速度和标量势，可以连续调节自旋极化电流和谷极化电流的大小与方向，速度与势垒工程为控制二维过渡金属硫族化合物中的自旋-谷物理提供了理论框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时调控势垒区的费米速度和标量势，可以连续调节自旋极化电流和谷极化电流的大小与方向，速度与势垒工程为控制二维过渡金属硫族化合物中的自旋-谷物理提供了理论框架。；创新点：引入势垒区费米速度与外部速度之比ξ（受斯涅尔-笛卡尔定律光学类比启发），将速度调制与势垒势调制相结合作为输运控制参数，揭示了速度调控在自旋-谷输运中的独特作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于有效大质量狄拉克哈密顿量描述单层WSe₂，通过求解狄拉克方程并在界面处施加电流守恒匹配条件，计算自旋-谷依赖的透射概率和电导。

papers.title: Effect of polar distortions on the anomalous Hall conductivity of altermagnetic $α$-MnTe
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic $α$-MnTe with Néel vector along the $y$-axis exhibits a finite anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) and weak ferromagnetism along the $z$-axis. As already demonstrated in the bulk, there is the breaking of the C$_6$ symmetry by the in-plane Néel vector, leaving a C$_2$-type magnetic symmetry. The surface of $α$-MnTe breaks the C$_2$, leaving only a time-reversed mirror symmetry with respect to the $x=0$ plane. Therefore, we demonstrate that on the surface, the interplay between breaking of the crystal symmetry and Néel vector orientation produces a reduction of the space group from hexagonal P6$_3$/mmc to orthorhombic Amm2. As a result, the surface exhibits not only a polar distortion along the $z$-axis, but also a polar distortion and a weak ferrimagnetism along the $y$-axis. To describe the surface of MnTe in an accessible way, we simplify the problem and examine the effect of the in-plane electric field in bulk MnTe. Moreover, as a doped ionic semiconductor, the properties of MnTe can be influenced by lattice polarization under an applied electric field. We investigate the interplay between the intrinsic anomalous Hall effect and lattice polarization, showing that polarization effects can substantially affect the AHC. Since the electric field breaks inversion symmetry, this contribution from the lattice polarization coexists with the non-linear anomalous Hall effect, highlighting the rich transport phenomenology of altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：demonstrate、examine、investigate、simplify the problem、DFT（隐含，基于对称性分析和能带计算常见方法）。；研究对象：反铁磁材料α-MnTe，具体研究其表面极性畸变对反常霍尔电导（AHC）的影响，以及电场诱导的晶格极化与反常霍尔效应的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: α-MnTe表面因晶体对称性破缺与奈尔矢量取向的共同作用，导致空间群从六方P6₃/mmc降为正交Amm2，从而在z轴和y轴方向均产生极性畸变及弱铁磁性；外加电场下的晶格极化可显著改变反常霍尔电导，并与非线性反常霍尔效应共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：α-MnTe表面因晶体对称性破缺与奈尔矢量取向的共同作用，导致空间群从六方P6₃/mmc降为正交Amm2，从而在z轴和y轴方向均产生极性畸变及弱铁磁性；外加电场下的晶格极化可显著改变反常霍尔电导，并与非线性反常霍尔效应共存。；创新点：揭示了表面极性畸变（沿z轴和y轴）与奈尔矢量取向协同作用导致空间群降维的机制，并首次指出晶格极化效应可显著调控反铁磁体α-MnTe的反常霍尔电导，且该极化贡献与非线性反常霍尔效应共存。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析（空间群降维、时间反演镜像对称性）和简化模型（用体相中面内电场模拟表面效应）进行理论推导，未明确提及具体第一性原理计算软件或实验手段。

papers.title: Approximate additivity in the solvent-mediated potential of mean force for ultrasoft particle systems
papers.abstract: In the infinite dilution limit, we show that the solvent-mediated potential of mean force (PMF) between solutes, extracted from the hypernetted-chain (HNC) closure of the Ornstein-Zernike equations, can expressed as a convolution between solute-specific generalised excluded volume functions. In the limit of a structureless solvent of point particles and hard core solutes, this recovers the exact Asakura-Oosawa depletion potential as the overlap between excluded volume spheres. The methodology can be deployed for ultrasoft particle systems such as those encountered in dissipative particle dynamics (DPD), where the solvent-mediated PMF can be recovered with considerable accuracy. These results confirm that in coarse-grained molecular DPD simulations the parametrisation of the non-bonded repulsions is sensitive to the assumed intramolecular bond lengths if they are smaller than the range of the DPD potential, due to the overlap of the soft excluded volume functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：hypernetted-chain closure、Ornstein-Zernike equations、potential of mean force、理论推导）；研究对象：超软粒子系统（如耗散粒子动力学DPD中遇到的体系）中溶剂介导的平均力势（PMF）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无限稀释极限下，溶剂介导的PMF可表示为溶质特定广义排除体积函数的卷积；在粗粒化DPD模拟中，若假设的分子内键长小于DPD势作用范围，非键排斥参数的设定对键长敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无限稀释极限下，溶剂介导的PMF可表示为溶质特定广义排除体积函数的卷积；在粗粒化DPD模拟中，若假设的分子内键长小于DPD势作用范围，非键排斥参数的设定对键长敏感。；创新点：将溶剂介导PMF的加和性近似从硬球体系推广至超软粒子系统，并揭示了DPD粗粒化模拟中非键参数与键长耦合的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ornstein-Zernike方程的超网链（HNC）闭包理论，推导溶剂介导PMF的卷积表达式；通过点粒子结构溶剂与硬核溶质的极限情况验证Asakura-Oosawa耗尽势的恢复；应用于DPD超软粒子体系进行数值验证。

papers.title: Plasmonic properties and correlation energies from a compact multipole representation of the dielectric response in 2D metals
papers.abstract: Multipole-Padé approximants provide a compact representation of dynamical response functions in terms of a small number of collective modes. Here, we generalize this framework to incorporate momentum dependence across the full Brillouin zone of 2D metals by constructing a symmetry-conserving, anisotropic representation of the inverse dielectric function. This analytic form enables efficient and accurate evaluation of quantities involving dynamical screening, including spectral features and correlation energies. We construct such compact representations for a set of seven two dimensional metals spanning distinct electronic regimes, and show that a small number of dispersive plasmonic modes suffices to accurately describe the dielectric response across the full Brillouin zone, while also yielding accurate correlation energies. The proposed representation therefore establishes a direct bridge between {\it ab initio} calculations and analytical models of screening, opening new avenues for applications in condensed matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“构建解析形式”、“计算关联能”、“第一性原理计算与解析模型之间的桥梁”。；研究对象：二维金属中的等离激元（plasmon）特性及其介电响应。具体研究了七种跨越不同电子态区域的二维金属。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建一种紧凑的多极子表示（Multipole-Padé近似），仅需少量色散等离激元模式即可精确描述二维金属在整个布里渊区内的介电响应，并能准确计算其关联能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建一种紧凑的多极子表示（Multipole-Padé近似），仅需少量色散等离激元模式即可精确描述二维金属在整个布里渊区内的介电响应，并能准确计算其关联能。；创新点：将多极子-帕德近似框架推广到包含整个布里渊区的动量依赖关系，从而建立了一种直接连接第一性原理计算与解析屏蔽模型的方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用多极子-帕德近似（Multipole-Padé approximants）框架，通过构造一个保持对称性、各向异性的逆介电函数解析形式，来紧凑地表示二维金属的动力学响应函数。

papers.title: Mass generation at a fixed point: A Functional Renormalization Group Study of the tricritical O($N$) model in $d=3$ and $N=\infty$
papers.abstract: Renormalization group (RG) fixed points are commonly associated with scale invariance and a divergent correlation length. We show that this connection can fail in the tricritical $O(N)$ model in three dimensions in the limit $N\to\infty$. Revisiting the line of fixed points identified by Bardeen, Moshe, and Bander, we use the functional renormalization group to clarify the mechanism leading to mass generation at its singular endpoint (the BMB fixed point). We demonstrate that the generated mass is nonuniversal and originates from the nonanalytic structure of the effective potential. We show that the critical exponent $ν$ which takes the value $ν= 1/2$ along the regular part of the BMB line, that is, for $0 \leq λ< λ_{\rm BMB}$, jumps to $ν= 1/3$ on the singular part of this line with the BMB FP, corresponding to $λ= λ_{\rm BMB}$, being the pivotal point between these two regimes. We also show how its singular potential emerges dynamically along the renormalization flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：Functional Renormalization Group Study（泛函重整化群研究）、理论分析、N→∞极限。；研究对象：三维tricritical O(N)模型在N→∞极限下的固定点行为，特别是Bardeen-Moshe-Bander（BMB）固定点处的质量生成机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维tricritical O(N)模型的N→∞极限下，重整化群固定点与标度不变性及发散关联长度的联系可能失效；在BMB固定点处，质量生成是非普适的，源于有效势的非解析结构，且临界指数ν在BMB线正则部分（ν=1/2）与奇异部分（ν=1/3）之间发生跳跃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维tricritical O(N)模型的N→∞极限下，重整化群固定点与标度不变性及发散关联长度的联系可能失效；在BMB固定点处，质量生成是非普适的，源于有效势的非解析结构，且临界指数ν在BMB线正则部分（ν=1/2）与奇异部分（ν=1/3）之间发生跳跃。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 泛函重整化群（Functional Renormalization Group, FRG）方法，用于分析有效势的非解析结构及重整化流中奇异势的动态涌现。

papers.title: Substrate insulated Josephson junctions for superconducting quantum circuits
papers.abstract: We have developed a fabrication technique for Josephson junctions that employs a three-dimensional patterned, low-loss substrate instead of commonly used organic resists. The technique enables the fabrication of high-quality trilayer junctions from a wide range of geometries and materials, including high-melting-point superconductors such as tantalum or niobium. The junction electrodes are free from intentionally introduced oxides and organic materials, which are known sources of decoherence. We fabricate and characterize underdamped Nb/AlOx/Nb junctions of different sizes in several geometries. Such junctions enable manufacturing of quantum circuits operating at higher speeds and elevated temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“developed a fabrication technique”、“fabricate and characterize”。；研究对象：用于超导量子电路的约瑟夫森结，具体为Nb/AlOx/Nb三层膜约瑟夫森结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种利用三维图案化低损耗衬底替代有机光刻胶的约瑟夫森结制备技术，可制造高质量、无有机残留和无意氧化层的超导结，有望实现更高速度和更高温度下运行的量子电路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种利用三维图案化低损耗衬底替代有机光刻胶的约瑟夫森结制备技术，可制造高质量、无有机残留和无意氧化层的超导结，有望实现更高速度和更高温度下运行的量子电路。；创新点：使用低损耗衬底直接作为结的绝缘和图案化介质，避免了有机光刻胶和人为引入的氧化物，从而消除已知的退相干来源。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：采用三维图案化低损耗衬底作为结的绝缘层和支撑结构，替代传统有机光刻胶；制备了不同尺寸和几何形状的欠阻尼Nb/AlOx/Nb约瑟夫森结，并对其进行了电学表征。

papers.title: Superconductivity in the pressure-amorphized topological insulator CrP$_4$
papers.abstract: The interplay among superconductivity, magnetism, and nontrivial band topology represents one of the most compelling frontiers in condensed matter physics. The exploration of novel superconductivity in 3d transition-metal compounds, particularly the rare Cr-based systems containing strongly magnetic Cr ions, has long attracted attention owing to their unconventional pairing mechanisms that challenge conventional wisdom. Yet, Cr-based superconductors remain scarce, especially those possessing nontrivial topological character, underscoring the urgent need to uncover new members. Here we report the observation of superconductivity in pressure-amorphized Cr-based topological insulator CrP$_4$. Upon compression, CrP$_4$ undergoes an anomalous quantum phase transition from a metallic to a semiconducting-like state at around 15 GPa, driven by significant changes in the electronic structure. At approximately 70 GPa, re-metallization with superconductivity occurs alongside an irreversible amorphization. The superconducting transition temperature Tc increases monotonically with pressure, reaching 4.8 K at 141.3 GPa. Furthermore, theoretical calculations predict multiple topological phase transitions from a strong topological insulator to a trivial state and finally back to a strong topological state under pressure. Our study not only establishes CrP$_4$ as the first Cr-based amorphous superconductor but also opens a new paradigm for exploring superconducting and topological properties in amorphous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论计算）。判断依据：摘要明确报告了“observation of superconductivity”、“experimental measurements”以及“theoretical calculations predict”。；研究对象：CrP₄ 化合物在高压下的超导电性、非晶化相变及拓扑性质演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在压力作用下，CrP₄ 经历从金属到类半导体态的反常量子相变，并在约70 GPa发生不可逆非晶化并伴随超导电性出现，超导转变温度随压力单调上升至4.8 K（141.3 GPa）。理论预测其拓扑性质在压力下经历多次转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在压力作用下，CrP₄ 经历从金属到类半导体态的反常量子相变，并在约70 GPa发生不可逆非晶化并伴随超导电性出现，超导转变温度随压力单调上升至4.8 K（141.3 GPa）。理论预测其拓扑性质在压力下经历多次转变。；创新点：首次在Cr基体系中实现非晶态超导体，并揭示非晶材料中同时存在超导与拓扑性质的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 高压实验（压缩至141.3 GPa）、电阻测量（确定超导转变温度）、理论计算（预测拓扑相变）。

papers.title: Stacking switching between correlation-protected radial Rashba field and persistent spin textures in graphene encapsulated by 1T-TaS$_2$ monolayers
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic structure, spin textures, and charge to spin/orbital transport in graphene encapsulated by 1T-TaS$_{2}$ monolayers in the charge density wave phase. Using first-principles calculations, tight-binding modeling, and the Kubo formalism, we show that the encapsulation stacking dictates fundamentally distinct transport regimes. In the asymmetrical (AA) stacking, proximity fields from both interfaces constructively interfere, yielding a cumulative Rashba phase of nearly $π/2$. This pure radial Rashba spin pattern leads to the unconventional Rashba-Edelstein effect, which robustly dominates over the conventional response by a factor of 35 across a wide energy range. Conversely, the symmetrical (AA') stacking preserves a horizontal mirror symmetry, establishing a stable, purely out-of-plane persistent spin texture. Furthermore, the computed orbital Hall effect is exceptionally efficient, surpassing the spin Hall effect by three orders of magnitude. Within the proximity-induced spectral gaps, the orbital Hall conductivity exhibits a finite plateau, whereas the spin Hall conductivity vanishes. Our findings establish graphene encapsulated heterostructures as a promising system for realizing distinct charge to spin and charge to orbital interconversion regimes determined by the choice of stacking order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。判断依据：第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型、Kubo形式论。；研究对象：被1T-TaS₂单层（处于电荷密度波相）包裹的石墨烯异质结中的电子结构、自旋织构以及电荷-自旋/轨道输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 包裹堆叠方式（AA与AA'）决定了截然不同的输运机制：AA堆叠产生累积的径向Rashba自旋织构，导致非常规Rashba-Edelstein效应；AA'堆叠则形成稳定的纯面外持续自旋织构。此外，轨道霍尔效应效率极高，比自旋霍尔效应高出三个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：包裹堆叠方式（AA与AA'）决定了截然不同的输运机制：AA堆叠产生累积的径向Rashba自旋织构，导致非常规Rashba-Edelstein效应；AA'堆叠则形成稳定的纯面外持续自旋织构。此外，轨道霍尔效应效率极高，比自旋霍尔效应高出三个数量级。；创新点：揭示了通过选择不同的堆叠顺序（AA与AA'），可以在石墨烯包裹异质结中实现由关联效应保护的径向Rashba场与持续自旋织构之间的切换，并首次展示了该体系中轨道霍尔效应远超自旋霍尔效应的巨大优势。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型、Kubo形式论。

papers.title: Thermodynamically consistent phase field model for hydrogen-assisted cracking
papers.abstract: We propose a phase field model able to simulate hydrogen-assisted cracking in polycrystalline materials. Within a variational framework, the model simultaneously describes crack propagation and hydrogen segregation on crack surfaces and grain boundaries together with the associated reduction in interfacial energies. In the context of hydrogen-enhanced decohesion (HEDE) mechanisms, we demonstrate the ability of the model to capture the transition from transgranular cracking to hydrogen-assisted intergranular cracking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：propose a phase field model、variational framework、simulate。；研究对象：多晶材料中的氢致裂纹（hydrogen-assisted cracking），具体涉及裂纹扩展、氢在裂纹表面和晶界的偏析，以及氢增强内聚减弱（HEDE）机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该相场模型能够同时描述裂纹扩展与氢在裂纹表面和晶界的偏析，并捕捉从穿晶断裂到氢致沿晶断裂的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该相场模型能够同时描述裂纹扩展与氢在裂纹表面和晶界的偏析，并捕捉从穿晶断裂到氢致沿晶断裂的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于变分框架的相场模型（phase field model），用于模拟多晶材料中氢辅助裂纹扩展，并考虑界面能降低效应。

papers.title: Tunable Snapping and Rigid Foldability in the Mars Origami Pattern
papers.abstract: Origami-inspired metamaterials exploit the interplay between geometry and elasticity to achieve programmable mechanical responses. Yet the origin and tunability of snap-through instabilities in non-rigidly foldable patterns remain poorly understood. Here we show that the Mars tessellation, a degree-4 vertex origami pattern composed of alternating square and rhombic faces, is not rigidly foldable because the folding-speed ratios required for vertex compatibility cannot be propagated consistently across neighboring units. This geometric incompatibility forces the facets to bend during folding, giving rise to a reproducible snap-through discontinuity in the force-displacement curve with a mean force drop of about 92.6 +/- 5.5 %, marking a transition between metastable states. Laser scoring of additional diagonal creases, guided by strain-field simulations, enables continuous tuning of the snap magnitude. These results reveal a general mechanism by which geometric frustration can be harnessed to program multistability in thin-sheet metamaterials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“激光 scoring of additional diagonal creases, guided by strain-field simulations”，表明同时使用了实验手段（激光刻划）和计算模拟（应变场模拟）。；研究对象：火星折纸图案（Mars origami pattern），一种由正方形和菱形面交替组成的四度顶点折纸结构，及其在薄片超材料中引发的非刚性折叠、突跳失稳与多稳态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 火星折纸图案因几何不兼容性导致非刚性折叠，在力-位移曲线中产生可重复的突跳不连续性（平均力降约92.6±5.5%），通过激光刻划附加对角线折痕可连续调控突跳幅度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：火星折纸图案因几何不兼容性导致非刚性折叠，在力-位移曲线中产生可重复的突跳不连续性（平均力降约92.6±5.5%），通过激光刻划附加对角线折痕可连续调控突跳幅度。；创新点：揭示了非刚性可折叠折纸图案中几何挫败（geometric frustration）作为编程多稳态性的一般机制，并展示了通过附加折痕连续调控突跳幅度的可调性。摘要未突出说明与已有刚性可折叠图案研究的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用激光刻划在薄片上引入附加对角线折痕；计算上使用应变场模拟（strain-field simulations）指导折痕位置设计；力学测试记录力-位移曲线以表征突跳行为。

papers.title: Enhanced localization length in a disordered one-dimensional band via cavity coupling to delocalized states
papers.abstract: We investigate the localization properties of cavity-coupled electronic states in disordered systems, motivated by recent proposals of cavity-mediated hopping in quantum Hall systems. We first introduce a minimal two-band model in which localized states in a disordered one-dimensional band are coupled, through a homogeneous cavity mode, to an excited band of delocalized states. Combining perturbation theory with a transfer-matrix approach, we show that cavity-assisted hopping between localized states decays exponentially with distance, implying that the eigenstates remain localized even beyond the perturbative regime. Nevertheless, the corresponding localization length increases with the light-matter coupling strength and can extend over several lattice sites in the single-electron ultrastrong-coupling regime. We then study a disordered Landau band coupled to a cavity mode within the framework developed in Refs.[1,2]. We find that the effective cavity-mediated coupling between edge states also decays exponentially with distance, but with a localization length that can reach micrometer scales for experimentally realistic parameters. By analyzing the inverse participation ratio, we show that this enhanced coupling is predominantly mediated by the most extended states of the upper Landau band. Our results demonstrate that, while cavity-induced hopping in disordered quantum Hall systems remains exponentially localized, the associated localization length can become sufficiently large for the corresponding states to exhibit effectively delocalized behavior on mesoscopic length scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbation theory, transfer-matrix approach, 理论模型分析。；研究对象：腔耦合无序电子系统的局域化性质，具体包括：一个无序一维能带中的局域态与一个扩展态能带通过均匀腔模耦合的模型，以及无序朗道能带与腔模耦合的量子霍尔系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔辅助的跳跃在无序系统中仍呈指数衰减，因此本征态保持局域化；但光-物质耦合强度可显著增大局域化长度，在单电子超强耦合下可覆盖多个晶格位点，在量子霍尔系统中甚至可达微米尺度，使态在介观尺度上表现出有效退局域化行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔辅助的跳跃在无序系统中仍呈指数衰减，因此本征态保持局域化；但光-物质耦合强度可显著增大局域化长度，在单电子超强耦合下可覆盖多个晶格位点，在量子霍尔系统中甚至可达微米尺度，使态在介观尺度上表现出有效退局域化行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合微扰论与转移矩阵方法分析两带模型；利用文献[1,2]发展的框架研究无序朗道能带与腔模耦合；通过逆参与率分析扩展态对增强耦合的主导作用。

papers.title: Structural responses incipient to pressure-driven antiferromagnetic quantum critical point of van der Waals heavy-fermion metal CeSiI
papers.abstract: CeSiI is a van der Waals heavy-fermion metal recently found to exhibit unconventional superconductivity near a pressure-induced antiferromagnetic quantum critical point (QCP) at Pc =6 GPa. Here, we report a comprehensive single-crystal X-ray diffraction study of CeSiI under high pressures up to 8.3 GPa at room temperature, revealing subtle structural responses that precede pressure-driven QCP. We find that the unit-cell volume decreases smoothly upon compression without showing any structural phase transition in the investigated pressure range. Intriguingly, we observe abrupt and concurrent anisotropic responses of the lattice parameters around Pc =6 GPa, i.e., the a-axis contracts while the c-axis enlongated suddenly, with the unit-cell volume smoothily varies with pressure. Structural refinements further show that these lattice anomalies primarily originate from changes of Ce-Ce and Ce-Si bond lengths, as well as a flattening of the inner honeycomb Si layer within the CeSiI monolayer around Pc. Our findings establish an interesting case linking pressure-driven electronic transition of QCP at low temperatures to incipient structural responses at room temperature, thereby providing fresh insight into the pressure-temperature phase diagram of CeSiI.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：single-crystal X-ray diffraction study（单晶X射线衍射研究）、high pressures（高压）、room temperature（室温）。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯重费米子金属CeSiI，及其在压力驱动反铁磁量子临界点（QCP）附近的晶格结构响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，CeSiI在压力接近6 GPa的量子临界点时，晶格参数出现突然且各向异性的响应（a轴收缩、c轴伸长），但体积保持连续变化，且未发生结构相变。这些晶格异常主要源于Ce-Ce和Ce-Si键长变化以及Si层扁平化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，CeSiI在压力接近6 GPa的量子临界点时，晶格参数出现突然且各向异性的响应（a轴收缩、c轴伸长），但体积保持连续变化，且未发生结构相变。这些晶格异常主要源于Ce-Ce和Ce-Si键长变化以及Si层扁平化。；创新点：首次在室温下观察到CeSiI中与低温压力驱动量子临界点相关的晶格结构前驱响应，建立了低温电子相变与室温结构响应之间的关联，为理解其压力-温度相图提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 高压单晶X射线衍射（single-crystal X-ray diffraction），压力范围0至8.3 GPa，室温条件。

papers.title: Quantum dynamic simulation of triplet formation in an effective model of Y6 (BTP-4F)
papers.abstract: We construct a five-state model for photoexcitation in Y6 (BTP-4F) dimers, and then solve the non-adiabtic dynamics using the Hierarchical Equations of Motion (HEOM) method. We find that triplets are populated mainly via a transiently excited \textit{intermolecular} charge-transfer singlet to triplet Frenkel exciton route; this route is not available to the monomer. Analysis of one-particle transition density matrices suggests that the charge-transfer states are spatially distinct to the Frenkel exciton states, indicating that the large spin-orbit-coupling for this transition is due to it being permitted by an associated change in orbital character. Aggregation in Y6 therefore directly enables fast and high-yield intersystem crossing. We selenise our model dimers, significantly enhancing spin-orbit-coupling, which then accelerates this charge-transfer mediated route. Looking forwards to simulations on larger aggregates, we show that, though Marcus theory gives qualitatively correct dynamics, the long-time yields are incorrect due to it missing quantum recurrences. Instead, we show that the recently developed memory-kernel projector\cite{Gestsson2025-ez} method can produce semi-classical rates directly from the HEOM equations which lead to quantitatively correct dynamics and yields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：construct a five-state model、solve the non-adiabatic dynamics、Hierarchical Equations of Motion (HEOM) method。；研究对象：Y6 (BTP-4F) 二聚体中的光激发与三线态形成动力学，具体涉及分子间电荷转移态与Frenkel激子态之间的自旋翻转过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Y6二聚体中三线态主要通过一个瞬态激发的分子间电荷转移单线态到Frenkel激子三线态的路径生成，该路径在单体中不存在；聚集效应直接实现了快速且高产率的系间穿越。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Y6二聚体中三线态主要通过一个瞬态激发的分子间电荷转移单线态到Frenkel激子三线态的路径生成，该路径在单体中不存在；聚集效应直接实现了快速且高产率的系间穿越。；创新点：揭示了Y6二聚体中一种新的、单体无法实现的系间穿越路径（分子间电荷转移单线态→Frenkel激子三线态），并指出该路径的高效性源于电荷转移态与Frenkel激子态之间轨道特征变化所允许的大自旋-轨道耦合；同时展示了记忆核投影方法相比Marcus理论能更准确地预测长时间产率。
papers.method_zh: 构建了Y6二聚体的五态模型，采用分层运动方程（HEOM）方法求解非绝热动力学；通过单粒子跃迁密度矩阵分析态的空间分布；使用硒取代增强自旋-轨道耦合；对比了Marcus理论与记忆核投影方法的动力学预测。

papers.title: Weakly interacting Bose gases in the canonical ensemble
papers.abstract: Based on the canonical description of a non-interacting Bose gas, we work out how both thermodynamic and statistical properties change perturbatively with respect to weak two-particle interactions. Up to first order, we obtain a recursion formula for the canonical partition function, which consists of the same Feynman diagrams as the grand-canonical description but with different Feynman rules. Resumming this recursion formula for the canonical partition function allows one to characterize the statistics of the ground-state occupancy by its respective cumulants. We demonstrate the applicability of this approach by analyzing a dilute Bose gas with contact interaction in a box trap. To this end, we used Dirichlet boundary conditions in view of their relevance for current experiments with atomic gases, where the box trap is implemented, for instance, with digital mirror devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“canonical description”、“perturbatively”、“recursion formula”、“Feynman diagrams”。；研究对象：弱相互作用玻色气体的热力学与统计性质，具体体系为盒状陷阱中的稀薄接触相互作用玻色气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正则系综框架下，通过微扰方法推导出弱相互作用玻色气体的配分函数递推公式，该公式与巨正则系综的费曼图形式相同但规则不同；利用该递推公式可表征基态占据数的统计性质（累积量）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正则系综框架下，通过微扰方法推导出弱相互作用玻色气体的配分函数递推公式，该公式与巨正则系综的费曼图形式相同但规则不同；利用该递推公式可表征基态占据数的统计性质（累积量）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于无相互作用玻色气体的正则系综描述，采用微扰论处理弱两粒子相互作用至一阶，推导正则配分函数的递推公式；通过重求和方法分析基态占据数的累积量。边界条件采用狄利克雷边界条件以匹配当前原子气体盒状陷阱实验（如数字微镜器件实现）。

papers.title: Kinetic kagome magnetism: from self-trapping RVB polarons to semiclassical correlations
papers.abstract: To gain deeper insight into the role of hole kinetics in determining magnetism in highly frustrated doped Mott insulators, we consider the single-hole counter-Nagaoka problem on the kagome lattice, using magnetization as a tuning parameter. Near full polarization, a doped hole delocalizes upon binding reversed spins in a pattern of singlet bonds which we term resonating-valence-bond (RVB) polaron. These RVB polarons can have extremely small effective bandwidths, and hence exhibit self-trapping. By tuning the spin polarization, we track the evolution of these states toward the unpolarized sector, where we observe the emergence of $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ antiferromagnetic correlation reminiscent of the classical Potts and Heisenberg models on the kagome lattice. These results provide a framework to understand how RVB physics at short scales evolves into conventional magnetic correlations at long scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：consider、theoretical framework、model。；研究对象：Kagome晶格上掺杂Mott绝缘体中的单空穴动力学与磁性的相互作用，具体为反Nagaoka问题，以及共振价键（RVB）极化子与半经典磁关联的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高度自旋极化条件下，掺杂空穴通过束缚反转自旋形成共振价键（RVB）极化子而实现退局域化，这些极化子具有极小的有效带宽并表现出自陷行为；随着自旋极化降低，系统演化出与经典Potts和Heisenberg模型类似的√3×√3反铁磁关联，揭示了短程RVB物理向长程常规磁关联的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高度自旋极化条件下，掺杂空穴通过束缚反转自旋形成共振价键（RVB）极化子而实现退局域化，这些极化子具有极小的有效带宽并表现出自陷行为；随着自旋极化降低，系统演化出与经典Potts和Heisenberg模型类似的√3×√3反铁磁关联，揭示了短程RVB物理向长程常规磁关联的转变。；创新点：首次在Kagome晶格上系统研究空穴动力学驱动的RVB极化子自陷行为，并建立从短程RVB关联到长程半经典磁关联的演化框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过磁化强度作为调控参数，研究Kagome晶格上单空穴反Nagaoka问题，追踪从高极化到非极化区域的状态演化。

papers.title: Roughening of active nonlinear interfaces with broken tilt symmetry
papers.abstract: We study the roughening of an interface with nonlinear elasticity driven by temporally correlated noise, which breaks statistical tilt symmetry. Using scaling arguments and a self-consistent Hartree approximation, we derive the crossover diagram and the steady-state structure factor. We identify three scaling regimes associated with the Larkin, anharmonic Larkin, and Edwards--Wilkinson universality classes, and obtain the crossover lengths separating them. Numerical simulations of large systems confirm the analytical predictions over the full parameter range. Our results provide a unified description of finite-size and crossover effects in a minimal nonlinear-elastic Ornstein--Uhlenbeck active interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词包括“scaling arguments”、“self-consistent Hartree approximation”、“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：具有非线性弹性、受时间关联噪声驱动的活性界面，该体系破坏了统计倾斜对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该活性界面存在三种标度行为区域，分别对应Larkin、非谐Larkin和Edwards-Wilkinson普适类，并获得了分隔这些区域的交叉长度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该活性界面存在三种标度行为区域，分别对应Larkin、非谐Larkin和Edwards-Wilkinson普适类，并获得了分隔这些区域的交叉长度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 标度分析、自洽Hartree近似、大规模数值模拟。

papers.title: Experimental straintronics in nanotube quantum dots
papers.abstract: Single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) are narrow ribbons of graphene with atomically precise edges and a single quantum transport channel, at experimentally-relevant dopings. This makes them ideal systems to harness quantum transport straintronics (QTS), i.e. using mechanical strain to control accurately quantum transport. We present QTS data from three single-wall carbon nanotube quantum dot (SWCNT-QD) transistors over a broad range of in-situ tunable and reversible uniaxial strain ($Δ\varepsilon_\text{mech}\approx$ 0 to 3 %). We first present the nanofabrication of the suspended SWCNT transistors whose channel lengths are $\approx$ 30 nm. The channels are strained by moving gold clamps holding firmly the nanotubes. We present detailed charge transport data, $dI/dV_{\text{B}} - V_{\text{B}} - V_{\text{G}}$ and $dI/dV_{\text{B}} - V_{\text{B}} - Δ\varepsilon_\text{mech}$, showing a large mechanical-gating effect of the SWCNT-QDs. The precise reversibility of the data, and their agreement with QTS theory, confirms that the tubes are strained elastically. We demonstrate that the mechanical control of the QD doping is not due to capacitive-gating effects, but to quantitatively predictable bandstructure changes including a strain-tunable bandgap. This precise mechanical control of the doping and bandgap of SWCNT-QDs could find applications in qubits, condensed matter physics, and homojunction molecular transistors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述实验数据（“We present QTS data”、“We present detailed charge transport data”）、纳米加工（“nanofabrication”）和器件测量（“dI/dV_B - V_B - V_G”）。；研究对象：单壁碳纳米管量子点（SWCNT-QD）晶体管中的量子输运应变电子学（QTS），即利用机械应变精确控制量子输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加可逆单轴应变（0~3%），实现了对单壁碳纳米管量子点的机械门控效应，该效应源于应变可调的能带结构变化（包括带隙调控），而非电容门控效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加可逆单轴应变（0~3%），实现了对单壁碳纳米管量子点的机械门控效应，该效应源于应变可调的能带结构变化（包括带隙调控），而非电容门控效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了沟道长度约30 nm的悬空单壁碳纳米管晶体管，通过移动固定纳米管的金夹钳施加单轴应变，并测量微分电导（dI/dV_B）随偏压（V_B）、栅压（V_G）和应变（Δε_mech）的变化图谱。

papers.title: Path convergence in diffusion models
papers.abstract: We discuss diffusion-model paths interpolating between a target distribution known only through p patterns and a reference distribution that can be sampled. These interpolating paths can be constructed symmetrically or else in forward direction (often referred to as a "noising") from the target patterns to the reference distribution or in backward direction (as a "denoising") from the reference distribution to the patterns. For backward paths with identical diffusion noise, we consider the path convergence in number of patterns p towards the path for infinitely many patterns. In a one-dimensional test case, we show that this convergence is on a scale 1/sqrt(p), but with infinite mean square deviation. We demonstrate that the path convergence allows for extrapolation towards the p=infinity path which samples the target distribution. We provide a proof-of-concept extrapolation algorithm and propose the convergence and extrapolation of paths as a possible strategy for density estimation and generalization. We illustrate all our algorithms through pseudo-codes and provide Python implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：讨论、证明、提出算法、提供伪代码。；研究对象：扩散模型中的路径收敛问题，具体研究在有限样本（p个模式）条件下，从参考分布到目标分布的插值路径的收敛行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单变量测试案例中，路径收敛的尺度为1/√p，但均方偏差发散；利用路径收敛性可外推至p=∞的路径，从而实现对目标分布的采样。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单变量测试案例中，路径收敛的尺度为1/√p，但均方偏差发散；利用路径收敛性可外推至p=∞的路径，从而实现对目标分布的采样。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值验证相结合。通过一维测试案例推导收敛标度，提出基于路径收敛的外推算法，并给出伪代码与Python实现。

papers.title: Grand-canonical phase diagram and chiral-current suppression at $π$ flux in a bosonic two-leg ladder
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state phase diagram of repulsively interacting bosons on a two-leg ladder threaded by a uniform artificial magnetic flux, using the cluster Gutzwiller mean-field method. In the strong-rung-coupling regime, self-consistent calculations are performed on a $2\times4$ cluster. By analyzing the superfluid order parameter, leg-resolved currents, chiral current, the current ratio on adjacent legs, and the density imbalance between the two legs, we distinguish Mott-insulating from superfluid regimes and characterize the observed states as Meissner-like, vortex-like (superfluid or Mott insulating), or biased-ladder. In regions overlapping with previous DMRG studies, our results qualitatively agree with the established phase structure, demonstrating that the cluster Gutzwiller approach balances computational efficiency and physical accuracy. We then construct the first grand-canonical $t$--$μ$ phase diagrams for this system, revealing how the magnetic flux modifies the shape, tilt, and extent of the Mott lobes. We further explore previously inaccessible regimes, including higher fillings $ρ\gtrsim1$ and the intermediate interaction window $U/t\in[7.69,9.09]$. Special attention is paid to $\varphi=π$, where the effective triangular-ladder mapping becomes singular. Owing to the equivalence of $\varphi=π$ and $-π$ modulo $2π$, a combined symmetry forbids net chiral currents, leading to a nonchiral Mott-insulating state, in contrast to the chiral-superfluid tendency expected away from $\varphi=π$. Our results offer a computationally efficient route for mapping the global phase structure of bosonic flux ladders and provide guidance for future ultracold-atom experiments in artificial gauge fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：cluster Gutzwiller mean-field method、self-consistent calculations、phase diagram。；研究对象：人工磁场下双腿梯子中相互排斥的玻色子体系，重点关注π磁通下的基态相图与手征电流行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在φ=π处，由于π与-π模2π等价性导致的组合对称性禁止净手征电流，形成非手征莫特绝缘态，与远离π通量时的手征超流倾向形成对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在φ=π处，由于π与-π模2π等价性导致的组合对称性禁止净手征电流，形成非手征莫特绝缘态，与远离π通量时的手征超流倾向形成对比。；创新点：首次构建了该体系的巨正则t-μ相图，揭示了磁通如何改变莫特瓣的形状、倾斜和范围；探索了之前难以触及的高填充（ρ≳1）和中等相互作用区间（U/t∈[7.69,9.09]），并特别分析了π通量处有效三角梯子映射的奇异性及其对手征电流的抑制。
papers.method_zh: 采用团簇Gutzwiller平均场方法，在强横档耦合区域对2×4团簇进行自洽计算，通过分析超流序参量、腿分辨电流、手征电流、相邻腿电流比及两腿密度不平衡来区分相。

papers.title: Tracking atomic-scale interdiffusion in immiscible bimetallic nanoparticles via four-dimensional electron tomography
papers.abstract: The interdiffusion of immiscible elements is generally considered both thermodynamically unfavorable and kinetically hindered. At the nanoscale, however, the mixing behavior of multielements materials often diverges from bulk equilibrium, yet a quantitative, atomically resolved description of this transformation has remained challenging. Using ex situ four dimensional atomic resolution electron tomography combined with in situ scanning transmission electron microscopy, here we reveal the atomic scale miscible transition driven by interdiffusion in immiscible PdIr nanoparticles at temperatures far below the melting point. The pathway involves surface reconstruction atom hopping at 200oC and surface flattening at 300oC, followed by a critical transition at 400oC where Ir interfacial diffusion and discrete Ir intermediates drive miscible intermixing. Upon reaching the nanoscale melting point 900oC, collective inward Ir diffusion yields the thermodynamically stable IrPd configuration. Our findings provide quantitative atomic scale insights into how metastable nanostructures evolve through distinct intermediates, offering a design framework for advanced multielement materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“ex situ four dimensional atomic resolution electron tomography combined with in situ scanning transmission electron microscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：不混溶双金属纳米颗粒（PdIr纳米颗粒）中的原子尺度互扩散行为及其导致的混溶转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远低于熔点的温度下，不混溶的PdIr纳米颗粒可通过表面重构、原子跳跃、界面扩散及中间体形成等路径实现原子尺度的混溶转变，最终在纳米尺度熔点（900°C）达到热力学稳定的IrPd构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远低于熔点的温度下，不混溶的PdIr纳米颗粒可通过表面重构、原子跳跃、界面扩散及中间体形成等路径实现原子尺度的混溶转变，最终在纳米尺度熔点（900°C）达到热力学稳定的IrPd构型。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上定量揭示了不混溶双金属纳米颗粒在远低于熔点的温度下发生混溶转变的具体路径和中间态，包括表面重构、原子跳跃、界面扩散及离散Ir中间体的形成，为设计多元素亚稳纳米材料提供了定量框架。
papers.method_zh: 结合离位四维原子分辨率电子断层扫描（4D electron tomography）与原位扫描透射电子显微镜（in situ STEM）进行原子尺度结构表征。

papers.title: Structural Changes and Transport Properties of $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_7}$ Locally Modified by a He$^+$ Focused Ion Beam
papers.abstract: Irradiation of a material with ions can cause various defects that can lead to structural phase transitions and the modification of the material's properties. Here we study the irradiation of the epitaxyally grown thin films of the high-temperature superconductor $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_7}$ with $30\,\mathrm{keV}$ He$^{+}$ ions which leads to the expansion of the crystal lattice, decrease of the critical temperature $T_c$ and eventually transition to an insulator. Fabrication of such insulating regions with a focused He-Ion beam with a spot size of $\sim 10\,\mathrm{nm}$ is a powerful technique for fabrication of superconducting nano-devices. Using low-temperature resistivity measurements, diffraction with a nanofocused X-ray beam and atomic force microscopy, we investigated how the structure and the electric transport properties of $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_7}$ depend on the irradiation dose in a range $10$--$100\,\mathrm{ions/nm^2}$ and on the lateral size of the irradiated area in a range $30$--$5000\,\mathrm{nm}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用低温和电阻测量、纳米聚焦X射线衍射、原子力显微镜等实验手段。；研究对象：高温超导体YBa₂Cu₃O₇（YBCO）外延薄膜，经30 keV He⁺聚焦离子束辐照后产生的结构变化与电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: He⁺离子辐照导致YBCO晶格膨胀、超导临界温度Tc下降，并最终使材料转变为绝缘体；辐照剂量和辐照区域的横向尺寸对结构及电输运性质有显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：He⁺离子辐照导致YBCO晶格膨胀、超导临界温度Tc下降，并最终使材料转变为绝缘体；辐照剂量和辐照区域的横向尺寸对结构及电输运性质有显著影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 低温和电阻测量（低温电阻率测量）、纳米聚焦X射线衍射（衍射实验）、原子力显微镜（AFM）。辐照剂量范围为10–100 ions/nm²，辐照区域横向尺寸范围为30–5000 nm。

papers.title: From Topological Order to Mixed-State Phases: A Ground-State Probe of Fractionalized Excitations
papers.abstract: How do we detect topological phases from a single ground state? Entanglement entropy and spectrum have long been the standard tools -- but the reduced density matrix (RDM) itself contains far more information. We show that the RDM of a 2D topologically ordered system, expressed at the entanglement cut, realizes a 1D mixed-state phase. For the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code phase, it is a 1D $\mathbb{Z}_2$ strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) phase, where deconfinement of anyons manifests as the short-range correlation of both $\mathbb{Z}_2$ charge and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ domain-wall in the RDM. The bulk $e$-$m$ duality translates into a Kramers--Wannier self-duality of the SW-SSB phase. Extending the framework to gapped $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin liquids, the global spin-rotation symmetry manifests as an additional weak symmetry for the 1D RDM. Spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ spinons result in a cusp on the disorder parameter of spin-rotation at $θ=π$, providing a direct, ground-state signature of symmetry fractionalization. We verify this prediction analytically using the matrix product density operator formalism and numerically for the kagome-lattice resonating valence bond state. The proposed observable requires only a single ground-state wavefunction, making it amenable to quantum simulation platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“show that”“predict”“analytically using the matrix product density operator formalism”“numerically for the kagome-lattice resonating valence bond state”，以理论推导和数值验证为主，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：二维拓扑有序系统（以$\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code相和$\mathbb{Z}_2$自旋液体为例）的基态约化密度矩阵所实现的一维混合态相，以及其中任意子激发（fractionalized excitations）的探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维拓扑有序系统的约化密度矩阵（在纠缠切割处）实现了一维混合态相：对于$\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code相，该相是$\mathbb{Z}_2$强到弱自发对称性破缺（SW-SSB）相，任意子的退禁闭表现为RDM中$\mathbb{Z}_2$电荷和$\mathbb{Z}_2$畴壁的短程关联；对于$\mathbb{Z}_2$自旋液体，自旋-1/2自旋子会在自旋旋转的无序参数于$\theta=\pi$处产生一个尖点，从而提供对称性分数化的直接基态信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维拓扑有序系统的约化密度矩阵（在纠缠切割处）实现了一维混合态相：对于$\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code相，该相是$\mathbb{Z}_2$强到弱自发对称性破缺（SW-SSB）相，任意子的退禁闭表现为RDM中$\mathbb{Z}_2$电荷和$\mathbb{Z}_2$畴壁的短程关联；对于$\mathbb{Z}_2$自旋液体，自旋-1/2自旋子会在自旋旋转的无序参数于$\theta=\pi$处产生一个尖点，从而提供对称性分数化的直接基态信号。；创新点：提出仅需单个基态波函数即可探测拓扑序和分数化激发的方案，通过分析纠缠切割处的约化密度矩阵所实现的一维混合态相，将体态任意子行为映射为混合态中的对称性破缺特征，并预言了自旋子导致的尖点信号，适用于量子模拟平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用约化密度矩阵（RDM）构造一维混合态相，分析对称性（强到弱自发对称性破缺、Kramers-Wannier自对偶性、弱对称性）。数值方法：矩阵乘积密度算符（MPDO）形式解析验证，以及kagome晶格共振价键（RVB）态的数值计算。

papers.title: All-electric picosecond field-free spin-orbit torque switching in magnetic trilayers
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT) enables the electrical manipulation of the magnetization with high speed and low energy consumption for magnetic random-access memory (MRAM) applications. Previous studies of short-pulse SOT switching have mainly focused on the nanosecond regime, whereas reports employing picosecond pulses remain scarce and have largely relied on field-assisted switching using bulky, high-power laser systems, limiting prospects for chip-level integration. Here, we introduce an all-electrical on-chip nanoplasma pulse generator capable of producing pulses as short as 6.4 ps, enabling ultrafast picosecond field-free SOT switching in magnetic trilayers. We show that reducing the pulse width lowers the writing energy by 2-3 orders of magnitude, with ultrafast Joule heating assistance playing an essential role in the enhanced efficiency of the picosecond regime. Our demonstration of ultrafast, all-electrical, and field-free SOT switching establishes the nanoplasma pulse generator as an on-chip platform for ultrafast spintronic studies, with promise for high-speed, energy-efficient, and scalable SOT-MRAM technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了“引入全电学片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器”、“展示”等实验实现和测量内容。；研究对象：磁性三层膜（magnetic trilayers）中的自旋轨道矩（SOT）超快切换现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过全电学片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器产生短至6.4皮秒的脉冲，实现了无外磁场辅助的超快皮秒级自旋轨道矩切换，且将脉冲宽度缩短可降低写入能量2-3个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过全电学片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器产生短至6.4皮秒的脉冲，实现了无外磁场辅助的超快皮秒级自旋轨道矩切换，且将脉冲宽度缩短可降低写入能量2-3个数量级。；创新点：首次实现了全电学、无外磁场辅助的皮秒级自旋轨道矩切换，克服了以往依赖大功率激光系统或纳秒脉冲的限制，并揭示了超快焦耳热在皮秒区间效率提升中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：全电学片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器（产生6.4 ps脉冲）、超快焦耳热辅助技术。未使用激光系统，采用全电学片上集成方案。

papers.title: Scalable Conformal MoSx Catalyst for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution at Industrial-Level Current Density in Alkaline Electrolyzers
papers.abstract: The development of simple and scalable fabrication strategies for cost-effective electrodes is crucial to advance water splitting in alkaline water electrolyzers (AWEs). Here, we present a coating-annealing method to conformally coat a MoSx catalyst layer onto a porous Ni foam (NF) substrate. By controlling the annealing process, the composition of the MoSx layer could be tuned from MoS2 to MoS3 and its catalytic performance for hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in alkaline media was optimized. The MoS3@NF synthesized by this method achieved industrially relevant HER current densities of 200 mA/cm2 at a low overpotential of 246 mV, maintaining stable operation for over 240 h. The MoS3@NF cathode, combined with a stainless steel anode, enabled an alkaline water electrolyzer (AWE) cell to operate steadily at 1.96 V and 1 A/cm2 for 1000 h. This performance surpasses that of most of the previously reported water electrolyzers employing MoSx-based cathodes. Our work demonstrates the potential of MoS3 (with its abundant edge-sulfur atoms serving as active sites) as a high-performance cathode material for industrial AWEs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的材料合成方法（coating-annealing method）和电化学性能测试（HER current densities, overpotential, stability test）。；研究对象：MoSx催化剂层（具体为MoS3）涂覆在多孔泡沫镍（Ni foam）基底上，用于碱性水电解中的析氢反应（HER）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控退火工艺合成的MoS3@NF电极，在碱性介质中实现了工业级电流密度（200 mA/cm²）下仅246 mV的低过电位，并能在1 A/cm²下稳定运行1000小时，性能优于大多数已报道的MoSx基阴极。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控退火工艺合成的MoS3@NF电极，在碱性介质中实现了工业级电流密度（200 mA/cm²）下仅246 mV的低过电位，并能在1 A/cm²下稳定运行1000小时，性能优于大多数已报道的MoSx基阴极。；创新点：提出了一种简单、可扩展的涂覆-退火策略，实现了MoS3催化剂在泡沫镍上的共形涂覆，并发现富含边缘硫原子的MoS3相在工业级电流密度下具有优异的催化活性和稳定性，展示了其作为工业碱性水电解槽阴极材料的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用涂覆-退火法（coating-annealing method）在泡沫镍上共形沉积MoSx层，通过控制退火过程调控MoSx的组成（从MoS2到MoS3），并测试其碱性HER催化性能及全电解池（MoS3@NF阴极+不锈钢阳极）的长期稳定性。

papers.title: Direct nanoscale observation of melting and solute redistribution in a hypoeutectic Al-Cu alloy with in situ STEM
papers.abstract: Melting and solidification of eutectic systems is a classical topic in physical metallurgy, yet the mechanisms at nanoscale are less investigated, due to experimental limitations in spatiotemporal resolution. The advent of \textit{in situ} STEM heating with MEMS technology has recently enabled investigation of eutectic behavior as a function of temperature, time and electrical resistivity. Using this methodology, we investigate the evolution of a nanocrystalline hypoeutectic Al--Cu alloy. Melting initiated in the hotter central region and propagated outward, with grain boundaries acting as preferred sites for eutectic liquid formation via Cu enrichment. The Al$_2$Cu phase melted prior to complete matrix melting. Liquid-state Cu redistribution over a distance of \SI{258}{\micro\metre} -- several orders of magnitude beyond solid-state diffusion limits -- resulted in Al-rich rim accumulations and Cu enrichment at the outermost edge of the observed chip region. These observations are discussed in the context of classical predictions for melting of eutectic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“in situ STEM heating”、“investigate the evolution”、“observations”。；研究对象：亚共晶Al-Cu合金的熔化过程及液相中溶质（Cu）的再分布行为，聚焦纳米尺度下的微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 熔化优先在样品中心高温区起始并向外扩展，晶界因Cu富集成为共晶液相的优先形核位点；Al₂Cu相在基体完全熔化前已熔化，且液相中Cu的再分布距离（258微米）远超固态扩散极限，导致富Al环带和样品边缘Cu富集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：熔化优先在样品中心高温区起始并向外扩展，晶界因Cu富集成为共晶液相的优先形核位点；Al₂Cu相在基体完全熔化前已熔化，且液相中Cu的再分布距离（258微米）远超固态扩散极限，导致富Al环带和样品边缘Cu富集。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于MEMS技术的原位扫描透射电子显微镜（in situ STEM）加热实验，实时观测温度、时间及电阻率变化下的微观结构演化。

papers.title: Proximity-induced unconventional superconductivity and chiral topological phases in twisted graphene/NbSe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure
papers.abstract: We study proximity-induced unconventional superconductivity in a twisted graphene/NbSe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes formalism. The normal-state parameters of proximitized graphene are extracted from ab initio calculations at a twist angle of $23.4^\circ$, which reduces the common symmetry of the heterostructure to $\mathbf{C}_3$. We construct symmetry-allowed superconducting gap functions of the graphene layer according to the irreducible representations of the $\mathbf{C}_3$ group, containing singlet and triplet pairing channels and their mixtures. Computing the topological invariants as a function of the mixing parameters, we find a rich phase diagram of chiral topological superconducting phases, characterized by nonzero Chern numbers $C\in\{-4,-2,2,4\}$. While the nature of the superconducting order parameter of NbSe$_2$ remains debated, the formation of the van der Waals heterostructure and the related symmetry reduction can alter the relative stability of competing pairing channels, potentially stabilizing a chiral component that is proximity-induced into graphene and triggers the topological phases identified here, making the twisted graphene/NbSe$_2$ heterostructure a promising platform for chiral topological superconductivity detectable via quasiparticle interference imaging and transport measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 形式论，并从第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations）提取参数。；研究对象：扭曲石墨烯/NbSe₂ 范德华异质结（twisted graphene/NbSe₂ van der Waals heterostructure），具体研究该体系中由近邻效应诱导的非传统超导性和手性拓扑相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲角为23.4°的异质结中，由于对称性降低为C₃群，石墨烯层中可产生由近邻效应诱导的手性拓扑超导相，其拓扑特性由非零陈数（C∈{-4,-2,2,4}）表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲角为23.4°的异质结中，由于对称性降低为C₃群，石墨烯层中可产生由近邻效应诱导的手性拓扑超导相，其拓扑特性由非零陈数（C∈{-4,-2,2,4}）表征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）具体考虑了扭曲石墨烯/NbSe₂异质结中由晶格失配导致的对称性降低（从高对称性降至C₃群）对超导配对对称性的影响；2）系统计算了在该对称性下，由近邻效应诱导的混合配对通道如何产生具有不同陈数（±2, ±4）的丰富手性拓扑超导相图。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 形式论。首先通过第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations）提取在23.4°扭曲角下近邻化石墨烯的正常态参数。然后根据C₃群的不可约表示，构建了对称性允许的石墨烯层超导能隙函数（包括单态、三重态及其混合通道）。最后通过计算拓扑不变量（陈数）作为混合参数的函数来绘制相图。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Delocalization Realizes Random Dirac Criticality in One Dimension
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian systems can evade Anderson localization and exhibit delocalized states even in one dimension. Here, we show that such non-Hermitian delocalized states under periodic boundary conditions (PBC) are intrinsically critical, realizing the universality class of one-dimensional random Dirac fermions. By linking spectral winding to topological Anderson transitions via Hermitization, we demonstrate that the delocalized PBC states exhibit a Dirac-type criticality with universal algebraic correlations. In contrast to Hermitian systems, where this criticality occurs only at fine-tuned transition points, it emerges generically in non-Hermitian systems as a consequence of spectral topology. These results identify a universal mechanism by which non-Hermiticity promotes criticality, providing a unified description of non-Hermitian delocalization in one dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“show”“demonstrate”“identify”等理论推导和论证性词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：一维非厄米系统中的退局域化现象，以及由此实现的随机狄拉克费米子临界性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在周期性边界条件下，非厄米系统的退局域态本质上具有临界性，实现了与一维随机狄拉克费米子相同的普适类；这种临界性在非厄米系统中是普遍存在的，而非像厄米系统那样仅出现在精细调谐的相变点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在周期性边界条件下，非厄米系统的退局域态本质上具有临界性，实现了与一维随机狄拉克费米子相同的普适类；这种临界性在非厄米系统中是普遍存在的，而非像厄米系统那样仅出现在精细调谐的相变点。；创新点：揭示了非厄米性通过谱拓扑机制普遍促进临界性的出现，为一维非厄米退局域化提供了统一的描述框架。
papers.method_zh: 通过厄米化（Hermitization）方法将谱缠绕数与拓扑安德森转变联系起来，从而建立非厄米退局域化与随机狄拉克临界性之间的理论联系。

papers.title: Multilayer Screening of Double and Conventional Perovskite Solar Cells Using SCAPS-1D and Machine Learning: Optimization of ETL, HTL, and Absorber for High-Efficiency Architectures
papers.abstract: The combinatorial design space of multilayer perovskite solar cells is vast, yet exhaustive experimental or computational screening of all possible material combinations remains impractical. Here, we integrate SCAPS-1D device simulations with machine learning to systematically explore 125 device architectures constructed from five electron transport layers (ETL), five absorbers (including lead-free double perovskites), and five hole transport layers (HTL). A representative subset of configurations is used to train a machine learning (ML) model, which predicts the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of the remaining unexplored structures. Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation yields a Spearman rank correlation, demonstrating reliable ranking capability. SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis reveals that the HTL band gap, absorber band gap, and ETL electron affinity are the most influential descriptors, providing physical insights into interfacial recombination and charge extraction. The machine learning model identifies several high-performance configurations that are subsequently verified by full SCAPS-1D simulations. Among them, the device FTO/TiO$_2$/Cs$_2$AgBiBr$_6$/NiO/Ag achieves a PCE of 28.85%, and the ML-suggested structure FTO/SnO$_2$/Cs$_2$AgInBr$_6$/NiO/Ag exhibits 28.62%, outperforming a closely related literature architecture by approximately 4% absolute. Notably, eight of the top-11 structures employ the lead-free double perovskite Cs$_2$AgInBr$_6$. This work demonstrates that a physics-based, data-driven workflow combining SCAPS-1D, ML, and SHAP can accelerate the discovery of high-efficiency, environmentally friendly perovskite solar cells while providing transparent design rules. The approach is generalizable to other multilayer optoelectronic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：SCAPS-1D device simulations, machine learning, SHAP analysis）；研究对象：多层钙钛矿太阳能电池，包括五种电子传输层（ETL）、五种吸收层（含无铅双钙钛矿）和五种空穴传输层（HTL）构成的125种器件结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习与SCAPS-1D模拟结合，筛选出高效无铅双钙钛矿太阳能电池结构，其中FTO/TiO₂/Cs₂AgBiBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.85%，FTO/SnO₂/Cs₂AgInBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.62%，且前11种高效结构中有8种采用无铅双钙钛矿Cs₂AgInBr₆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习与SCAPS-1D模拟结合，筛选出高效无铅双钙钛矿太阳能电池结构，其中FTO/TiO₂/Cs₂AgBiBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.85%，FTO/SnO₂/Cs₂AgInBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.62%，且前11种高效结构中有8种采用无铅双钙钛矿Cs₂AgInBr₆。；创新点：将SCAPS-1D物理模拟与机器学习及SHAP可解释性分析相结合，系统筛选125种多层钙钛矿器件结构，并揭示HTL带隙、吸收层带隙和ETL电子亲和能为最关键性能描述符，为无铅高效钙钛矿太阳能电池提供透明设计规则。
papers.method_zh: SCAPS-1D器件模拟、机器学习（ML）模型训练与预测、留一组交叉验证（Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation）、SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）特征重要性分析。

papers.title: When and how particles are removed by drops
papers.abstract: Particulate contaminants decrease the power output of solar panels, the transparency of windows, and are detrimental to microelectronics, where even a single particle can induce a short circuit. Despite significant research on particle adhesion and self-cleaning, it remains unclear when and how a drop can remove a particle from a surface, thus efficiently cleaning the surface. Here, by combining lattice Boltzmann simulations and confocal microscopy experiments, we show that at least six different scenarios arise from the complex interplay between capillary and friction forces when a drop collides with a particle. Notably, the capillary force plays a dual role in particle removal: while its tangential component always drives removal, its normal component can also hinder it. By introducing a dimensionless capillary capture parameter, we can predict particle removal across a wide range of particle and surface properties. These results provide quantitative design principles for easy-to-clean surfaces that minimize water and chemical usage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：lattice Boltzmann simulations（计算）、confocal microscopy experiments（实验）。；研究对象：液滴撞击表面时移除固体颗粒的物理过程，具体涉及毛细力与摩擦力之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴移除颗粒至少存在六种不同情景，毛细力的切向分量始终促进移除，但其法向分量可能阻碍移除；引入无量纲“毛细捕获参数”可预测不同颗粒与表面性质下的移除行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴移除颗粒至少存在六种不同情景，毛细力的切向分量始终促进移除，但其法向分量可能阻碍移除；引入无量纲“毛细捕获参数”可预测不同颗粒与表面性质下的移除行为。；创新点：首次系统揭示了液滴移除颗粒时毛细力与摩擦力的复杂竞争关系，并提出了一个无量纲参数（毛细捕获参数）来统一预测颗粒是否被移除，为设计易清洁表面提供了定量设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 格子玻尔兹曼模拟（lattice Boltzmann simulations）与共聚焦显微镜实验（confocal microscopy experiments）相结合。

papers.title: Heisenberg-Langevin theory of an exciton mirror
papers.abstract: We develop a Heisenberg-Langevin theory of an exciton mirror accounting for the retardation and the long-range electron-hole exchange. A particular case of a strong transverse magnetic field is analyzed in detail. The optical bistability due to repulsion between the excitons inside the light cone appears to be prone to a modulational instability towards the non-radiative surface polariton modes. Above the corresponding threshold, the pumped 2D exciton gas acts as an optical parametric generator of twin polariton beams. Conversely, below the threshold, the mirror acquires the phase-conjugating properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Heisenberg-Langevin theory（海森堡-朗之万理论）、理论分析、光学双稳态、调制不稳定性。；研究对象：激子镜（exciton mirror）体系，具体为二维激子气体在强横向磁场下的光学行为，涉及激子-光子耦合、长程电子-空穴交换相互作用以及表面极化激元模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强横向磁场下，光锥内激子间的排斥作用导致的光学双稳态容易向非辐射表面极化激元模式发生调制不稳定性；高于阈值时，泵浦的二维激子气体可作为孪生极化激元光束的光学参量发生器，低于阈值时则具有相位共轭特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强横向磁场下，光锥内激子间的排斥作用导致的光学双稳态容易向非辐射表面极化激元模式发生调制不稳定性；高于阈值时，泵浦的二维激子气体可作为孪生极化激元光束的光学参量发生器，低于阈值时则具有相位共轭特性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用海森堡-朗之万理论框架，考虑了延迟效应和长程电子-空穴交换相互作用，并对强横向磁场这一特定情形进行了详细解析分析。

papers.title: Reflective Metastructure Q-plate for Ultrashort Laser Pulses
papers.abstract: The orbital angular momentum of light is an intriguing property for developing light driven applications. It emerged as an independent degree of freedom by which to manipulate light and, consequently, the interaction of light with matter. Several methods exist for the generation of light carrying orbital angular momentum, mostly employing transmitting or reflecting optical components, which radially modulate the phase profile of the light. As one of such components, transmissive q-plates established themselves as standard elements due to their usability over a broad wavelength range. Here, we present our approach to build a highly reflective q-plate based on a plasmonic metasurface capable of converting orbital angular momentum from the nanostructure to ultrashort laser pulses without temporal broadening. We highlight its working principle over a wide range of wavelengths for reflection under normal and gracing incidence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：plasmonic metasurface（等离激元超表面）、highly reflective q-plate（高反射q板）、ultrashort laser pulses（超短激光脉冲）。；研究对象：基于等离激元超表面的高反射型q板，用于在超短激光脉冲中产生和转换轨道角动量（OAM）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该反射式超表面q板能够将纳米结构中的轨道角动量转换为超短激光脉冲，且不会引起时间展宽，并在正入射和掠入射下均能在宽波长范围内有效工作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该反射式超表面q板能够将纳米结构中的轨道角动量转换为超短激光脉冲，且不会引起时间展宽，并在正入射和掠入射下均能在宽波长范围内有效工作。；创新点：提出了一种基于等离激元超表面的高反射型q板，区别于传统的透射式q板，能够在反射模式下工作，并适用于超短激光脉冲，且无时间展宽效应。摘要未突出说明与已有反射式方案相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用等离激元超表面（plasmonic metasurface）构建高反射q板，通过纳米结构对光场的径向相位进行调制，实现轨道角动量的转换。摘要未明确说明具体制备工艺或表征手段。

papers.title: Phonons and magnetism of kagome FeGe probed by nuclear resonant scattering
papers.abstract: Kagome FeGe hosts a $2\times2\times2$ charge-density wave (CDW) that strongly interplays with antiferromagnetic order. Here, we report $^{57}$Fe nuclear resonant scattering measurement to study FeGe across its long-range CDW and incommensurate magnetic transitions. Upon entering the CDW state, hardening of acoustic phonons and optical phonons around 22~meV, 27~meV, and 31~meV are observed in the Fe partial phonon density of states, which can be qualitatively captured by first-principle calculations. Upon entering the incommensurate magnetic phase, neither the phonon density of states nor the hyperfine interaction parameters change significantly, although a subtle feature associated with the incommensurate magnetic order or slow fluctuations is detected in the time-domain Mössbauer spectra. These findings show that the CDW in kagome FeGe significantly modifies its lattice dynamics and magnetism, evidencing an intertwined nature of the spin, charge, and lattice degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：nuclear resonant scattering measurement、Mössbauer spectra、first-principle calculations作为辅助）；研究对象：Kagome结构FeGe中的电荷密度波（CDW）与反铁磁有序的相互作用，具体研究其声子动力学和磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 进入CDW态后，Fe的声子态密度中声学声子和光学声子（约22、27、31 meV）出现硬化，而进入非公度磁相后声子态密度和超精细相互作用参数变化不大，但时域穆斯堡尔谱检测到与非公度磁序或慢涨落相关的细微特征，表明自旋、电荷和晶格自由度之间存在交织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：进入CDW态后，Fe的声子态密度中声学声子和光学声子（约22、27、31 meV）出现硬化，而进入非公度磁相后声子态密度和超精细相互作用参数变化不大，但时域穆斯堡尔谱检测到与非公度磁序或慢涨落相关的细微特征，表明自旋、电荷和晶格自由度之间存在交织。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 57Fe核共振散射（nuclear resonant scattering）测量，结合第一性原理计算（first-principle calculations）定性分析声子态密度变化，以及时域穆斯堡尔谱（time-domain Mössbauer spectra）探测磁序特征。

papers.title: In Situ Dynamics of the Microscopic Crystallographic Dehydration Pathway in a Model Channel Hydrate, Theophylline
papers.abstract: Solid-state phase transformations in molecular crystal hydrates govern stability and functional performance across a range of applications, including pharmaceutical, agrochemical and coordination framework materials. During dehydration, these hydrates can undergo substantial structural reorganisation involving changes in molecular orientation, intermolecular interactions, and lattice symmetry. Despite extensive study, the microscopic crystallographic pathways by which such transformations proceed remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the dynamics of solid-state dehydration of theophylline monohydrate as a model molecular hydrate using in situ low-dose scanning electron diffraction (SED). Simultaneous observations of changes in morphology and crystallographic phase and orientation mapped across single particles reveal how complete dehydration proceeds via a two-step, reconstructive topotactic solid-state transformation: anisotropic, surface-specific mass loss of material near water channel sides (suggesting the monohydrate adopts a non-centrosymmetric crystal structure) is followed by surface-localised nucleation and growth of anhydrous form II on the parent monohydrate while preserving similar molecular orientations at a common plane. By providing direct, local crystallographic insight into hydrate dehydration, this work demonstrates how surface-controlled mass loss, morphological changes, and lattice orientation jointly govern solid-state transformations in molecular hydrates. More broadly, it establishes low-dose SED as an effective approach for probing dynamic phase transformations in beam-sensitive molecular crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了使用“in situ low-dose scanning electron diffraction (SED)”进行实验观测。；研究对象：茶碱一水合物（theophylline monohydrate）作为模型分子晶体水合物，研究其固态脱水过程中的微观晶体学路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 茶碱一水合物的完全脱水通过两步、重构型拓扑固态相变实现：首先在通道侧面发生各向异性、表面特异的质量损失（暗示一水合物具有非中心对称晶体结构），随后在母体一水合物表面局部成核并生长无水II型，同时保持共同平面上的相似分子取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：茶碱一水合物的完全脱水通过两步、重构型拓扑固态相变实现：首先在通道侧面发生各向异性、表面特异的质量损失（暗示一水合物具有非中心对称晶体结构），随后在母体一水合物表面局部成核并生长无水II型，同时保持共同平面上的相似分子取向。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原位低剂量扫描电子衍射（SED），同时观测单颗粒的形貌变化、晶体学相变和取向变化。

papers.title: Residual stress gradient in a thin film within the dislocation pile-up theory
papers.abstract: A model for predicting the residual stress gradient in a thin film segment is developed on the basis of the theory of dislocation pile-ups. The initial shear stress within the film is relaxed via the formation of a pile-up of screw dislocations against the impenetrable film-substrate interface. Plastic strain is related to the dislocation density, leading to a fundamental equation, which links the residual stress to this density. The distribution of dislocations within the pile-up for an arbitrary, non-uniform residual stress profile is derived analytically by applying the force balance condition. This results in a singular integro-differential equation for the residual stress profile. The equation is solved numerically by a collocation method for various initial stress distributions: constant, linear, parabolic, and exponential functions. The solutions demonstrate that the established residual stress profile strongly depends on the film segment's thickness-to-width ratio and the initial stress distribution. As this ratio increases, stress relaxation becomes more effective away from the film-substrate interface. In all cases, equilibrium requires a pile-up containing dislocations with both positive and negative Burgers vectors. The total number of dislocations and their density distribution vary significantly with the initial stress profile. This model provides a critical step towards more complex models of residual stress formation in constrained material systems, specifically, thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develops a model”（建立模型）、“derived analytically”（解析推导）、“solved numerically”（数值求解），属于理论建模与数值计算范畴。；研究对象：薄膜中的残余应力梯度。具体体系为：在不可穿透的薄膜-基底界面处，通过螺位错塞积的形成来释放初始剪切应力的薄膜片段。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立的残余应力分布强烈依赖于薄膜片段的厚度-宽度比以及初始应力分布。随着该比值增大，远离薄膜-基底界面的应力松弛更有效；在所有情况下，平衡态要求塞积群中同时包含正负伯氏矢量的位错。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立的残余应力分布强烈依赖于薄膜片段的厚度-宽度比以及初始应力分布。随着该比值增大，远离薄膜-基底界面的应力松弛更有效；在所有情况下，平衡态要求塞积群中同时包含正负伯氏矢量的位错。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：将位错塞积理论应用于预测薄膜中的残余应力梯度，并解析推导了任意非均匀残余应力分布下的位错分布方程，为更复杂的约束材料系统（如薄膜）中的残余应力形成模型提供了关键一步。
papers.method_zh: 基于位错塞积理论，通过力平衡条件解析推导了任意非均匀残余应力分布下的位错分布函数，得到一个奇异积分-微分方程。采用配置法（collocation method）对常数、线性、抛物线和指数函数等不同初始应力分布下的方程进行数值求解。

papers.title: Estimation of conserved charges for a one dimensional system with inhomogeneous hopping
papers.abstract: Quantum integrability in a system is characterized by a large number of conserved charges. However, finding the conserved charges in a generic quantum system is highly challenging. The integrable matrix theory provides a unified framework to obtain the conserved charges in a certain class of systems. We demonstrate this framework in case of a single-particle system on a 1D finite-sized lattice with inhomogeneous nearest neighbor hopping to study the statistical properties of the system across its chaotic--integrable crossover from the perspective of the conserved charges. The eigenspectrum of our random matrix model is studied first. We then estimate the conserved charges and find their properties throughout the chaotic to integrable transition of the system. We calculate the number of conserved charges across this crossover and observe that it is nearly equal to the size of the system at its integrable limit. Our result suggests that the number of conserved charges, estimated using the integrable matrix theory, can be a measure of quantum integrability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“量子可积性”“随机矩阵模型”“可积矩阵理论”等理论框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：一维有限尺寸晶格上具有非均匀最近邻跳跃的单粒子系统，研究其从混沌到可积的交叉过程中的统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可积矩阵理论估算出的守恒荷数量在系统可积极限下接近系统尺寸，表明该数量可作为量子可积性的度量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可积矩阵理论估算出的守恒荷数量在系统可积极限下接近系统尺寸，表明该数量可作为量子可积性的度量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用可积矩阵理论（Integrable Matrix Theory）作为统一框架，构建随机矩阵模型，分析其本征谱，并估算守恒荷在混沌-可积交叉过程中的性质与数量。

papers.title: Coupling Chirality, Polar Order, and Altermagnetic Spin Splitting in a Hybrid Manganese Chloride
papers.abstract: Hybrid manganese halides enable the coexistence of molecular chirality, polar order, and magnetic exchange within a single lattice. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with spin-space-group analysis to investigate the synthesized enantiomeric pair [(R)/(S)-MPA]2[MnCl4(H2O)] (MPA = beta-methylphenethylammonium). We predict that its compensated magnetic state hosts altermagnetic spin splitting in the nonrelativistic limit, and that the coupled chiral, polar, and magnetic degrees of freedom define a symmetry-related manifold. From this manifold, we derive simple sign rules for the electronic and magneto-optical response: reversing both chirality and polarity, or reversing the magnetic domain alone, inverts the spin splitting throughout the Brillouin zone, whereas reversing chirality alone or polarity alone changes the spin-splitting sign only in symmetry-selected regions. With spin-orbit coupling, reversing chirality or magnetic order flips the Kerr rotation angle, while changing the polar variant leaves it unchanged. These results reveal a chemically accessible route to translate molecular handedness into symmetry-controlled spin splitting and magneto-optical readout in hybrid manganese halides. Critically, we show that the sign and momentum pattern of the splitting are governed by the interplay of the chiral, polar, and magnetic degrees of freedom. This interplay opens the possibility to control the spin splitting through a judicious design of the organic cations, by modulating their chirality and polarity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、spin-space-group analysis（自旋空间群分析）。；研究对象：手性杂化锰氯化物 [(R)/(S)-MPA]₂[MnCl₄(H₂O)]（MPA = β-甲基苯乙铵）的对映体，以及其中手性、极性序与交变磁自旋劈裂的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测该材料的补偿磁态在非相对论极限下存在交变磁自旋劈裂，且自旋劈裂的符号和动量模式由手性、极性和磁自由度的耦合决定；通过反转手性与极性、或单独反转磁畴可翻转整个布里渊区的自旋劈裂符号，而单独反转手性或极性仅改变对称性选择区域的自旋劈裂符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测该材料的补偿磁态在非相对论极限下存在交变磁自旋劈裂，且自旋劈裂的符号和动量模式由手性、极性和磁自由度的耦合决定；通过反转手性与极性、或单独反转磁畴可翻转整个布里渊区的自旋劈裂符号，而单独反转手性或极性仅改变对称性选择区域的自旋劈裂符号。；创新点：揭示了通过有机阳离子的手性和极性设计来调控自旋劈裂的化学途径，并建立了手性、极性与磁自由度耦合对自旋劈裂及磁光响应符号的定量规则。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合自旋空间群分析（spin-space-group analysis），并分析了电子与磁光响应（如Kerr旋转角）的符号规则。

papers.title: The Kondo effect in ferromagnetic quantum critical CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$
papers.abstract: The mechanism of a pressure-induced quantum critical point in the heavy fermion ferromagnet CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$ has attracted interest, as ferromagnetic quantum criticality in a clean itinerant Ce compound is typically avoided. The localized versus itinerant character of the 4\textit{f} electrons is a key aspect for understanding this behavior. We investigated the electronic structure of the 4\textit{f} shell in CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$ using core-level photoelectron and x-ray absorption spectroscopy, demonstrating the hybridization of Ce 4\textit{f} with the conduction electrons. Linearly polarized x-ray absorption reveals a temperature-dependent linear dichroism consistent with the crystal-electric-field (CEF) sequence as inferred from the static susceptibility. This dichroism cannot be described by an ionic full-multiplet model alone, but is reproduced by including the Kondo effect within a single-impurity Anderson model in the non crossing approximation (SIAM/NCA). The Kondo effect mixes higher lying crystal-field states into a resulting multiorbital ground state with 4\textit{f} occupancy \textit{n}$_f$\,$\sim$\,0.9. Deviations at low temperatures between the measured linear dichroism and calculated dichroism suggest an orbital-dependent Kondo effect. A scenario in which there is a multiorbital ground state and orbital-dependent Kondo hybridization should be a starting point for a model of pressure-induced criticality in CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了核心能级光电子能谱（core-level photoelectron spectroscopy）和X射线吸收谱（X-ray absorption spectroscopy）等实验手段。；研究对象：重费米子铁磁体CeRh₆Ge₄中压力诱导的量子临界点，特别是4f电子的局域与巡游特性以及Kondo效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CeRh₆Ge₄中，Kondo效应将高能晶体场态混合成多轨道基态（4f占据数n_f~0.9），且低温下线性二色性的测量值与计算值存在偏差，暗示存在轨道依赖的Kondo效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CeRh₆Ge₄中，Kondo效应将高能晶体场态混合成多轨道基态（4f占据数n_f~0.9），且低温下线性二色性的测量值与计算值存在偏差，暗示存在轨道依赖的Kondo效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 核心能级光电子能谱、线偏振X射线吸收谱（测量温度依赖的线性二色性），结合单杂质安德森模型（SIAM）在非交叉近似（NCA）下的理论计算。

papers.title: Interfacial Coupling and Sparse Intercalation of 7-Atom-Wide Armchair Graphene Nanoribbons by N-Heterocyclic Carbene Monolayers
papers.abstract: Graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) synthesized on metal substrates experience electronic coupling and screening from the underlying surface, which, although often weak, can modify their observed properties and complicate their transfer to device-compatible substrates. Intercalation of GNRs by self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) offers a possible route to reduce this interaction. Here, we investigate the intercalation of 7-atom-wide armchair graphene nanoribbons (7-AGNRs) on Au(111) using N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs). Low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, and density functional theory calculations reveal that the adsorption geometry of the NHCs strongly influences the intercalation yield for GNRs. Methyl-substituted NHCs form flat-lying dimers that partially intercalate the GNRs, producing locally decoupled segments. In contrast, bulkier isopropyl-substituted NHCs form upright monomers that embed the GNRs within the monolayer, preventing intercalation. The low intercalation yield indicates that lifting the nanoribbon from the Au surface is energetically costly. These results establish molecular adsorption geometry and packing as key parameters controlling intercalation at GNR-metal interfaces, with implications for the rational design of decoupling layers for GNR-based device integration pathways.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了低温柔道扫描隧道显微镜/谱（LT-STM/STS）、拉曼光谱等实验手段，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进行解释。；研究对象：7原子宽扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（7-AGNRs）与N-杂环卡宾（NHCs）自组装单分子层在Au(111)表面的界面耦合与插层行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NHCs的吸附几何构型（平躺二聚体 vs. 直立单体）强烈影响其对7-AGNRs的插层效率：甲基取代的NHCs形成平躺二聚体，可部分插层并局部解耦纳米带；而异丙基取代的NHCs形成直立单体，将纳米带嵌入单分子层内，阻止插层。整体插层产率低，表明将纳米带从金表面抬起在能量上代价高昂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NHCs的吸附几何构型（平躺二聚体 vs. 直立单体）强烈影响其对7-AGNRs的插层效率：甲基取代的NHCs形成平躺二聚体，可部分插层并局部解耦纳米带；而异丙基取代的NHCs形成直立单体，将纳米带嵌入单分子层内，阻止插层。整体插层产率低，表明将纳米带从金表面抬起在能量上代价高昂。；创新点：首次揭示了分子吸附几何构型和堆积方式作为控制石墨烯纳米带-金属界面插层的关键参数，为合理设计用于纳米带器件集成的解耦层提供了依据。
papers.method_zh: 低温柔道扫描隧道显微镜/谱（LT-STM/STS）、拉曼光谱、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Exact distribution of the output of a deep-layered machine
papers.abstract: Deep-layered machines, in which each node computes a Boolean function of all nodes below it, underpin deep learning and digital computation. Yet the statistics of their global output function remain poorly understood. We derive the exact finite-depth distribution of the output of a machine with width $k$ and depth $n$. The distribution depends only on the Hamming weight of the output, and as $n$ increases favors functions with low and high Hamming weights. But this bias peaks at a crossover depth proportional to $2^k$ before collapsing onto the constant functions true and false.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive the exact finite-depth distribution”（推导精确分布）、“statistics”（统计）、“distribution depends only on”（分布仅依赖于），属于纯理论分析。；研究对象：深度分层机器（deep-layered machines），即每个节点计算其下方所有节点的布尔函数的网络结构，用于理解深度学习与数字计算中全局输出函数的统计特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了宽度为 \(k\)、深度为 \(n\) 的机器输出函数的精确有限深度分布。该分布仅依赖于输出函数的汉明重量，且随着深度 \(n\) 增加，分布倾向于低汉明重量和高汉明重量的函数；但这种偏好在深度达到约 \(2^k\) 的交叉点后达到峰值，随后分布坍缩为常数函数 true 和 false。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了宽度为 \(k\)、深度为 \(n\) 的机器输出函数的精确有限深度分布。该分布仅依赖于输出函数的汉明重量，且随着深度 \(n\) 增加，分布倾向于低汉明重量和高汉明重量的函数；但这种偏好在深度达到约 \(2^k\) 的交叉点后达到峰值，随后分布坍缩为常数函数 true 和 false。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过解析方法精确计算深度分层机器输出函数的有限深度分布，分析其与宽度 \(k\)、深度 \(n\) 及汉明重量的依赖关系。

papers.title: Boron Co-Alloying in AlScN Wurtzite Ferroelectrics: Insights from an 850-Sample Combinatorial Study
papers.abstract: AlScN wurtzite ferroelectrics are promising candidates for energy-efficient non-volatile memory. However, AlScN suffers from a high coercive field and reduced cycling endurance, and the limited tunability of its properties constrains further optimization. Co-doping AlScN with boron offers the promise of independently tailoring the chemical and structural properties, making AlScBN an attractive quaternary system. This material has already been explored for a few selected compositions, however, no systematic study of the full AlScBN compositional space exists. A combinatorial approach consisting of gradient deposition with HiPIMS at low temperatures of 250°C and automatic analysis of film properties allowed us to analyze a total of 850 unique samples within the AlScBN phase space. In addition to a full screening of the materials' chemical and structural properties, we fabricate and characterize combinatorial device libraries. XPS charge transfer analysis experimentally confirms that bond ionicity correlates with a reduction in the coercive field for AlScN and AlScBN systems, opposite trends are instead observed for AlBN. While the films maintain a high remanent polarization of 130-150 μC/cm2, Sc and B co-doping reduces the coercive field from 7 MV/cm to 3 MV/cm. Notably, B co-alloying lowers the amount of Sc needed to lower the coercive field, reducing reliance on this scarce element. In addition, we find that co-alloying with B, notably improves cycling endurance, which is related to a reduction in defect density. These results establish AlScBN as a scalable, CMOS-compatible ferroelectric, positioning it as an interesting alternative to AlScN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“combinatorial approach”、“gradient deposition with HiPIMS”、“fabricate and characterize combinatorial device libraries”、“XPS charge transfer analysis”。；研究对象：AlScBN（硼共掺杂的AlScN）纤锌矿铁电体，具体研究其全组分空间内的化学、结构、铁电及循环耐久性等性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硼共掺杂可显著降低AlScN的矫顽场（从7 MV/cm降至3 MV/cm），同时保持高剩余极化（130-150 μC/cm²），并提高循环耐久性；硼的加入还减少了对稀缺元素Sc的依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硼共掺杂可显著降低AlScN的矫顽场（从7 MV/cm降至3 MV/cm），同时保持高剩余极化（130-150 μC/cm²），并提高循环耐久性；硼的加入还减少了对稀缺元素Sc的依赖。；创新点：首次对AlScBN全组分空间进行系统性、高通量的实验研究（850个样品），揭示了硼共掺杂在降低矫顽场、减少Sc用量及改善循环耐久性方面的协同作用，并实验证实了键合离子性与矫顽场之间的关联趋势在AlScN/AlScBN与AlBN体系中相反。
papers.method_zh: 采用组合方法，包括低温（250°C）HiPIMS梯度沉积技术制备薄膜，结合自动分析对850个独特样品进行化学与结构性质的全组分筛选；并制备组合器件库进行电学表征；使用XPS电荷转移分析实验验证键合离子性与矫顽场的关系。

papers.title: Perspective: The Physics of Active Solids -- From Hamiltonians to Active Matter Models
papers.abstract: The physics of active matter, wherein constituent particles consume energy to generate autonomous motion, has revolutionized non-equilibrium statistical mechanics. While a large body of work has successfully elucidated the behavior of dilute active systems, the dense regime -- characterized by ``active glasses and active solids'' -- presents profound challenges that defy conventional theoretical frameworks. Recent observations reveal two striking features in these dense systems: an apparent enhancement of Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg (MWH) fluctuations leading to anomalous long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a remarkable correspondence between activity-induced annealing and annealing via oscillatory shear. In this perspective article, we propose a novel approach toward a deeper understanding of dense active matter: by developing active Hamiltonian models as equilibrium reference frameworks, we map out pathways toward non-equilibrium active systems.
