This strategy allows us to elucidate both the correspondence between driven and active systems and the enhanced MWH fluctuations, which likely arise from a strong coupling between spatially random active forces and long-wavelength density (phonon) modes. We outline a comprehensive roadmap employing complementary approaches, including the active Hamiltonian formalism, comparative studies of oscillatory shear in active and passive solids, and investigations of chiral active matter. Establishing this activity-oscillatory shear correspondence across diverse systems is essential to demonstrate its universality, reveal the underlying large-scale emergent physics, and place our hypothesis on a firmer theoretical ground.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：perspective article, propose a novel approach, theoretical frameworks, hypothesis）；研究对象：密集活性物质体系，具体包括活性玻璃（active glasses）和活性固体（active solids）中的非平衡统计力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 密集活性物质表现出两个显著特征：一是梅明-瓦格纳-霍恩伯格（MWH）涨落的表观增强，导致反常的长波长密度涨落；二是活性诱导的退火与振荡剪切退火之间存在显著对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：密集活性物质表现出两个显著特征：一是梅明-瓦格纳-霍恩伯格（MWH）涨落的表观增强，导致反常的长波长密度涨落；二是活性诱导的退火与振荡剪切退火之间存在显著对应关系。；创新点：提出通过发展活性哈密顿模型作为平衡参考框架来理解密集活性物质的新策略，并系统性地建立活性系统与驱动系统（振荡剪切）之间的对应关系，以揭示其普适性和底层大尺度涌现物理。
papers.method_zh: 提出构建活性哈密顿模型（active Hamiltonian models）作为平衡参考框架，通过该框架映射通向非平衡活性系统的路径；同时采用互补研究手段，包括活性哈密顿形式论、活性与被动固体中振荡剪切的比较研究，以及手性活性物质的研究。

papers.title: Visualizing Transient Ordering Phenomena in Dense Nanoparticle Clouds
papers.abstract: The dynamics of nanoparticles within nanoscale liquid environments exhibit a range of complex phenomena driven by the interplay of processes at varying length scales. While these dynamics have profound technical implications, such as in nanoscale catalytic kinetics, ion-transport pathways in energy storage, and macromolecular crowding in biological systems, real-space imaging of dense, confined nanoparticle assemblies remains a significant challenge. Here, we present a liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy approach in which dense clouds of gold nanoparticles are formed within microfluidic channels, rendering the particle ensemble visible in bright-field electron imaging. This strategy enables direct imaging of different density-dependent particle ordering phenomena, including a local structuring of the colloidal liquid in nanoscale spaces, disordered dynamic clouds at high nanoparticle densities and the reversible formation of superlattice structures. Our results provide a unique window into the complex processes of colloidal self-organization at the nanoscale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy approach、direct imaging、visualizing。；研究对象：纳米颗粒在纳米尺度液体环境中的动态有序现象，具体为微流通道内密集金纳米颗粒云中的有序化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过液相透射电子显微镜直接成像，观察到密集纳米颗粒云中依赖于密度的多种有序现象，包括纳米空间内胶体液体的局域结构、高密度下的无序动态云以及超晶格结构的可逆形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过液相透射电子显微镜直接成像，观察到密集纳米颗粒云中依赖于密度的多种有序现象，包括纳米空间内胶体液体的局域结构、高密度下的无序动态云以及超晶格结构的可逆形成。；创新点：实现了对密集、受限纳米颗粒组装体在真实空间中的直接成像，克服了此前难以观察此类体系动态过程的挑战，揭示了纳米尺度胶体自组织的复杂过程。
papers.method_zh: 液相透射电子显微镜（liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy），结合微流通道形成密集金纳米颗粒云，利用明场电子成像使颗粒集合体可见。

papers.title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
papers.abstract: Halide double perovskites (A$_2$BB'X$_6$) are a long-known class of materials that has recently been rediscovered for diverse applications, including photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection. Their doubled unit cell provides immense chemical tunability, allowing the incorporation of magnetic ions and enabling access to a wide range of electronic-structure features, including different band-edge characters, alignments, and symmetries. Magnetic elements may further introduce spin degrees of freedom and magnetic behaviour, thereby broadening the functional landscape of these compounds. Here, we present the first comprehensive database of spin-polarised electronic-structure data for all halide double perovskites predicted to be stable by the recently introduced $τ$ tolerance factor by Bartel et al. The dataset focuses on the Cs$_2$BB'X$_6$ family, with X = I, Br, Cl, and F, and includes density of states (DOS) for $>$2,500 compounds, calculated using hybrid-functional density functional theory. Among these, 719 compounds exhibit band gaps in the visible range and 118 display half-metallic character. In addition, we provide chemical-bonding analysis using \textsc{lobster}, which provides insights into orbital interactions across the dataset. To facilitate exploration, we further offer UMAP-based visualisations and an interactive app for systematic investigation of chemical composition, electronic structure, and magnetic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid-functional density functional theory”（混合泛函密度泛函理论）和“chemical-bonding analysis using lobster”（使用lobster进行化学键分析），均为计算手段。；研究对象：卤化物双钙钛矿（A₂BB'X₆），具体聚焦于Cs₂BB'X₆家族（X = I, Br, Cl, F），包括其自旋极化电子结构、化学键合以及磁性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建了首个涵盖2500多种稳定卤化物双钙钛矿的自旋极化电子结构数据库，其中719种化合物具有可见光范围内的带隙，118种表现出半金属特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建了首个涵盖2500多种稳定卤化物双钙钛矿的自旋极化电子结构数据库，其中719种化合物具有可见光范围内的带隙，118种表现出半金属特性。；创新点：首次提供了基于自旋极化电子结构的大规模卤化物双钙钛矿数据库，并结合化学键合分析，为系统研究其组成、电子结构与磁性之间的关系提供了数据基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合泛函密度泛函理论（hybrid-functional DFT）计算态密度（DOS）；使用lobster进行化学键合分析；利用UMAP进行可视化降维，并开发了交互式应用程序用于系统探索。

papers.title: Quantum tidal locking in orbiting Bose-Einstein condensates
papers.abstract: Angular momentum coupling manifests widely in diverse physical systems, underpinning the emergent properties and collective dynamics across different scales. The tidal locking, which originates from the synchronization of rotational and orbital motions, has far-reaching impacts in celestial mechanics, reflecting fundamental processes of angular momentum transfer, energy dissipation, and evolution toward dynamical equilibrium. However, its counterpart in mesoscopic quantum fluids has remained largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate the emergence of quantum tidal locking in Bose-Einstein condensates undergoing central force motion in an anharmonic potential. The condensate follows a well-defined orbital trajectory in a static trap and experiences an effective rotating potential induced by the trap anharmonicity. The sustained geometric squeezing continuously deforms the condensate and drives a self-organized synchronization process, in which the intrinsic rotation gradually locks to the orbital motion. Numerical simulations further reveal the formation of a ring-shaped vortex array over longer timescales, arising from the coherent evolution of the rotating matter wave during the locking dynamics. Our findings establish quantum tidal locking in mesoscopic systems as a robust self-organized mechanism for generating and stabilizing circulating states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、numerical simulations、self-organized synchronization）；研究对象：在非简谐势阱中做中心力运动的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensates, BECs）中的量子潮汐锁定现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在介观量子流体中，玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在非简谐势阱中运动时，会自发产生量子潮汐锁定，即内禀转动逐渐与轨道运动同步，并在长时间尺度上形成环形涡旋阵列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在介观量子流体中，玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在非简谐势阱中运动时，会自发产生量子潮汐锁定，即内禀转动逐渐与轨道运动同步，并在长时间尺度上形成环形涡旋阵列。；创新点：首次在介观量子流体中揭示了潮汐锁定现象的量子对应物，建立了量子潮汐锁定作为一种自组织机制，用于产生和稳定循环态。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（numerical simulations），具体为模拟玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在静态非简谐势阱中的轨道运动及有效旋转势作用下的动力学演化。

papers.title: Robust Spin Logic Enabled by Generalized $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ Symmetry in $p$-Wave Magnets
papers.abstract: Unconventional magnets combine the vanishing stray fields of antiferromagnets with the strong spin-splitting of ferromagnets, offering a unique material platform for spintronics. However, a critical challenge in realizing functional spin-logic devices lies in preserving long-range spin coherence against momentum-degrading scattering and gate-induced dephasing. Here, we demonstrate that the intrinsic momentum-dependent exchange field of a three-dimensional $p$-wave magnet can be precisely tuned against gate-induced Rashba spin-orbit coupling to establish a \textit{generalized} $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ spin-rotation symmetry. This emergent conservation law generates a symmetry-protected Persistent Spin Helix (PSH), effectively integrating the high energy scales of 3D bulk magnetic exchange with the macroscopic coherence of symmetry protection. By modeling a synergistic $p$-wave magnetic spin field-effect transistor (spin-FET), we reveal high-visibility Datta-Das conductance oscillations controlled purely by electrical gating. Crucially, our quantum transport simulations confirm that this symmetry-engineered transport regime exhibits exceptional resilience against strong non-magnetic Anderson disorder and geometric variations. These results establish a synergistic paradigm for non-magnetized spintronics, demonstrating how the active integration of spin-orbit coupling and unconventional magnetism can yield disorder-resilient spintronic logic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”、“modeling”、“quantum transport simulations”等关键词，表明主要基于理论建模和数值模拟。；研究对象：三维 \( p \)-波磁体（\( p \)-wave magnet）中的自旋逻辑器件，具体为一种协同型 \( p \)-波磁自旋场效应晶体管（spin-FET）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确调控三维 \( p \)-波磁体的内禀动量依赖交换场与栅极诱导的Rashba自旋轨道耦合，可以建立一种广义的 \( \mathrm{SU}(2) \) 自旋旋转对称性，从而产生对称性保护的持久自旋螺旋（PSH）。基于此设计的自旋场效应晶体管展现出高可见度的Datta-Das电导振荡，且对强非磁性安德森无序和几何变化具有卓越的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确调控三维 \( p \)-波磁体的内禀动量依赖交换场与栅极诱导的Rashba自旋轨道耦合，可以建立一种广义的 \( \mathrm{SU}(2) \) 自旋旋转对称性，从而产生对称性保护的持久自旋螺旋（PSH）。基于此设计的自旋场效应晶体管展现出高可见度的Datta-Das电导振荡，且对强非磁性安德森无序和几何变化具有卓越的鲁棒性。；创新点：首次提出并证明了在三维 \( p \)-波磁体中，通过主动整合自旋轨道耦合与非常规磁性，可以工程化地实现广义 \( \mathrm{SU}(2) \) 对称性，从而将三维体磁交换的高能量尺度与对称性保护的宏观相干性（持久自旋螺旋）结合起来，为构建抗无序的自旋逻辑器件提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与量子输运模拟。具体包括：利用对称性分析建立广义 \( \mathrm{SU}(2) \) 对称性条件；通过建模协同型 \( p \)-波磁自旋场效应晶体管（spin-FET）进行器件性能分析；采用量子输运模拟（quantum transport simulations）验证器件在无序和几何变化下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Intrinsic Nonreciprocity in Electron-Phonon Interaction Driven Thermoelectric Diodes
papers.abstract: We study an electron-phonon interaction driven thermoelectric diode. The nonreciprocity in this diode arises from the asymmetry between the probabilities of phonon emission and absorption in the electron-phonon interaction, as well as the structural reflection asymmetry. We reveal the intrinsic nature of this nonreciprocity, as the forward and backward electron transport remains asymmetric even when the applied temperature difference is not reversed. This intrinsic nonreciprocity gives rise to two novel transport phenomena. One is a novel thermoelectric effect which is driven by the temperature difference between the leads and the central device region, rather than the conventional temperature difference between the two leads. The second, and more significant, phenomenon is the suppression of electronic backscattering in the load resistor. This suppression decreases the resistance of the load resistor, which leads to the breakdown of Ohm's addition law. Under suitable conditions, the presence of electron-phonon interaction can yield a larger thermoelectric current compared to the case without it. This intrinsic nonreciprocity opens up a new pathway for low-power electronics besides topology and superconductivity, and for nonreciprocal thermoelectric devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We study”、“We reveal”等理论分析常用表述，并基于物理机制推导出新的输运现象，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：电子-声子相互作用驱动的热电二极管中的非互易输运现象。具体体系为包含中心器件区、两个电极（引线）以及负载电阻的电路模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了电子-声子相互作用中发射与吸收概率的不对称性，结合结构反射不对称性，可产生一种“本征非互易性”。该非互易性导致两种新现象：一种由引线与中心区温差驱动的新型热电效应，以及负载电阻中电子背散射被抑制，从而破坏欧姆加法法则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了电子-声子相互作用中发射与吸收概率的不对称性，结合结构反射不对称性，可产生一种“本征非互易性”。该非互易性导致两种新现象：一种由引线与中心区温差驱动的新型热电效应，以及负载电阻中电子背散射被抑制，从而破坏欧姆加法法则。；创新点：首次提出并论证了电子-声子相互作用本身即可作为热电二极管非互易性的内在来源，而非依赖外部磁场或拓扑保护。该非互易性在温差方向不反转时依然存在，并由此引出了对传统欧姆定律的修正，为低功耗电子学提供了除拓扑和超导之外的新路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。摘要未明确说明具体的理论框架（如是否使用非平衡格林函数、玻尔兹曼方程或主方程等），仅从概率不对称性和结构不对称性出发进行物理机制推导。

papers.title: Universal Information-Theoretic Structure of the Quasi-Stationary Domany--Kinzel Automaton
papers.abstract: We characterize the quasi-stationary distribution (QSD) of the bond directed-percolation line of the Domany--Kinzel automaton using a matrix-product-state representation of the probability distribution, obtained by projecting out the absorbing state and iterating the transfer matrix. Unlike moment- or sampling-based methods, this yields the full conditional distribution and direct access to information-theoretic diagnostics. The spatial structure of the QSD changes sharply across the transition: the active phase is bulk-like with finite density, whereas in the inactive phase the surviving activity collapses into a single flock occupying a vanishing fraction of the chain, with an internal filling that ranges from a single cluster deep in the inactive phase to a loose, partially filled group near criticality. This picture carries a sharp information-theoretic signature: throughout the inactive phase the bipartite mutual information of the QSD equals the entropy of a single binary choice -- whether the flock lies to the left or right of the cut -- so the surviving clusters together encode just one bit of positional information, corresponding to a single effective cluster. The approach extends matrix-product-state techniques to the projected eigenvector defining a QSD, opening information-theoretic diagnostics for absorbing-state systems that bulk-observable methods cannot reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：matrix-product-state representation、transfer matrix、information-theoretic diagnostics。；研究对象：Domany–Kinzel 自动机中键定向渗流线的准稳态分布（QSD）的信息论结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非活性相中，准稳态分布的双分互信息等于单个二元选择（即存活团簇位于分割线左侧或右侧）的熵，表明所有存活团簇共同编码仅1比特的位置信息，对应一个有效团簇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非活性相中，准稳态分布的双分互信息等于单个二元选择（即存活团簇位于分割线左侧或右侧）的熵，表明所有存活团簇共同编码仅1比特的位置信息，对应一个有效团簇。；创新点：将矩阵乘积态技术扩展到定义准稳态分布的投影本征向量，从而能够对吸收态系统进行传统体观测量方法无法触及的信息论诊断。
papers.method_zh: 采用矩阵乘积态（MPS）表示概率分布，通过投影出吸收态并迭代转移矩阵获得准稳态分布的全条件分布，从而直接计算信息论诊断量。

papers.title: Sonochemically Boosted Hydrogen Evolution Activity of Janus TMD Monolayers
papers.abstract: 2D electrocatalysts that enable hydrogen evolution at low overpotentials offer an attractive alternative to expensive platinum-based systems. Here, we report the growth of Janus transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers (MLs), SeMoS and SeWS, on Au foils using chemical vapor deposition, and systematically compare their catalytic properties in the context of hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) with those of their parent TMDs. The Janus MLs exhibited significantly enhanced catalytic performance relative to the parent TMDs. Furthermore, these MLs on Au foils were subjected to sonochemical treatment in polar and non-polar solvents, in which the treatment with polar solvents led to a substantial improvement in the HER activity of Janus MLs. In particular, SeMoS MLs treated with water showed a low overpotential of ~63 mV, a Tafel slope of ~42 mV/dec, and an exchange current density of ~10$^{-3}$ mA cm$^{- 2}$, approaching that of platinum. Analyses indicate that enhanced electrocatalytic activity is associated with tensile strain induced by Au surface restructuring and the formation of defects in Janus MLs, as shown by experimental observations and by density functional theory calculations. The enhancement in catalytic performance due to sonochemical treatment emphasizes the importance of our results for developing novel catalytic systems for HER based on Janus 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：growth, chemical vapor deposition, experimental observations, density functional theory calculations）；研究对象：Janus过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）单层（SeMoS和SeWS）在Au箔上的生长及其析氢反应（HER）催化性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Janus TMD单层相比其母体TMD表现出显著增强的HER催化活性；经极性溶剂超声处理后，SeMoS单层的HER性能接近铂，过电位低至~63 mV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Janus TMD单层相比其母体TMD表现出显著增强的HER催化活性；经极性溶剂超声处理后，SeMoS单层的HER性能接近铂，过电位低至~63 mV。；创新点：首次将超声化学处理应用于Janus TMD单层以提升HER活性，并揭示其增强机制与Au表面重构引起的拉伸应变及缺陷形成相关。
papers.method_zh: 化学气相沉积（CVD）生长Janus单层；超声化学处理（极性/非极性溶剂）；电化学HER性能测试；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；实验观测结合理论分析应变与缺陷效应。

papers.title: Modelling magnetic material properties with uncertainty-aware neural networks
papers.abstract: Machine learning is increasingly applied to accelerate the discovery of novel materials by exploring large compositional and structural design spaces. Yet, the scarcity of high-quality data and the frequent need for out-of-distribution prediction introduce substantial uncertainty, making the assessment of model reliability essential. In this work, we investigate uncertainty quantification as a means to evaluate model confidence in the context of permanent magnet research. In a first study, we benchmark classical and modern machine learning models for predicting intrinsic magnetic properties, focusing on the quality of their uncertainty estimates. We apply Gaussian negative log-likelihood loss and dropout-based Bayesian approximation as practical strategies for estimating predictive uncertainty. In a second study, we transfer these architectural features for uncertainty estimation to a more complex task: predicting coercivity from microstructural information using a graph neural network. Together, these studies demonstrate that uncertainty quantification not only enhances the trustworthiness of predictions but is also transferable across different modeling tasks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning、modelling、predicting、graph neural network。；研究对象：永磁材料（permanent magnet）的磁学性质，包括本征磁性质（intrinsic magnetic properties）和矫顽力（coercivity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不确定性量化（uncertainty quantification）不仅能提升机器学习预测的可靠性，而且其方法（如高斯负对数似然损失和基于丢弃法的贝叶斯近似）可迁移至不同建模任务（从本征性质预测到微结构-矫顽力预测）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不确定性量化（uncertainty quantification）不仅能提升机器学习预测的可靠性，而且其方法（如高斯负对数似然损失和基于丢弃法的贝叶斯近似）可迁移至不同建模任务（从本征性质预测到微结构-矫顽力预测）。；创新点：将不确定性量化系统性地引入永磁材料性质预测，并验证了其在不同建模任务（本征性质与微结构-矫顽力）间的可迁移性。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习方法：经典与现代机器学习模型用于本征磁性质预测；高斯负对数似然损失（Gaussian negative log-likelihood loss）和基于丢弃法的贝叶斯近似（dropout-based Bayesian approximation）用于估计预测不确定性；图神经网络（graph neural network）用于从微结构信息预测矫顽力。

papers.title: Ferroelectric Altermagnetic Chern Insulator in magnetic field: electrical control of the Chern number
papers.abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall effect in altermagnets is difficult to realize because spin-up and spin-down states remain degenerate at the $Γ$ point in the nonrelativistic limit. We start from the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model to incorporate nontrivial band topology. We demonstrate that the combined effects of an external magnetic field, spin canting, and ferroelectric orbital hybridization lift the degeneracy at the $Γ$ point, enabling electric-field control of the Chern number. A minimal two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic model with band inversion then realizes a ferroelectrically tunable Chern insulator with spontaneous spin canting. The ferroelectric polarization controls the topological phase and the orbital angular momentum, enabling a rich phase diagram with C = $\pm 1$ and C = $\pm 2$ through a Berry-curvature reorganization linked to the spin canting response and ferroelectricity. Our results establish a symmetry-consistent route to electrically tunable Chern insulating phases in altermagnetic materials, opening opportunities for low-power topological and orbitronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“We start from the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model”“A minimal two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic model”等理论模型构建与推导。；研究对象：铁电交替磁体中的陈绝缘体，具体研究在磁场作用下，通过自旋倾斜和铁电轨道杂化实现陈数电控的二维d波交替磁体体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在外部磁场、自旋倾斜和铁电轨道杂化的共同作用下，可解除交替磁体中Γ点自旋简并，实现陈数的电场调控，并得到陈数C=±1和C=±2的丰富拓扑相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在外部磁场、自旋倾斜和铁电轨道杂化的共同作用下，可解除交替磁体中Γ点自旋简并，实现陈数的电场调控，并得到陈数C=±1和C=±2的丰富拓扑相图。；创新点：提出了一种对称性一致的路径，在交替磁体材料中实现电可调的陈绝缘体相，并揭示了铁电极化对拓扑相和轨道角动量的控制机制，为低功耗拓扑与轨道电子器件提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang模型引入非平庸能带拓扑，构建最小二维d波交替磁体模型，通过分析贝里曲率重组、自旋倾斜响应与铁电性的耦合，研究拓扑相变。

papers.title: Pinned Boundaries Delay Contraction and Shape Stress Relaxation in Active Gels
papers.abstract: Cells dynamically generate, transmit, and dissipate stress. Central to these processes is the actomyosin cortex, an active contractile material that drives cellular mechanical behavior. While prior studies have focused on freely contracting actomyosin systems, the role of mechanical constraints such as adhesion to boundaries remains less explored. To address this, we employ reconstituted actomyosin gels to investigate cellular contractility. We study contraction dynamics under pinned boundary conditions, where the gel is adhered transversely to two opposing surfaces, mimicking supracellular actomyosin networks in tissues and embryos. We find that pinned contraction leads to stress buildup, delaying contraction, producing intermittent dynamics, and generating spatially nonuniform strain fields. Stress is relieved through several pathways, including active-stress-driven symmetric constriction and defect-driven processes such as boundary detachment and internal rupture. We develop a hydrodynamic model incorporating elastic, viscous, and active stress contributions that distinguishes between stress-accumulation and stress-release phases and links variations in active stress to the observed intermittent dynamics. The model predicts distinct energy relaxation rates before and after detachment events, providing insight into stress dissipation. We compare experiments with numerical simulations, which reproduce the observed behavior and reveal how internal energy is generated and dissipated during stress buildup and relaxation. Together, our results demonstrate how boundary conditions and spatial heterogeneity govern the mechanical behavior of contractile active gels. These findings provide insight into stress regulation in cellular and tissue-scale systems and may inform the design of adaptive soft materials and bioinspired robotic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要提到“employ reconstituted actomyosin gels”进行实验研究，同时“develop a hydrodynamic model”进行理论建模，并“compare experiments with numerical simulations”。；研究对象：主动收缩凝胶（actomyosin gels）在钉扎边界条件下的收缩动力学与应力松弛行为，模拟细胞及组织中的肌动蛋白皮层力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钉扎边界条件会导致应力积累，从而延迟收缩、产生间歇性动力学和空间非均匀应变场；应力通过对称收缩、边界脱离和内部断裂等多种途径释放。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钉扎边界条件会导致应力积累，从而延迟收缩、产生间歇性动力学和空间非均匀应变场；应力通过对称收缩、边界脱离和内部断裂等多种途径释放。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用重构的肌动球蛋白凝胶（reconstituted actomyosin gels），在钉扎边界条件下（凝胶横向粘附于两个相对表面）研究收缩动力学；理论上建立包含弹性、粘性和主动应力贡献的流体动力学模型，区分应力积累与应力释放阶段；并通过数值模拟复现实验行为，分析内能的产生与耗散。

papers.title: On the flash temperature in accelerated sliding contacts
papers.abstract: The temperature increase in the contact regions between solids in sliding contact can easily reach several hundred Kelvin and thereby dramatically affect friction and wear. Here I extend an earlier multiscale theory for the flash temperature (Ref. \cite{MP}) to the case of accelerated motion, and present numerical results illustrating the theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“extend an earlier multiscale theory”以及“present numerical results illustrating the theory”，表明工作核心是理论扩展和数值计算。；研究对象：加速滑动接触中的闪温（flash temperature）现象。具体指固体在滑动接触过程中，接触区域因摩擦产生的瞬时高温。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作将已有的多尺度闪温理论推广到了加速运动的情形，并通过数值结果展示了该理论在加速条件下的具体表现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作将已有的多尺度闪温理论推广到了加速运动的情形，并通过数值结果展示了该理论在加速条件下的具体表现。；创新点：将闪温理论从匀速滑动情形推广至加速滑动情形。摘要未明确说明此前理论是否完全无法处理加速情况，但明确指出这是对已有理论的扩展。
papers.method_zh: 多尺度理论扩展。作者基于一篇参考文献（Ref. \cite{MP}）中的多尺度闪温理论，将其适用范围从匀速滑动扩展到加速滑动，并进行了数值计算以验证和展示理论结果。

papers.title: Nonlinear Mechanics and Predictable Bifurcation of Multi-Cell Kresling Origami Chains
papers.abstract: Meta-structures that display axial-twist coupling can be achieved through the emerging kinematics in Kresling origami patterns. A central challenge in these structures is understanding their nonlinear mechanical behaviour, specifically their equilibrium branches and bifurcation diagrams. This involves identifying relationships between desired responses and the geometric variables that define the design space, including the Kresling polygon count, initial twist angle, height, radius, and crease lengths. As the number of constituent units increases in an n-layer chain, we track complex equilibrium branches extending into the post-critical regime under successive instabilities, including branch-point bifurcations and limit-point instabilities. This work begins by establishing the relationship between the geometric design variables and the response curves of the assembled chain by modelling the crease lines as axial-load-carrying elements. Subsequently, equilibrium branches and instabilities are systematically investigated via continuation and bifurcation analysis, beginning with the single-layer system and progressively extending to two- and three-layer configurations. Finally, a generalisation strategy is proposed to extend these findings to an n-layer Kresling chain. This strategy enables the predictive construction of equilibrium paths and the inverse design of multi-layer meta-structures, using prescribed critical points to control post-critical behaviour. It provides a foundation for the inverse design and optimisation of architected mechanical metamaterials with programmable responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。关键词：modelling、continuation and bifurcation analysis、generalisation strategy、inverse design。；研究对象：多单元Kresling折纸链（multi-cell Kresling origami chains）构成的超结构（meta-structures），具体研究其轴向-扭转耦合的非线性力学行为，包括平衡分支与分岔图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将折痕线建模为轴向承载元件，并系统分析单层到三层链的平衡分支与失稳，提出了一种可推广至n层Kresling链的策略，能够预测性地构建平衡路径并实现多层超结构的逆向设计，从而控制后临界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将折痕线建模为轴向承载元件，并系统分析单层到三层链的平衡分支与失稳，提出了一种可推广至n层Kresling链的策略，能够预测性地构建平衡路径并实现多层超结构的逆向设计，从而控制后临界行为。；创新点：提出了从单层到n层Kresling链的通用化策略，实现了平衡路径的预测性构建与多层超结构的逆向设计，为具有可编程响应的力学超材料提供了设计基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续与分岔分析（continuation and bifurcation analysis）方法，将折痕线建模为轴向承载元件（axial-load-carrying elements），从单层系统逐步扩展到两层、三层及n层构型，并基于指定临界点提出逆向设计策略。

papers.title: Mathematical Basis for Analyzing Superconducting Phase Transitions Using Catastrophe Theory
papers.abstract: We establish a rigorous mathematical bridge from quantum many-body path integrals to the cusp catastrophe model by Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction, which provides a theoretical foundation for analyzing superconducting phase transition using the catastrophe theory. First, it is proved that, near the critical point the infinite-dimensional effective action is diffeomorphic to a finite-dimensional catastrophe. Secondly, starting from Ginzburg-Landau free energy functional, the Euler-Lagrange partial differential equation can be reduced to the cusp catastrophe model. Thirdly, the fermionic imaginary-time path integral to the cusp catastrophe is derived through the Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation, Matsubara frequency expansion, and Grassmann algebra. Furthermore, we connect this framework with the adsorption potential theory we proposed, elucidating the catastrophic topological nature of the electron pairing mechanism in high-temperature superconductivity. The precise microscopic derivation of the adsorption potential from first-principles electronic structure calculations would strengthen the predictive power of the theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“证明”、“推导”、“建立数学桥梁”等关键词，核心工作为数学推导和理论框架构建，未提及任何实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：超导相变，特别是高温超导中的电子配对机制。论文旨在从数学上建立超导相变与突变论（特别是尖点突变模型）之间的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在临界点附近，量子多体系统的无穷维有效作用量可以微分同胚于一个有限维的突变模型；并且，从费米子虚时路径积分出发，通过一系列数学变换，可以严格推导出描述超导相变的尖点突变模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在临界点附近，量子多体系统的无穷维有效作用量可以微分同胚于一个有限维的突变模型；并且，从费米子虚时路径积分出发，通过一系列数学变换，可以严格推导出描述超导相变的尖点突变模型。；创新点：为使用突变论分析超导相变提供了严格的数学基础，特别是从量子多体路径积分出发，首次建立了到尖点突变模型的完整推导链条。摘要未突出说明与以往仅基于唯象Ginzburg-Landau理论使用突变论的工作相比，本工作的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 主要运用了严格的数学物理方法，包括：1）Lyapunov-Schmidt 约化（将无穷维问题约化到有限维）；2）Ginzburg-Landau 自由能泛函的 Euler-Lagrange 方程约化；3）Hubbard-Stratonovich 变换、Matsubara 频率展开和 Grassmann 代数（用于处理费米子路径积分）。此外，还联系了作者此前提出的“吸附势理论”。

papers.title: Shape-space dynamics and geometric pattern formation in nonreciprocal slender bodies
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions in active solids violate action-reaction symmetry and produce a net response to strain. Assuming invariance under Euclidean symmetries, we derive a shape-space formulation for the elastohydrodynamics of nonreciprocal slender bodies that separates intrinsic deformation from rigid motion. The resulting nonlinear reaction-advection-diffusion system represents a geometric flow whose activity-driven instabilities generate steady, oscillatory, and chaotic patterns. These manifest as rigid, swimming, and chaotic motion, linking nonreciprocal elastohydrodynamics to geometric pattern formation and unifying recent observations in slender active structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive a shape-space formulation”、“nonlinear reaction-advection-diffusion system”、“geometric flow”。；研究对象：非互易细长体（nonreciprocal slender bodies）的弹性流体动力学行为，具体涉及活性固体中因非互易相互作用导致的形变与运动模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易细长体的弹性流体动力学可被映射为一个形状空间中的几何流，其活性驱动的失稳可产生稳态、振荡和混沌图案，分别对应刚性运动、游动运动和混沌运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易细长体的弹性流体动力学可被映射为一个形状空间中的几何流，其活性驱动的失稳可产生稳态、振荡和混沌图案，分别对应刚性运动、游动运动和混沌运动。；创新点：将非互易弹性流体动力学与几何图案形成联系起来，统一了近期在细长活性结构中观察到的多种运动模式。
papers.method_zh: 基于欧几里得对称性不变性假设，推导了非互易细长体的形状空间弹性流体动力学方程，将内在形变与刚性运动分离，最终得到一个非线性反应-平流-扩散系统。

papers.title: Bulk-like Compressibility of the Au-Au Metallic Bond in the Atomically Precise $\mathrm{Au}_{25}$ Cluster
papers.abstract: We present a high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction study of the atomically precise $\mathrm{Au}_{25}(\mathrm{PET})_{18}^{q}$ cluster ($q=-1,0$) up to 10 GPa under strictly hydrostatic conditions. Our crystallographic analysis provides direct evidence for the pressure-induced phase transitions previously suggested by spectroscopic studies. Structural refinements reveal that the cluster accommodates compression through the reorganization of the flexible ligand shell and secondary distortions of the staple motifs, while the $\mathrm{Au}_{13}$ icosahedral core remains intact. Notably, the internal Au-Au distances exhibit a monotonic contraction that quantitatively mirrors the compressibility of bulk gold. This invariant rigidity at the sub-nanometer scale demonstrates that the fundamental stiffness of the metallic bond is preserved regardless of size. Our findings reconcile previous contradictions in the elasticity of metal nanostructures by isolating the intrinsic mechanical response of the gold kernel from extrinsic structural and experimental artifacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction study（高压单晶X射线衍射研究）、crystallographic analysis（晶体学分析）、structural refinements（结构精修）。；研究对象：原子精确的 Au₂₅(PET)₁₈^q 团簇（q = -1, 0），具体研究其在高压下金属键的压缩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Au₂₅团簇内部的Au-Au键距在高压下呈现单调收缩，其压缩性与块体金定量一致，表明亚纳米尺度下金属键的本征刚度与尺寸无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Au₂₅团簇内部的Au-Au键距在高压下呈现单调收缩，其压缩性与块体金定量一致，表明亚纳米尺度下金属键的本征刚度与尺寸无关。；创新点：通过直接晶体学证据，将金团簇内核的固有力学响应与配体壳层重组、钉书状结构变形等外在因素分离，解决了此前关于金属纳米结构弹性行为的研究矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 高压单晶X射线衍射实验，在严格静水压条件下（最高10 GPa）进行晶体结构解析与精修。

papers.title: Berry-phase-based Topological Charge in Quasicrystals and their Observable Features in Photonic System
papers.abstract: Topological charges based on Berry phase play the fundamental role in the topological physics. However, such topological charges remain unexplored in quasicrystals, impeding the systematic understanding of topological states in such quasiperiodic systems. In this work, by deriving all the allowed topological charges according to group representation theory and the corresponding low-energy effective Hamiltonians, we establish a universal framework for Berry-phase-based topological charges in two-dimensional quasicrystals. Taking the $C_{8v}$ quasicrystal as an example, we demonstrate and characterize a higher topological charge of $C=4$, which is inaccessible in conventional periodic systems. Applying our framework to photonic quasicrystals, we uncover that the circling of photon momentum around the charge gives a $C$ times winding of the electromagnetic field distribution pattern. Such observable feature provides a direct experimental method to probe the topological charges. Our work paves the way for exploring topological charges in quasiperiodic matter, and fundamentally bridges periodic and quasiperiodic topological band theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“根据群表示理论推导”、“建立通用框架”、“以光子准晶为例”等理论推导和框架构建关键词，未提及具体实验操作或数值计算。；研究对象：二维准晶中基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷，以及其在光子准晶体系中的可观测特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了二维准晶中基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷的通用理论框架，发现并表征了常规周期系统中无法实现的高阶拓扑电荷（C=4），并揭示了光子准晶中光子动量绕拓扑电荷旋转时电磁场分布模式会随之缠绕C圈的实验可观测特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了二维准晶中基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷的通用理论框架，发现并表征了常规周期系统中无法实现的高阶拓扑电荷（C=4），并揭示了光子准晶中光子动量绕拓扑电荷旋转时电磁场分布模式会随之缠绕C圈的实验可观测特征。；创新点：首次将基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷概念拓展到准晶体系，填补了准周期系统中拓扑电荷研究的空白，并建立了周期系统与准周期系统拓扑能带理论之间的基本桥梁。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 群表示理论推导所有允许的拓扑电荷及其对应的低能有效哈密顿量；以C₈ᵥ对称性准晶为例进行具体表征；将理论框架应用于光子准晶体系以预测可观测特征。

papers.title: A stochastic model for elastoplastic contact of rough surfaces incorporating scale-dependent hardness
papers.abstract: The stress concentrations caused by inherent roughness of natural and manufactured surfaces often induce plastic deformation at contact interfaces, a challenge compounded by competing influences of the size effect of plastic deformation and self-affine rough surface topography. To address this, we developed a novel methodology based on stochastic theory using compounded Chapman-Kolmogorov equations, for the first time, to solve elastoplastic contact problems involving scale-dependent hardness. Our approach formulates three integral equations describing the evolution of probability density functions of elastic contact pressure, relative plastic contact area, and relative non-contact area across geometrical scales. We thoroughly investigate the effects of scale-dependent hardness on contact pressure distribution, relative elastic and plastic contact areas, and the area-to-load relationship. By adjusting various mechanical and material properties, our model predicts a smooth transition from linear elasticity to elastic-plastic behavior and finally to full plasticity. A key advancement is the derivation of a new topographic yield parameter incorporating a wider range of material and geometrical properties, aiding identification of contact status. Numerical solutions enable highly precise determination of elastic and plastic limits via curve-fitting, and we also provide a new diagram for rapid identification of contact status. This study pioneers a stochastic process framework for applying the compounded Chapman-Kolmogorov equation to rough surface contact analysis, and the integral equations characterizing how interfacial properties evolve with scale could offer valuable insights for other multidisciplinary fields where multiscale roughness is critical, such as earthquakes, electrical contact, and contact electrification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic theory（随机理论）、compounded Chapman-Kolmogorov equations（复合Chapman-Kolmogorov方程）、numerical solutions（数值解）。；研究对象：粗糙表面在弹塑性接触中的力学行为，具体涉及尺度相关硬度（scale-dependent hardness）对接触压力分布、弹塑性接触面积及面积-载荷关系的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入尺度相关硬度，模型预测了从线弹性到弹塑性再到完全塑性的平滑过渡，并推导出一个新的地形屈服参数（topographic yield parameter），可用于快速识别接触状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入尺度相关硬度，模型预测了从线弹性到弹塑性再到完全塑性的平滑过渡，并推导出一个新的地形屈服参数（topographic yield parameter），可用于快速识别接触状态。；创新点：首次将复合Chapman-Kolmogorov方程应用于粗糙表面接触分析，建立了描述界面性质随尺度演化的积分方程框架，并提出了一个包含更广泛材料与几何性质的新地形屈服参数。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机理论，首次采用复合Chapman-Kolmogorov方程建立三个积分方程，描述弹性接触压力、相对塑性接触面积和相对非接触面积的概率密度函数随几何尺度的演化，并通过数值求解获得弹性和塑性极限。

papers.title: Spin-Orbit Torque and Magnetization Switching in 2D Ferromagnetic Devices
papers.abstract: Current-induced spin-orbit torque has emerged as a powerful technique for manipulating magnetization switching of ferromagnet/nonmagnet (FM/NM) based memory cell. By investigating nonequilibrium spin torque effect in a van der Waals heterobilayer, trigonal $\text{Cr}_{3}\text{Te}_{4}/\text{PtTe}_{2}$, the first-principles quantum transport calculations are applied to determine both local spin induction, resulting from Rashba-Edelstein effect in the FM layer, and spin current injection, flowing from the NM to the FM layer. Our work reveals that local spin induction significantly generates the fieldlike torque, which primarily governs the switching current in systems with strong in-plane magnetic anisotropy. Our work emphasizes the importance of optimizing spin Hall effect in the NM layer for perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA)-based magnetization switching and maximizing the Rashba effect in the FM layer for in-plane magnetic anisotropy (IMA)-based switching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles quantum transport calculations（第一性原理量子输运计算）。；研究对象：二维铁磁器件中的自旋轨道矩与磁化翻转，具体材料体系为范德华异质双层：三角晶格 Cr₃Te₄/PtTe₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有强面内磁各向异性的体系中，局域自旋感应（源于铁磁层中的Rashba-Edelstein效应）显著产生类场力矩，并主导翻转电流；对于垂直磁各向异性翻转，需优化非磁层的自旋霍尔效应；对于面内磁各向异性翻转，需最大化铁磁层的Rashba效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有强面内磁各向异性的体系中，局域自旋感应（源于铁磁层中的Rashba-Edelstein效应）显著产生类场力矩，并主导翻转电流；对于垂直磁各向异性翻转，需优化非磁层的自旋霍尔效应；对于面内磁各向异性翻转，需最大化铁磁层的Rashba效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理量子输运计算（first-principles quantum transport calculations），用于确定局域自旋感应和自旋电流注入。

papers.title: Ambient and Pressure Dependent Superconductivity with Hydrogen Storage Potential in Quaternary Hydride LiMgZr2H12: A Comprehensive First-principles Insights
papers.abstract: Molecular hydrides have attracted relatively less attention in the search for high Tc superconductors because their hydrogen quasi-molecular units tend to be electronically inactive for superconductivity. In contrast, hydrogen rich compounds under high pressure have been widely considered strong candidates for achieving room-temperature superconductivity. However, their dependence on extreme pressure conditions significantly constrains their practical applicability. This work investigates hydrogen-rich superconducting materials that may be stable under ambient pressure conditions. Motivated by recent studies on the MgZrH2n family, a LiMgZr2H12 structure with Pmmm symmetry was designed. The mechanical, thermodynamic, and dynamical stability of the compound, together with its electronic and optical properties, were systematically investigated using first-principles calculations. Li doping in LiMgZr2H12 significantly increases the hydrogen derived contribution near the Fermi level (EF) and strengthens the electron-phonon coupling constant (λ) compared with MgZrH6. LiMgZr2H12 exhibits a critical temperature of 72.76 K at ambient pressure, which is further enhanced by applying pressure. At 10 GPa the critical temperature increases to 77.3 K. Elastic property analysis shows that the material remains mechanically stable over the pressure range studied (0-10 GPa). It also behaves like a ductile material suitable for current carrying applications. The material has a high machinability index, which is much higher than that of stainless steels. In addition, LiMgZr2H12 exhibits a gravimetric hydrogen storage capacity of 5.36 wt%, indicating its potential as a promising candidate for hybrid hydrogen storage technologies. This work offers a new direction for designing high-Tc hydrides at ambient conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：四元氢化物LiMgZr₂H₁₂（Pmmm对称性结构），及其在常压和高压下的超导电性与储氢性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LiMgZr₂H₁₂在常压下具有72.76 K的超导临界温度，在10 GPa下提升至77.3 K，同时具备5.36 wt%的储氢容量，是一种兼具常压高温超导和储氢潜力的材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LiMgZr₂H₁₂在常压下具有72.76 K的超导临界温度，在10 GPa下提升至77.3 K，同时具备5.36 wt%的储氢容量，是一种兼具常压高温超导和储氢潜力的材料。；创新点：通过Li掺杂设计出常压稳定的四元氢化物LiMgZr₂H₁₂，克服了传统富氢超导体依赖极端高压的局限，并首次在该体系中同时实现较高Tc和储氢性能。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（DFT），系统研究了材料的力学、热力学、动力学稳定性，以及电子结构、光学性质、电子-声子耦合常数（λ）和超导临界温度（Tc）。

papers.title: Integrated magnonic neural circuits based on nonlinear wave neurons
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is driving intense interest in alternative computing hardware capable of neural information processing beyond conventional charge-based electronics. Among emerging approaches, wave-based computing promises highly parallel and energy-efficient operation, but scalable physical neural hardware has remained elusive because wave systems generally lack cascadable nonlinear neurons with signal regeneration and phase-robust operation. Here we demonstrate integrated magnonic neural circuits based on nonlinear threshold neurons realized in nanoscale yttrium iron garnet waveguides. The neurons perform weighted summation of multiple spin-wave inputs, while a pump-controlled nonlinear activation defines continuously tunable firing thresholds. Owing to deeply nonlinear spin-wave dynamics, the activated neurons emit self-normalized outputs whose intensities are largely independent of the input amplitudes, while nonlinear phase self-adjustment suppresses sensitivity to the relative input phases, enabling deterministic neuron-to-neuron cascading without external signal restoration. We experimentally realize programmable threshold neurons, reconfigurable weighted classification and deterministic cascading between sequential neuronal stages, and further demonstrate reconfigurable physical pattern recognition in a seven-neuron integrated magnonic circuit through experimental classification of the binary letter patterns 'HUST'. These results establish nonlinear magnons as a scalable platform for integrated neural hardware and position nonlinear wave dynamics as a general paradigm for physical neuromorphic computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally realize”“experimental classification”等实验实现和验证的关键词。；研究对象：基于非线性磁振子的集成神经电路，具体材料为纳米尺度的钇铁石榴石（YIG）波导，物理现象为非线性自旋波动力学及其在神经形态计算中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过泵浦控制的非线性激活函数，实现了可级联、相位鲁棒的磁振子神经元，并成功在七神经元集成磁振子电路中完成了对二进制字母图案“HUST”的可重构物理模式识别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过泵浦控制的非线性激活函数，实现了可级联、相位鲁棒的磁振子神经元，并成功在七神经元集成磁振子电路中完成了对二进制字母图案“HUST”的可重构物理模式识别。；创新点：首次在集成磁振子电路中实现了可级联的非线性阈值神经元，解决了波基计算系统中缺乏信号再生和相位鲁棒性的关键瓶颈，并展示了可编程的物理模式识别。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：纳米尺度钇铁石榴石波导制备、自旋波加权求和、泵浦控制非线性激活、神经元级联实验。未使用计算或理论框架，摘要未提及具体数值模拟或理论模型。

papers.title: Observation of coherently modulated phonon band and lifetime in superlattice
papers.abstract: Similar to the behavior of elementary particles, such as photons and electrons, the interference of phonon waves in artificial periodic nanostructures coherently modulates phonon band structures, serving as the foundation for phonon band engineering. However, direct observation of such coherently modulated phonon band structures remains challenging despite substantial insights from existing literature. Here, utilizing high-resolution inelastic X-ray scattering, we observed coherently modulated phonon band structures with phononic band gaps in a short-period GaAs/AlAs superlattice at 300 K and 500 K. Our findings provide the first direct evidence of phonon coherence at and above room temperatures, signifying a major advancement in the artificial engineering of phonon band structures. Furthermore, our experimental observations and ab initio lattice dynamics revealed that the coherently modulated phonon band structure enhances three-phonon scattering channels, strengthening high-order anharmonic effects such as three-phonon scattering and optical phonon softening. Our observations demonstrate the robustness of phonon coherence at high temperatures, and opens new routes for engineering phonon band structure and high-order phonon-phonon scattering by employing a flexible, bottom-up nanostructuring approach, with extensive applications in phononic metamaterials, microelectronics, and thermoelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：high-resolution inelastic X-ray scattering、experimental observations、ab initio lattice dynamics）；研究对象：短周期GaAs/AlAs超晶格中的相干调制声子能带结构及声子寿命。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在300 K和500 K下首次直接观测到短周期GaAs/AlAs超晶格中具有声子带隙的相干调制声子能带结构，证实了室温及以上温度下的声子相干性，并发现该调制增强了三声子散射通道及高阶非谐效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在300 K和500 K下首次直接观测到短周期GaAs/AlAs超晶格中具有声子带隙的相干调制声子能带结构，证实了室温及以上温度下的声子相干性，并发现该调制增强了三声子散射通道及高阶非谐效应。；创新点：首次在室温及以上温度直接观测到超晶格中相干调制的声子能带结构，为声子能带工程提供了直接实验证据，并揭示了相干调制对高阶声子-声子散射的增强作用。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率非弹性X射线散射实验，结合第一性原理晶格动力学计算。

papers.title: DSpinGNN: A Physics-Informed Equivariant Graph Neural Network for Dynamic Magnetic Exchange Prediction in Strain-Deformed Monolayer CrI$_3$
papers.abstract: Resolving the instantaneous, position-dependent isotropic magnetic exchange coupling $J_{ij}$ across a dynamically deforming crystal lattice requires a computational approach that simultaneously handles structural forces and magnetic interactions at length scales inaccessible to first-principles methods. Here we introduce DSpinGNN, a bifurcated machine-learning architecture comprising an $E(3)$-equivariant graph neural network (E-GNN) for classical Langevin structural dynamics and a physics-informed $Δ$-MLP that maps instantaneous local Cr-I-Cr bond geometry to isotropic exchange couplings, with the Goodenough-Kanamori superexchange relationship embedded as an analytical inductive bias. Trained on 345 DFT+U configurations of monolayer CrI$_3$ and evaluated on a strictly withheld 61-configuration test set, DSpinGNN simultaneously achieves an energy MAE of $1.1$ meV/atom, a force MAE of $6.5$ meV/Å, and an exchange coupling MAE of $0.18$ meV ($R^2 = 0.91$). Deployed at 400$\times$ scale in a 3,200-atom supercell under a collinear Ising-constrained adiabatic approximation at $5$ K, the model maps the local exchange response to a propagating biaxial strain wave. Wave reflection at periodic boundaries generates transient constructive interference regions where local compressive strain exceeds the DFT-established FM-to-AFM threshold, producing spatially heterogeneous exchange coupling textures that damp as the wave dissipates. Quantitative analysis yields a domain wall width of $ξ= 1.7 \pm 0.3$~nm and a constructive-interference oscillation period of $τ= 0.27$~ps -- mesoscopic observables inaccessible to direct DFT and constituting testable predictions for cryogenic magnetic force microscopy. DSpinGNN provides a reproducible, transferable framework for mesoscale exchange mapping in strain-driven 2D magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用DFT+U、机器学习（E(3)-equivariant图神经网络、Δ-MLP）、Langevin结构动力学等计算方法。；研究对象：单层CrI₃在动态应变变形下的各向同性磁交换耦合（Jᵢⱼ）的时空演化，以及由此产生的介观尺度磁织构（如畴壁、干涉振荡）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DSpinGNN模型成功将局域Cr-I-Cr键几何映射到交换耦合，并在3200原子超胞中模拟了双轴应变波传播，发现波在周期性边界反射时产生瞬态相长干涉区域，局域压缩应变超过DFT确定的铁磁-反铁磁阈值，形成空间异质交换耦合织构，畴壁宽度约1.7 nm，干涉振荡周期约0.27 ps。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DSpinGNN模型成功将局域Cr-I-Cr键几何映射到交换耦合，并在3200原子超胞中模拟了双轴应变波传播，发现波在周期性边界反射时产生瞬态相长干涉区域，局域压缩应变超过DFT确定的铁磁-反铁磁阈值，形成空间异质交换耦合织构，畴壁宽度约1.7 nm，干涉振荡周期约0.27 ps。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用E(3)-等变图神经网络（E-GNN）处理经典Langevin结构动力学，结合物理信息Δ-MLP（以Goodenough-Kanamori超交换关系为分析归纳偏置）映射局域键几何到交换耦合。训练数据为345个DFT+U构型，测试集为61个严格保留构型。在5 K下采用共线Ising约束绝热近似进行3200原子超胞模拟。

papers.title: Consistent Evaluation of Operators Involving the Position Operator in the Bloch Representation: Application to the Orbital Moment
papers.abstract: The position operator plays a central role in condensed-matter observables such as velocity, orbital moment, and electric polarization. In solid-state physics, the evaluation of operators incorporating the position operator has not reached a consensus, as observed in the operator-level discrepancy between the local circulation of Wannier functions and the self-rotation of wave packets. Here, to achieve a consistent evaluation of such operators, we propose three rules for evaluating operators involving the position operator in the Bloch representation. The rules are devised to satisfy physical conditions: independence from the choice of unit cell, preservation of Hermitian conjugacy for the product of operators, and recovery of the correct intraband velocity. We further address the gauge dependence of the position operator and introduce a scheme termed gauge filtration, which systematically removes gauge-dependent contributions from the operators containing the position operator. This methodology ensures that the quantities obtained from the operator evaluation correspond to observable physical phenomena. By applying our framework, we reconcile the results concerning the self-rotation of the wave packet and the local circulation of the Wannier function. We expect our proposal to establish a consistent framework for evaluating operators involving the position operator.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论的是理论框架的构建（“propose three rules”、“introduce a scheme termed gauge filtration”），旨在解决一个理论上的不一致性问题（“operator-level discrepancy”），没有提及任何实验或计算模拟的具体实施。；研究对象：凝聚态物理中涉及位置算符的物理量，具体以轨道磁矩（orbital moment）为例，并特别关注波包的自旋转（self-rotation of wave packets）和万尼尔函数的局域环流（local circulation of Wannier functions）这两个物理图像之间的不一致性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了三条规则和一种称为“规范过滤”（gauge filtration）的方案，能够一致地评估布洛赫表象中包含位置算符的算符，从而调和了波包自旋转与万尼尔函数局域环流这两个物理图像之间的矛盾。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了三条规则和一种称为“规范过滤”（gauge filtration）的方案，能够一致地评估布洛赫表象中包含位置算符的算符，从而调和了波包自旋转与万尼尔函数局域环流这两个物理图像之间的矛盾。；创新点：提出了一套自洽的、基于物理条件（如单胞选择无关性、厄米共轭性、正确带内速度）的规则，并引入“规范过滤”方案，从根本上解决了长期以来在布洛赫表象中处理位置算符时存在的歧义和矛盾，为相关物理量的计算提供了统一的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。具体包括：1. 提出了三条评估布洛赫表象中包含位置算符的算符的规则（满足与单胞选择无关、保持算符乘积的厄米共轭性、恢复正确的带内速度）。2. 引入了一种称为“规范过滤”的方案，系统性地移除包含位置算符的算符中的规范依赖贡献。

papers.title: A quantitative approach to flowing supercooled liquids: From microscopic heterogeneities to rheology
papers.abstract: Soft glassy materials display rich and complex flow behaviors across both macroscopic and molecular scales, and a fundamental understanding of these phenomena remains an outstanding challenge. Here, we propose a theoretical model for the flow of supercooled liquids -- a typical class of glassy fluids -- based on a two-state paradigm that conceptualizes the flow as a dynamic coexistence of transient solid-like and liquid-like regions. The model rests on two essential physical ingredients: a correlation length that captures medium-range structural order, and a localized elasticity-mediated interaction that restricts stress propagation within solid-like regions. Remarkably, with all parameters determined solely from equilibrium state, the model quantitatively reproduces rheological responses -- including both steady-state and start-up shear -- for a broad range of shear rates. Furthermore, it simultaneously captures the evolution of molecular dynamic heterogeneity. This dual success -- spanning macroscopic rheology and microscopic spatiotemporal fluctuations -- underscores the pivotal role of structural and dynamic heterogeneities in governing the rheological response. Moreover, it provides a direct understanding of how the flow behaviors of a supercooled liquid are embedded in its equilibrium properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical model”、“two-state paradigm”、“quantitatively reproduces”。；研究对象：过冷液体（supercooled liquids）的流动行为，属于软玻璃态材料（soft glassy materials）的一类，重点关注其流变学（rheology）与微观动态异质性（dynamic heterogeneity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论模型仅利用平衡态参数，即可定量复现过冷液体在宽剪切速率范围内的稳态和启动剪切流变响应，同时捕捉分子动态异质性的演化，表明流动行为内嵌于平衡态性质中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该理论模型仅利用平衡态参数，即可定量复现过冷液体在宽剪切速率范围内的稳态和启动剪切流变响应，同时捕捉分子动态异质性的演化，表明流动行为内嵌于平衡态性质中。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于两态范式（two-state paradigm）的理论模型，引入两个关键物理要素：表征中程结构有序的相关长度（correlation length），以及限制应力在类固态区域内传播的局域弹性介导相互作用（localized elasticity-mediated interaction）。所有参数均由平衡态确定。

papers.title: Unveiling Orbital-mediated Ultrafast Demagnetization in Rare Earth-Transition-Metal Ferrimagnets
papers.abstract: The ultimate speed limit of magnetic recording and spintronic devices is set by the efficiency of angular-momentum transfer during ultrafast demagnetization, yet its microscopic pathway in Rare-Earth-Transition-Metal (RE-TM) ferrimagnets remains debated. Here, we establish an orbital-mediated framework in which 3d spin-orbit coupling (SOC) governs angular momentum (AM) dissipation. Strong 3d-SOC in RE-Co enables sub-picosecond, single-step demagnetization via direct orbital-to-lattice transfer, whereas weak 3d-SOC in RE-Fe redirects AM into 4f orbitals, producing slower two-step dynamics. The second-stage rate scales with 4f-SOC strength, revealing a distinct orbital-mediated dissipation channel. Using time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr measurements, supported by an extended four-temperature model, corroborate this picture across diverse RE-TM systems (RE = Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho and TM = Fe, Co, CoNi). Our results identify the SOC-driven competition between 3d and 4f orbital channels as the universal mechanism governing ultrafast demagnetization in RE-TM ferrimagnets, enabling rational design of the switching speed for next-generation spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论模型）。判断依据：使用了“time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr measurements”（时间分辨磁光克尔测量）作为主要实验手段，并“supported by an extended four-temperature model”（辅以扩展的四温度模型）进行理论支持。；研究对象：稀土-过渡金属（RE-TM）亚铁磁体中的超快退磁过程。具体材料体系包括：RE = Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho 和 TM = Fe, Co, CoNi。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了轨道介导的超快退磁框架，指出3d自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的强弱决定了RE-TM亚铁磁体中的角动量耗散路径和退磁动力学：强3d-SOC（如RE-Co）导致亚皮秒单步退磁，而弱3d-SOC（如RE-Fe）则导致较慢的两步退磁，其中第二步速率由4f-SOC强度决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了轨道介导的超快退磁框架，指出3d自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的强弱决定了RE-TM亚铁磁体中的角动量耗散路径和退磁动力学：强3d-SOC（如RE-Co）导致亚皮秒单步退磁，而弱3d-SOC（如RE-Fe）则导致较慢的两步退磁，其中第二步速率由4f-SOC强度决定。；创新点：提出了一个普适的轨道介导机制，将3d和4f轨道通道之间的SOC竞争确立为控制RE-TM亚铁磁体超快退磁速度的通用物理机制，从而为设计下一代自旋电子器件的开关速度提供了理性设计依据。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用时间分辨磁光克尔效应（TR-MOKE）测量超快退磁动力学；理论上使用扩展的四温度模型（extended four-temperature model）对实验结果进行拟合和解释。

papers.title: Chiral Magnons and Cycloidal Phonons in Altermagnetic CuF$_{2}$ Monolayer
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism establishes momentum-dependent spin splitting through non-symmorphic crystal symmetries, yet whether these same symmetries simultaneously govern spin and lattice collective excitations remains open. Here we show, using first-principles calculations and linear spin-wave theory, that monolayer CuF$_2$ hosts both chirality-split magnons and cycloidal phonons controlled by the same $P2_1/c$ symmetry operations. The altermagnetic order drives strongly anisotropic magnon chirality via symmetric anisotropic exchange, with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions acting as a weak secondary modulation. Crucially, the phonon and magnon chiral responses are directionally complementary: cycloidal phonon angular momentum emerges precisely where magnon chirality is symmetry-suppressed, and vice versa. The magnon bands further carry quantized Chern numbers $C^M = \pm 2$, confirming non-trivial altermagnetic topology. These results establish monolayer CuF$_2$ as a platform where a single symmetry framework engineers magnonic, phononic, and topological responses, providing a direct connection between altermagnetism and spin-lattice chirality in two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、linear spin-wave theory（线性自旋波理论）。；研究对象：单层CuF₂中的交错磁序（altermagnetism）及其驱动的自旋和晶格集体激发，具体包括手性磁振子（chiral magnons）和摆线声子（cycloidal phonons）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单层CuF₂中，相同的P2₁/c对称性操作同时控制了手性分裂的磁振子和摆线声子，且磁振子与声子的手性响应在方向上互补；磁振子能带携带非平凡的陈数C^M = ±2，证实了交错磁拓扑性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单层CuF₂中，相同的P2₁/c对称性操作同时控制了手性分裂的磁振子和摆线声子，且磁振子与声子的手性响应在方向上互补；磁振子能带携带非平凡的陈数C^M = ±2，证实了交错磁拓扑性质。；创新点：首次证明在交错磁体系中，同一非点式对称性框架可同时调控磁振子、声子和拓扑响应，并揭示了磁振子手性与声子角动量在方向上的互补关系，建立了交错磁性与自旋-晶格手性之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合线性自旋波理论（linear spin-wave theory）。

papers.title: Polarization-Resolved Photon Statistics of Cavity Quantum Materials
papers.abstract: By forming hybrid light-matter states, optical cavities offer a route for engineering material properties, however, unambiguously probing the effects of light-matter coupling remains difficult. Here, we show that the polarization-resolved statistics of photons transmitted through a cavity, measurable via $g^{(2)}$, provide one such diagnostic. By relating $g^{(2)}$ to matter correlation functions such as the Raman structure factor, we link photon bunching and antibunching to material properties. By applying this method to the stripy-to-antiferromagnetic transition in the Kitaev-Heisenberg spin model, we find that polarization-dependent patterns of bunching and antibunching encode the magnetic point-group symmetries of each phase and characterize the behavior at the phase boundary. Finally, we predict measuring $g^{(2)}$ for output photon pairs polarized orthogonal to the input field will isolate higher-order light-matter scattering processes that probe higher-order material correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“we link”“we find”“we predict”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：腔量子材料（cavity quantum materials）中光与物质耦合形成的杂化态，以及通过腔透射光子的偏振分辨统计特性来探测材料性质，具体应用于Kitaev-Heisenberg自旋模型中的条状反铁磁相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量腔透射光子的二阶关联函数 \( g^{(2)} \) 的偏振分辨统计，可以区分不同磁相的点群对称性，并表征相边界行为；正交偏振光子对的 \( g^{(2)} \) 能隔离高阶光-物质散射过程，从而探测高阶物质关联函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量腔透射光子的二阶关联函数 \( g^{(2)} \) 的偏振分辨统计，可以区分不同磁相的点群对称性，并表征相边界行为；正交偏振光子对的 \( g^{(2)} \) 能隔离高阶光-物质散射过程，从而探测高阶物质关联函数。；创新点：提出利用偏振分辨的光子统计（\( g^{(2)} \)）作为诊断光-物质耦合效应的新方法，特别是通过正交偏振光子对测量来提取高阶物质关联信息。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：将光子统计量 \( g^{(2)} \) 与物质关联函数（如拉曼结构因子）建立联系，并应用于Kitaev-Heisenberg自旋模型的相变分析。

papers.title: Invariants of Sequential Circuits and Generalized Non-Abelian Statistics
papers.abstract: Non-invertible symmetries in quantum many-body systems generally give rise to sequential unitary circuits that move symmetry defects. In this paper, we investigate invariants defined by sequences of such circuits, which move non-invertible defects and generate a Berry phase evaluated on quantum states with defects. We show that this Berry phase generally defines an invariant under local deformations, provided that the sequential circuits preserve the locality of those deformations. This invariant also rules out a short-range-entangled state that preserves the non-invertible symmetry, thereby signaling the 't Hooft anomaly of a non-invertible symmetry purely in terms of unitary operators acting on a state. We then apply this framework to loop excitations in three spatial dimensions and identify a new loop excitation in the (3+1)D $\mathbb{D}_4$ topological order, which we dub a non-Abelian fermionic loop. Using the invariant of sequential circuits, we characterize the statistics of non-Abelian fermionic loops. In addition, we find a new (3+1)D mixed topological order with a single non-Abelian fermionic loop, whose long-range entanglement is protected by an invariant of sequential circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-invertible symmetries, invariants, Berry phase, topological order。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的非可逆对称性、顺序幺正电路、以及(3+1)维拓扑序中的环激发（loop excitations），特别是$\mathbb{D}_4$拓扑序中的非阿贝尔费米子环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现顺序幺正电路定义的Berry相位在局域形变下是一个不变量，该不变量可用于刻画非可逆对称性的’t Hooft反常，并识别出(3+1)维$\mathbb{D}_4$拓扑序中一种新的非阿贝尔费米子环激发，其统计性质可由该不变量表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现顺序幺正电路定义的Berry相位在局域形变下是一个不变量，该不变量可用于刻画非可逆对称性的’t Hooft反常，并识别出(3+1)维$\mathbb{D}_4$拓扑序中一种新的非阿贝尔费米子环激发，其统计性质可由该不变量表征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：利用顺序幺正电路移动非可逆缺陷并计算Berry相位，通过该相位定义局域形变下的不变量；将该不变量应用于(3+1)维拓扑序中的环激发，分析其统计性质。

papers.title: Unveiling the Interplay of Charge and Magnetic Excitations in HgBa$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{8+δ}$
papers.abstract: Unraveling the mechanism that binds electrons into Cooper pairs in cuprate high-temperature superconductors remains one of the most fundamental challenges in condensed-matter physics. While both magnetic interactions and lattice vibrations are known to govern key electronic properties, their possible cooperation has never been directly observed. We investigate HgBa$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{8+δ}$ (Hg1223) - the cuprate with the highest $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ at ambient pressure - as a magnifying glass to probe the possible entwining of the excitations at the core of the pairing. Using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering, we find that the charge response is dominated by dynamic charge density fluctuations (CDF) extending up to several hundred meV, where magnetic excitations reside. At the same momentum where CDF are most intense, the paramagnon energy exhibits a pronounced softening, revealing a strong interplay among charge, lattice, and spin excitations. Our results point to a cooperative mechanism in which dynamic charge fluctuations mediate the coupling between lattice, charge and spin degrees of freedom-shedding new light on the fundamental origin of high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：resonant inelastic X-ray scattering（共振非弹性X射线散射）。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体 HgBa₂Ca₂Cu₃O₈₊δ（Hg1223），即常压下临界温度最高的铜氧化物超导材料，以及其中电荷、晶格和自旋激发的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Hg1223中，电荷响应由动态电荷密度涨落主导，其能量范围延伸至数百meV，与磁激发能量区间重叠；在电荷涨落最强的动量位置，磁振子能量出现显著软化，表明电荷、晶格和自旋激发之间存在强耦合，暗示动态电荷涨落可能作为媒介耦合了晶格、电荷和自旋自由度，为高温超导配对机制提供新视角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Hg1223中，电荷响应由动态电荷密度涨落主导，其能量范围延伸至数百meV，与磁激发能量区间重叠；在电荷涨落最强的动量位置，磁振子能量出现显著软化，表明电荷、晶格和自旋激发之间存在强耦合，暗示动态电荷涨落可能作为媒介耦合了晶格、电荷和自旋自由度，为高温超导配对机制提供新视角。；创新点：首次直接观测到铜氧化物超导体中电荷、晶格和自旋激发之间的协同相互作用，揭示了动态电荷密度涨落可能作为耦合这些自由度的关键媒介。
papers.method_zh: 共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）。

papers.title: Superconductivity near quarter- and half-filling of a strongly correlated triangular Hubbard band in twisted trilayer WSe2
papers.abstract: The triangular-lattice Hubbard model is one of the paradigmatic settings for studying correlated electronic systems with geometric frustration that can give rise to a variety of phases. Recently, twisted bilayer TMD systems have emerged as attractive experimental platforms for realising such a model in the moderate-correlation regime. Alternating twisted trilayer TMD systems are expected to realise stronger correlations than bilayer systems owing to their mirror symmetry. Here we report the discovery of superconductivity near quarter- and half-filling, together with various correlated phases, in alternating twisted trilayer WSe2 (TTWSe2). At half filling, a robust correlated insulating state persists over a broad range of displacement fields, signalling the strongly correlated regime. Upon doping, superconductivity emerges over an extended region of the phase diagram. Near quarter filling, another superconducting state appears flanked by correlated metals. Our results establish the TTWSe2 system as a compelling platform for studying strongly correlated triangular-lattice Hubbard physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：discovery of superconductivity, report, experimental platforms, results establish。；研究对象：交替扭曲三层WSe2（alternating twisted trilayer WSe2, TTWSe2）中的强关联三角晶格哈伯德模型物理，具体关注四分之一填充和半填充附近的超导电性及相关关联相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在TTWSe2中，于半填充和四分之一填充附近均发现了超导电性，并在半填充处观测到强关联绝缘态，表明该体系是实现强关联三角晶格哈伯德物理的可靠平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在TTWSe2中，于半填充和四分之一填充附近均发现了超导电性，并在半填充处观测到强关联绝缘态，表明该体系是实现强关联三角晶格哈伯德物理的可靠平台。；创新点：相较于扭曲双层TMD体系，交替扭曲三层WSe2因镜面对称性可实现更强的关联效应，并在半填充和四分之一填充两个不同填充区域同时观测到超导电性，扩展了三角晶格哈伯德模型的实验研究范围。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建交替扭曲三层WSe2异质结，施加位移场调控，测量不同填充下的输运性质（如电阻、相图），从而识别超导态和关联绝缘态。

papers.title: Nucleation instability preempts relativistic domain wall transport in high-exchange ferrimagnetic nanowires
papers.abstract: Current-driven domain wall motion in ferrimagnets can approach the spin-wave velocity, giving rise to relativistic-like dynamics. While this regime has been experimentally observed in crystalline ferrimagnetic garnets and amorphous GdFeCo, the material conditions that determine whether it can be accessed remain unresolved. Here, we investigate spin-orbit-torque-driven domain wall motion in high-exchange GdCo nanowires using magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy. We find that nucleation preempts relativistic transport. In GdCo, no velocity saturation or high-field collapse is observed. Instead, the large exchange interaction raises the maximum spin-wave group velocity to $\approx 7\text{--}9~\mathrm{km/s}$, far above the experimentally accessible domain wall velocities. Before this limit can be approached, increasing current density and in-plane magnetic field induce domain nucleation, disrupting steady-state propagation. We map the boundary separating domain wall transport from nucleation instability and show that the nucleation threshold decreases with pulse duration, consistent with thermally assisted barrier crossing. These results identify nucleation as the mechanism that prevents access to the relativistic regime in high-exchange ferrimagnets and establish a dynamical phase boundary between steady propagation and nucleation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy（磁光克尔效应显微镜）、experimentally observed、investigate。；研究对象：高交换耦合的GdCo铁磁纳米线中的电流驱动畴壁运动，具体关注自旋轨道矩驱动的畴壁动力学及其与相对论性输运的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高交换耦合铁磁体GdCo中，畴壁运动无法进入相对论性速度区域，因为高电流密度和面内磁场会提前引发畴核生成（nucleation），破坏稳态传播，从而阻止相对论性输运的实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高交换耦合铁磁体GdCo中，畴壁运动无法进入相对论性速度区域，因为高电流密度和面内磁场会提前引发畴核生成（nucleation），破坏稳态传播，从而阻止相对论性输运的实现。；创新点：首次明确指出在高交换耦合铁磁体中，畴核生成（而非速度饱和或高场崩塌）是阻碍畴壁进入相对论性动力学区域的关键机制，并建立了稳态传播与畴核生成之间的动力学相边界。
papers.method_zh: 使用磁光克尔效应显微镜（magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy）观测自旋轨道矩驱动的畴壁运动，并系统测量不同脉冲持续时间下的畴核生成阈值，结合热辅助势垒跨越模型分析。

papers.title: Synthetic Altermagnetism Beyond the Crystal Limit
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic magnons in crystalline materials exhibit momentum-dependent splitting whose nodal structure and chiral character are governed by the point-group symmetry of the magnetic sublattice rotation. Here, we demonstrate the first synthetic realization of altermagnetic magnonics in a continuum platform composed of antiferromagnetically coupled ferromagnetic films with alternating in-plane exchange anisotropies, showing that the key signatures of altermagnetic magnonics emerge beyond the crystalline setting. Solving the linearized Landau-Lifshitz equation within a dipole-exchange framework, we show that this architecture reproduces the characteristic momentum-dependent splitting, nodal directions, and anisotropic isofrequency contours of A-type altermagnets. Long-range dipolar interactions qualitatively reconstruct this exchange-driven spectrum by lifting the nominal nodal degeneracy, hybridizing opposite-chirality modes, and producing a finite, thickness-dependent wave-vector splitting along directions that are nodal in the exchange-only limit. Extending the bilayer to finite multilayers reveals that synthetic altermagnetism undergoes a parity-dependent reconstruction that separates surface and bulk altermagnetic excitations. These results establish altermagnetic magnon phenomenology as an engineerable collective response of dipole-exchange multilayers beyond microscopic crystal symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、solving the linearized Landau-Lifshitz equation、dipole-exchange framework。；研究对象：人工合成交变磁（altermagnetic）自旋波（magnon）的连续介质平台，具体由反铁磁耦合的铁磁薄膜交替排列构成，并具有交替的面内交换各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非晶态连续介质中首次实现了交变磁自旋波的人工合成，其动量依赖的劈裂、节点方向和等频轮廓与A型交变磁体一致；长程偶极相互作用会重构交换驱动的能谱，且多层结构中的交变磁效应呈现宇称依赖的重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非晶态连续介质中首次实现了交变磁自旋波的人工合成，其动量依赖的劈裂、节点方向和等频轮廓与A型交变磁体一致；长程偶极相互作用会重构交换驱动的能谱，且多层结构中的交变磁效应呈现宇称依赖的重构。；创新点：将交变磁自旋波现象从晶体材料拓展至非晶态连续介质平台，证明其可作为偶极-交换多层膜的工程化集体响应，突破了微观晶体对称性的限制。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性化的Landau-Lifshitz方程，在偶极-交换框架（dipole-exchange framework）下进行理论求解与分析。

papers.title: Screening of the Coulomb interaction in Carbon Nanotubes: A First-Principles cRPA study
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic screening of long-range Coulomb interactions in carbon nanotubes with different chiralities using first-principles calculations within the random-phase approximation. Depending on their wrapping vector, carbon nanotubes exhibit either metallic or semiconducting behavior, providing an ideal platform to explore how reduced dimensionality and electronic structure govern screening in one-dimensional systems. The strength of on-site Coulomb interactions in these compounds falls within the range of 3.5 to 5 eV, which is approximately 2-3 eV smaller than the corresponding values in nanoribbon compounds. This reduction subsequently affects the value of long-range interactions, consistent with experimental results regarding the smaller binding energy of excitons in nanotubes. Despite their common carbon backbone, we find that the effective interaction landscape depends not only on metallicity but also sensitively on chirality and band topology. In particular, armchair and zigzag nanotubes with similar electronic character exhibit markedly different screening efficiencies. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of electronic screening in carbon nanotubes and place them in direct context with previous first-principles studies of low-dimensional carbon nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“random-phase approximation”（随机相位近似）。；研究对象：不同手性（chirality）的碳纳米管（Carbon Nanotubes），具体研究其长程库仑相互作用的电子屏蔽效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碳纳米管中在位库仑相互作用的强度（3.5-5 eV）比纳米带化合物小约2-3 eV，这导致其长程相互作用减弱，与实验中纳米管激子结合能较小的结果一致。此外，有效相互作用的强弱不仅取决于金属性，还对手性和能带拓扑结构敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碳纳米管中在位库仑相互作用的强度（3.5-5 eV）比纳米带化合物小约2-3 eV，这导致其长程相互作用减弱，与实验中纳米管激子结合能较小的结果一致。此外，有效相互作用的强弱不仅取决于金属性，还对手性和能带拓扑结构敏感。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作通过统一的计算框架，系统比较了不同手性碳纳米管中的电子屏蔽，并将其与之前低维碳纳米结构的第一性原理研究建立了直接联系，揭示了手性和能带拓扑对屏蔽效率的敏感依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于随机相位近似（RPA）的第一性原理计算，具体为约束性随机相位近似（cRPA）方法。

papers.title: Extrinsic quantum geometry in the quadrupolar bulk photovoltaic effect
papers.abstract: The bulk photovoltaic effect has become a valuable probe of the quantum geometry of Bloch bands. While it is restricted to inversion-broken systems within the dipole approximation, the finite momentum of light is appreciated to give rise to this effect even in centrosymmetric crystals, an effect referred to as "photon drag." In this work, we recast the photon drag effect at leading order in the optical wavevector, highlighting a previously neglected contribution arising intuitively from the electric quadrupole correction to light-matter coupling. In the language of band geometry, we identify this interband quadrupole as a multiband metric tensor that quantifies the variation of two resonantly driven states extrinsic to the subspace they span. We predict that systems in which three or more bands strongly admix in momentum space, such as twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayers, will have anomalously large photon drag due to this quadrupolar effect. Our work provides a conceptual bridge between band-geometric organizing principles and electromagnetic multipole corrections in nonlinear optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“recast”“identify”“predict”，以及理论框架“band geometry”“multiband metric tensor”。；研究对象：体光伏效应中的光子拖曳效应（photon drag effect），特别是由电四极修正（electric quadrupole correction）导致的非本征量子几何（extrinsic quantum geometry）贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光学波矢的一阶近似下，光子拖曳效应中存在一个此前被忽略的贡献，该贡献源于光-物质耦合的电四极修正，可被理解为一种多能带度规张量，描述共振驱动态在其子空间之外的几何变化。具有三个或更多能带在动量空间强混合的系统（如扭曲MoTe₂双层）将因该四极效应产生异常大的光子拖曳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光学波矢的一阶近似下，光子拖曳效应中存在一个此前被忽略的贡献，该贡献源于光-物质耦合的电四极修正，可被理解为一种多能带度规张量，描述共振驱动态在其子空间之外的几何变化。具有三个或更多能带在动量空间强混合的系统（如扭曲MoTe₂双层）将因该四极效应产生异常大的光子拖曳。；创新点：首次将光子拖曳效应中的电四极贡献与带几何中的多能带度规张量联系起来，揭示了非本征量子几何在非线性光学中的新角色，为带几何组织原理与电磁多极修正之间建立了概念桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 采用带几何（band geometry）理论语言，对光子拖曳效应在光学波矢一阶展开下进行重新表述，识别出电四极修正对应的多能带度规张量，并基于能带混合强度进行预测。

papers.title: Dynamics of repeated BEC formation and extraction in dimple traps
papers.abstract: We investigate repeated Bose-Einstein-condensate (BEC) formation and extraction in a dimple trap embedded in a reservoir of thermal atoms using a kinetic model. The model includes pulsed extraction, evaporation, three-body losses, and thermal-atom replenishment. Three extraction protocols are compared: extraction of all atoms from the dimple (BEC and thermal atoms), full and partial extractions of the BEC, but not of the thermal atoms. Residual atoms in the dimple after extraction seed subsequent Bose-stimulated growth and reduce the recovery time between extractions, but also enhance density-dependent losses. For all protocols, repeated extraction of BECs can be achieved without replenishment, but the number of BEC formations is limited by reservoir depletion and heating. With continuous replenishment, the system can reach a periodic steady-state regime, after an initial transient period, controlled by the externally imposed rates of extraction pulses and thermal-atom input. Within the explored parameter range, partial BEC extraction gives the highest efficiency, particularly for short extraction periods and high input rates. These results identify seeding by residual populations of BECs and thermal atoms as a kinetic mechanism for improving repeated condensate production in dimple traps.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用“kinetic model”（动力学模型）进行研究，并比较了不同的提取方案，属于理论建模与计算分析。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是“dimple trap”（凹阱）中的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的重复形成与提取动力学。该凹阱嵌入在一个热原子库中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在凹阱中，通过部分提取BEC（而非全部提取）并利用残余原子作为“种子”来促进后续的玻色子刺激增长，可以在不补充原子或连续补充原子的情况下，实现最高效率的重复BEC提取，尤其是在短提取周期和高输入速率条件下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在凹阱中，通过部分提取BEC（而非全部提取）并利用残余原子作为“种子”来促进后续的玻色子刺激增长，可以在不补充原子或连续补充原子的情况下，实现最高效率的重复BEC提取，尤其是在短提取周期和高输入速率条件下。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点可能在于系统地比较了不同提取协议（特别是部分BEC提取）对重复BEC形成效率的影响，并揭示了残余BEC和热原子作为“种子”在缩短恢复时间和提高效率中的关键动力学机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用了一个动力学模型，该模型包含了脉冲提取、蒸发、三体损失以及热原子补充等物理过程。通过比较三种不同的提取协议（提取凹阱中所有原子、仅提取全部BEC、仅提取部分BEC）来研究系统的行为。

papers.title: Topological Phase Transition in Mechanical Honeycomb Lattice
papers.abstract: Topological materials provide a new tool to direct wave energy with unprecedented precision and robustness. Three elastic topological phases, the valley Hall, Chern and spin Hall insulators, are currently studied, and they are achieved separately in rather distinct configurations. Here, we explore analytically various topological phase transitions for in-plane elastic wave in a unified mass-spring honeycomb lattice. It is demonstrated that the three elastic topological phases can be realized in this single lattice by designing mass, stiffness or introducing Coriolis' effect. In particular, the interface between valley Hall and Chern insulators is found to support topological interface mode for the first time. Perturbation method is used to derive the analytic effective continuum model in the neighbor of band degeneracy, and the physics in topological phase transitions are revealed through evaluation of topological invariants. The topologically protected interface states, their decaying profile as well as the pseudo-spin-indicating polarization specific for elastic wave are systematically analyzed, and these results are further confirmed numerically by Bloch wave analysis of domain wall strip and transient simulation of finite sized sample. This study offers a concise and unified analytical model to explore topology nature of elastic wave, and can provide intuitive guidance to design of continuum mechanical topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically explore”“perturbation method”“analytic effective continuum model”“numerically confirmed by Bloch wave analysis and transient simulation”。；研究对象：机械蜂巢晶格中面内弹性波的拓扑相变，具体研究谷霍尔、陈绝缘体、自旋霍尔绝缘体三种弹性拓扑相在同一晶格中的实现与转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计质量、刚度或引入科里奥利效应，可在单一质量-弹簧蜂巢晶格中实现三种弹性拓扑相；首次发现谷霍尔绝缘体与陈绝缘体之间的界面支持拓扑界面模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计质量、刚度或引入科里奥利效应，可在单一质量-弹簧蜂巢晶格中实现三种弹性拓扑相；首次发现谷霍尔绝缘体与陈绝缘体之间的界面支持拓扑界面模式。；创新点：在统一的质量-弹簧蜂巢晶格中同时实现三种弹性拓扑相，并首次发现谷霍尔与陈绝缘体界面处的拓扑界面模式，提供了简洁统一的解析模型以探索弹性波的拓扑本质。
papers.method_zh: 解析微扰方法推导能带简并点附近的有效连续模型；通过拓扑不变量评估揭示拓扑相变物理；数值上采用布洛赫波分析（畴壁条带）和有限尺寸样品的瞬态模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Defect Tolerance in Trigonal Selenium Photovoltaics
papers.abstract: Understanding how point defects fundamentally influence photovoltaic performance remains a central question for emerging wide-band gap absorbers. Trigonal selenium (t-Se) has recently re-emerged as a promising photovoltaic material due to its near-optimal band gap for tandem and indoor applications. Here we quantify defect-assisted Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) recombination in t-Se using first principles calculations across a large and chemically diverse set of point defects. Our results suggest that t-Se is intrinsically defect tolerant. Despite the presence of multiple deep levels in the gap, recombination via nonradiative multi-phonon emission processes is strongly suppressed by large lattice reorganizations and large energy releases of at least 0.5 EG per recombination event, while radiative defect-assisted capture also remains too small to account for the observed device losses. Consequently, SRH recombination mediated by realistic concentrations of point defects cannot account for the observed efficiency limitations in selenium photovoltaics. We explore trends in both radiative and nonradiative SRH recombination rates across the defect data set, highlighting their complex dependence on defect level position, lattice relaxation, charge state, and doping conditions. These findings establish trigonal selenium as a defect-tolerant wide-band-gap absorber and provide transferable design principles for optimizing next-generation photovoltaic materials for tandem and indoor applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：三角相硒（trigonal selenium, t-Se）中的点缺陷及其对光伏性能的影响，具体研究缺陷辅助的Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) 非辐射复合过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三角相硒本质上是一种缺陷容忍的宽带隙光伏材料。尽管存在多种深能级缺陷，但由点缺陷介导的SRH非辐射复合被强烈抑制，无法解释实验中观察到的效率限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三角相硒本质上是一种缺陷容忍的宽带隙光伏材料。尽管存在多种深能级缺陷，但由点缺陷介导的SRH非辐射复合被强烈抑制，无法解释实验中观察到的效率限制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作首次通过大规模第一性原理计算，系统量化了三角相硒中多种点缺陷的SRH复合行为，并揭示了其缺陷容忍性的物理机制（大晶格弛豫和大能量释放导致非辐射复合被抑制），为理解该材料的效率限制提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），用于量化大量化学多样性点缺陷的SRH复合速率，并分析辐射与非辐射复合速率。

papers.title: Compressed minimum-purity time evolution for late-time quantum dynamics
papers.abstract: Unitary time evolution of initially simple quantum many-body states rapidly generates entanglement and complex correlations, which limits direct numerical simulations. The late-time dynamics of physical observables, however, typically exhibits an effective simplicity in the form of hydrodynamics or kinetic theory. This leads to the question whether microscopic equations of motion can remain accurate and tractable up to long time scales by discarding irrelevant information in a controlled manner. Here, we introduce compressed minimum-purity time evolution (CoMPuTE) as an approach to keep track of a consistent set of reduced local density matrices, closing the hierarchical equations of motion using a minimum-purity principle. In benchmark applications we demonstrate (i) accurate description of energy diffusion in the one-dimensional mixed-field Ising model, (ii) the applicability to genuinely out-of-equilibrium Floquet dynamics starting from a pure state, and (iii) the limitations of the local reduced density matrix approximation when describing transport in the XXZ chain at $Δ=1$ that is governed by increasingly non-local integrals of motion. The CoMPuTE method enhances computational efficiency in comparison to the closely related local-information time evolution algorithm, opening a possible route towards an extension to systems in higher spatial dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：提出新的数值方法（CoMPuTE），并通过基准测试（benchmark applications）验证其性能。；研究对象：量子多体系统在长时间尺度下的动力学演化，具体包括一维混合场伊辛模型中的能量扩散、纯态出发的非平衡Floquet动力学，以及XXZ链（Δ=1）中的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出压缩最小纯度时间演化（CoMPuTE）方法，能够在长时间尺度上准确描述量子多体系统的动力学，同时显著提升计算效率，并揭示了局域约化密度矩阵近似在描述非局域守恒量主导的输运时的局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出压缩最小纯度时间演化（CoMPuTE）方法，能够在长时间尺度上准确描述量子多体系统的动力学，同时显著提升计算效率，并揭示了局域约化密度矩阵近似在描述非局域守恒量主导的输运时的局限性。；创新点：提出一种新的数值方法（CoMPuTE），通过最小纯度原理实现层级方程的闭合，相比已有方法（如局域信息时间演化算法）显著提升计算效率，并有望扩展到更高空间维度。
papers.method_zh: CoMPuTE方法：基于最小纯度原理（minimum-purity principle）闭合局域约化密度矩阵的层级运动方程，以压缩方式追踪一组自洽的约化局域密度矩阵。与已有的局域信息时间演化算法（local-information time evolution algorithm）进行对比。
