papers.title: Unusual half-metallic state in unconventional magnets
papers.abstract: Half-metallic ferromagnets exhibit a gap in the density of states for one spin projection while remaining gapless for the opposite spin. We show that in helimagnets an unusual half-metallic state can exist, where the spin projection that experiences the gap is determined by the direction of the wave vector. This state originates from the nontrivial topology of the band structure, specifically from the dispersion forming a multi-sheeted covering over the Brillouin zone. We present two-dimensional tight-binding models for $p$-wave and $f$-wave half metals. These structures can be realized in crystalline and van der Waals systems. The complex band structure of the unusual $p$-wave half metal in nanostructures is also discussed. In a quantum well, a standing wave with a helical spin structure is formed, and a persistent spin current exists.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、present、discuss（理论推导与模型构建）。；研究对象：非常规磁体中的半金属态，具体为螺旋磁体（helimagnets）中的p波和f波半金属。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在螺旋磁体中存在一种不寻常的半金属态，其能隙所对应的自旋投影方向由波矢方向决定；该态源于能带结构的非平凡拓扑，即色散在布里渊区上形成多叶覆盖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在螺旋磁体中存在一种不寻常的半金属态，其能隙所对应的自旋投影方向由波矢方向决定；该态源于能带结构的非平凡拓扑，即色散在布里渊区上形成多叶覆盖。；创新点：首次提出在螺旋磁体中存在一种由波矢方向决定自旋能隙取向的新型半金属态，并揭示了其与能带拓扑（多叶覆盖色散）的内在关联。
papers.method_zh: 构建二维紧束缚模型（tight-binding models），分析p波和f波半金属的能带结构，并讨论纳米结构中p波半金属的复杂能带结构。

papers.title: Reconfigurable Strain Gradient Polarity in Crystalline Oxide Nanomembranes for Controlled Bending of Functional Materials
papers.abstract: We report the fabrication and mechanical characterization of a "bubble" geometry for accessing local strain gradients using freestanding, single-crystalline manganite nanomembranes: a switchable bistable nanodrum, with opposite strain gradient polarities. By leveraging epitaxial strain as a source of pre-strain and with control of geometrical and mechanical boundary conditions, the fabricated device can support strain gradients with strain variation ranging from 0.01% to 1%. Switching energetics can be designed to configure the bubble morphology. By providing a mechanical framework for sustained strain gradients, this platform supports scalable oxide membrane applications such as the mechanical manipulation of magnetism, coupled to local probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fabrication、mechanical characterization、device、local probes。；研究对象：单晶锰氧化物（manganite）纳米薄膜中可重构的应变梯度极性结构，具体为一种“气泡”几何构型的双稳态纳米鼓（bistable nanodrum），用于实现可控弯曲功能材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过外延应变作为预应变源，并控制几何与力学边界条件，成功制备出具有相反应变梯度极性的可切换双稳态纳米鼓，其应变变化范围可达0.01%至1%，且可通过设计切换能量来配置气泡形态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过外延应变作为预应变源，并控制几何与力学边界条件，成功制备出具有相反应变梯度极性的可切换双稳态纳米鼓，其应变变化范围可达0.01%至1%，且可通过设计切换能量来配置气泡形态。；创新点：实现了在晶体氧化物纳米薄膜中可重构的应变梯度极性（即双稳态切换），为持续应变梯度提供了力学平台，从而可扩展至氧化物膜应用中，例如通过机械方式调控磁性并与局域探针耦合。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了自支撑单晶锰氧化物纳米薄膜，构建了“气泡”几何结构；通过力学表征测量应变梯度；利用外延应变作为预应变源，并调控几何与力学边界条件来控制应变梯度极性。

papers.title: Chiral anomaly and planar Hall conductance in pseudospin-$1$ Fermions
papers.abstract: Positive longitudinal magnetoconductance (LMC) and planar Hall conductance (PHC) are hallmark transport signatures of the chiral anomaly in Weyl semimetals. Recent theoretical developments have extended Weyl fermions to multifold Fermionic systems with higher-pseudospin quasiparticle excitations, motivating the study of their magnetotransport properties. Here, we employ semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory within the relaxation-time approximation to investigate magnetotransport in pseudospin-1 Weyl semimetals, incorporating momentum-dependent scattering, orbital magnetic moment corrections, and charge-conservation constraints. To obtain a finite PHC, we break azimuthal symmetry through either a generic tilt of the quasiparticle dispersion or a finite misalignment between the electric and magnetic fields. In the untilted case, the PHC is positive and scales quadratically with magnetic field strength. Increasing the scattering strength induces a sign reversal of the PHC, producing a transition from positive to negative values. The PHC further exhibits the characteristic angular dependence $\sin 2γ$, where $γ$ is the angle between the magnetic field and the $x$-axis. Tilt qualitatively alters this behavior: tilt along the $x$- and $z$-directions changes the angular response to $\sinγ$ and $\cosγ$, respectively, generating strong anisotropy in the planar Hall signal. Moreover, the PHC shows a nonmonotonic dependence on tilt magnitude, revealing the interplay between tilt-induced symmetry breaking and chiral-anomaly-driven transport. Our results provide experimentally accessible signatures of multifold fermions and a framework for interpreting magnetotransport measurements in candidate materials of space groups 199, 214, and 220.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory、theoretical developments、investigate。；研究对象：赝自旋-1 外尔半金属（pseudospin-1 Weyl semimetals）中的磁输运现象，特别是手征反常导致的纵向磁导（LMC）和平面霍尔电导（PHC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在赝自旋-1 外尔半金属中，平面霍尔电导（PHC）在无倾斜时为正且与磁场强度呈二次方关系，散射强度增大会导致PHC符号反转（正变负）；引入能带倾斜会改变PHC的角度依赖关系（从sin2γ变为sinγ或cosγ），并产生非单调的倾斜幅度依赖行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在赝自旋-1 外尔半金属中，平面霍尔电导（PHC）在无倾斜时为正且与磁场强度呈二次方关系，散射强度增大会导致PHC符号反转（正变负）；引入能带倾斜会改变PHC的角度依赖关系（从sin2γ变为sinγ或cosγ），并产生非单调的倾斜幅度依赖行为。；创新点：将手征反常的磁输运研究从传统外尔费米子扩展到赝自旋-1 的多重费米子系统，揭示了倾斜和散射对平面霍尔电导的定性影响（如符号反转和角度依赖变化），为空间群199、214、220候选材料中的磁输运测量提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用弛豫时间近似下的半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论，并考虑了动量依赖的散射、轨道磁矩修正以及电荷守恒约束。

papers.title: Universal critical behavior in ideal Bose-Einstein condensation
papers.abstract: Ideal Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) remains a paradigmatic example of a continuous phase transition and a cornerstone for understanding quantum degenerate bosonic matter. We demonstrate that critical behavior of the ideal Bose gas near the BEC phase transition falls into three distinct classes, determined exclusively by the low-energy scaling of the density of states. Depending on its scaling exponent, which is controlled by dimensionality and confinement, the transition displays either the usual algebraic divergences of thermodynamic susceptibilities, divergent behavior with marginal logarithmic corrections, or a more subtle form of criticality, where only the correlation length diverges. Our work provides a unified framework for criticality in noninteracting bosonic systems. This classification applies broadly to atomic, photonic, polaritonic, and magnonic condensates, where dimensionality, confinement, and spectral engineering can strongly reshape the density of states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、provides a unified framework、classification。；研究对象：理想玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）中的临界行为，涵盖原子、光子、极化激元、磁振子等凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 理想玻色气体在BEC相变附近的临界行为可归为三类，由态密度的低能标度指数唯一决定：通常的代数发散、带对数修正的发散，或仅关联长度发散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：理想玻色气体在BEC相变附近的临界行为可归为三类，由态密度的低能标度指数唯一决定：通常的代数发散、带对数修正的发散，或仅关联长度发散。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于态密度的低能标度分析，通过维度、约束和谱工程控制标度指数，建立统一的理论框架。

papers.title: Exact Dynamics of Topological Order Across a CDW--SPT Transition
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium dynamics of a one-dimensional interacting system across a transition from a charge-density-wave (CDW) phase to a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase. Starting from a CDW initial state, we study both sudden quenches and slow ramps into the SPT regime. While the CDW order melts under both protocols, the fate of topological order is sharply different. Following a sudden quench, long-range SPT order does not emerge because the post-quench state contains a finite density of excitations above the topological ground state. In contrast, slow ramps allow the system to follow the instantaneous ground state away from the critical region, enabling the buildup of SPT order with deviations governed by Kibble-Zurek defect production. The dynamics is solvable via a unitary mapping to a quadratic fermionic Hamiltonian, allowing us to compute the Loschmidt echo, correlation functions, and string correlator. The Loschmidt rate function exhibits cusps signaling dynamical quantum phase transitions, while the correlation dynamics reveal the contrasting mechanisms governing quenches and ramps across the transition. These results demonstrate that entering the topological regime is not sufficient for the emergence of topological order; the decisive factor is the suppression of excitation production during the evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We investigate”“The dynamics is solvable via a unitary mapping to a quadratic fermionic Hamiltonian”等表述，属于理论分析与可解模型研究，未提及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：一维相互作用系统从电荷密度波（CDW）相到对称保护拓扑（SPT）相的相变过程中的非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在从CDW相到SPT相的动力学过程中，拓扑序能否建立的关键不在于系统是否进入拓扑区域，而在于演化过程中激发产生的抑制程度：突然淬火无法建立长程SPT序，而缓慢斜坡（ramp）可以，其偏差由Kibble-Zurek缺陷产生机制决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在从CDW相到SPT相的动力学过程中，拓扑序能否建立的关键不在于系统是否进入拓扑区域，而在于演化过程中激发产生的抑制程度：突然淬火无法建立长程SPT序，而缓慢斜坡（ramp）可以，其偏差由Kibble-Zurek缺陷产生机制决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过幺正映射将相互作用系统转化为二次费米子哈密顿量，实现精确可解动力学。计算了Loschmidt回波、关联函数和弦关联函数，并分析了淬火与斜坡两种协议下的动力学行为。

papers.title: Ferromagnetism from the geometry of localized wavefunctions in moiré systems
papers.abstract: We present a mechanism for ferromagnetism in narrow bands consisting of Anderson-localized states. We exploit single-particle localization to derive a controlled theory of exchange interactions within the narrow band. For quasiperiodic systems with a half-filled moiré band, we show that the critical interaction strength for ferromagnetism is highly sensitive to the geometry of real-space overlaps between localized orbitals: we find well-defined resonances at which ferromagnetism sets in for interaction energies that are far lower than the gap to other bands. Near these resonances, all the approximations in our theory are controlled, so our critical point predictions are quantitative. We show examples both in one and two dimensions. Our work identifies a route to ferromagnetism based on the geometry of real-space wavefunctions, distinct from previously found mechanisms based on the quantum geometry of Bloch bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：present a mechanism、derive a controlled theory、show examples。；研究对象：莫尔系统中由安德森局域态构成的窄带中的铁磁性机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准周期莫尔系统中，铁磁性的临界相互作用强度对局域轨道实空间重叠的几何结构高度敏感；存在明确的共振点，在这些共振点附近，铁磁性可在远低于其他能带间隙的相互作用能下出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准周期莫尔系统中，铁磁性的临界相互作用强度对局域轨道实空间重叠的几何结构高度敏感；存在明确的共振点，在这些共振点附近，铁磁性可在远低于其他能带间隙的相互作用能下出现。；创新点：提出了一种基于实空间波函数几何结构的铁磁性实现路径，区别于以往基于布洛赫带量子几何的铁磁机制。
papers.method_zh: 利用单粒子局域化性质，推导出窄带内交换相互作用的可控理论；在一维和二维中给出示例。

papers.title: Numerical simulations of the spread from the mean of the SLE and Multiple SLE dynamics
papers.abstract: The Schramm-Loewner Evolution (SLE) describes a family of fractal curves that arise in the study of the scaling limits of many planar Statistical Physics models. These curves are modeled using the Loewner Differential Equation for the conformal maps $g_t(z)$ with a Brownian motion driver. Using Euler's Method, in the current work we performed numerical experiments to study at a fixed time the quantities $|g_t(z) - \overline{g_t(z)}|$ and $Re(g_t(z)) - Re(\overline{g_t(z)})$, where $Re$ denotes the real part and $\overline{g_t(z)}$ refers to the sample average. These random variables measure the 'spread' of the dynamics from the average behavior at fixed time. One of the scopes of this work is to give numerical predictions for future theoretical investigations on these quantities. When investigating these quantities in the SLE case our experiments predict that the distribution is bimodal when the dynamics started close to the origin, and it can become bell-shaped if the dynamics is started further from the origin. In the second part, we performed experiments for a Multiple SLE model whose driver is Dyson Brownian Motion. Due to singularity in the dynamics of the drivers and the many data points needed, this part is challenging from a computational perspective. In the multiple SLE case, our experiments predict that the distribution is bell-shaped in all cases. In addition, we check the changes in the distributions as we vary the parameter $κ$ in the SLE case and $β$ in the Multiple SLE case.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“numerical simulations”、“numerical experiments”、“Euler’s Method”。；研究对象：Schramm-Loewner Evolution（SLE）和Multiple SLE动力学中，共形映射$g_t(z)$相对于其样本平均值的“扩散”（spread）行为，具体研究$|g_t(z) - \overline{g_t(z)}|$和$Re(g_t(z)) - Re(\overline{g_t(z)})$这两个随机变量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SLE情形下，当动力学从靠近原点开始时，分布呈双峰；当从远离原点开始时，分布呈钟形。在Multiple SLE情形下，所有情况下的分布均为钟形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SLE情形下，当动力学从靠近原点开始时，分布呈双峰；当从远离原点开始时，分布呈钟形。在Multiple SLE情形下，所有情况下的分布均为钟形。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用欧拉方法（Euler’s Method）对Loewner微分方程进行数值模拟。对于SLE，驱动为布朗运动；对于Multiple SLE，驱动为Dyson布朗运动。通过改变SLE中的参数$\kappa$和Multiple SLE中的参数$\beta$，观察分布的变化。

papers.title: Quantifying the Distribution of Biexciton Emission Efficiencies in Colloidal Quantum Shells
papers.abstract: The efficiency of multi-photon emission is an important characteristic of quantum light sources. Bright multi-photon emission is desirable for high-power lighting and lasers, while its complete suppression is required for high-purity single-photon generation. In colloidal quantum emitters, multi-photon emission can vary significantly between individual particles. Resolving this heterogeneity remains challenging with conventional particle-by-particle approaches. Here, we introduce a crosstalk-suppressed SPAD-array photon-correlation approach for high-throughput quantification of multi-photon emission from more than 1000 colloidal quantum shells. By projecting two images of the same sample onto distant regions of the detector array, we avoid short-range crosstalk between detector pixels. Time gating suppresses dark-count coincidences and distinguishes individual emitters from clusters. Applying this method to quantum shells reveals a near-Gaussian distribution of biexciton emission efficiencies, with a mean of 0.55 and an estimated intrinsic standard deviation of 0.12. Intra-batch correlations between the biexciton efficiency and the particle brightness are consistent with the volume scaling of Auger quenching. These results establish SPAD-array photon correlation as a scalable route to resolve multi-photon heterogeneities in nanoparticle ensembles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验方法（SPAD-array photon-correlation approach）和测量结果（分布、均值、标准差等）。；研究对象：胶体量子壳（colloidal quantum shells）中双激子发射效率的分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量测量超过1000个胶体量子壳，发现双激子发射效率呈近高斯分布，平均值为0.55，估计本征标准差为0.12。批次内双激子效率与粒子亮度的相关性符合俄歇猝灭的体积标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量测量超过1000个胶体量子壳，发现双激子发射效率呈近高斯分布，平均值为0.55，估计本征标准差为0.12。批次内双激子效率与粒子亮度的相关性符合俄歇猝灭的体积标度关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用串扰抑制的SPAD阵列光子关联方法（crosstalk-suppressed SPAD-array photon-correlation approach），通过将同一试样的两个图像投影到探测器阵列的远距离区域来避免像素间短程串扰，并利用时间门控抑制暗计数符合事件、区分单个发射体与团簇。

papers.title: Nonadditivity in Quantum Field Theory: Replica Energies, Scaling Filters, and the Renormalization Group
papers.abstract: Extensive systems have a simple thermodynamic signature: the logarithm of the partition function scales homogeneously with the size of the system. We show that the failure of this scaling, measured by the replica energy ${\cal E}$, provides a useful bridge between statistical mechanics and quantum field theory. The associated differential operator $(1-\frac1d L\partial_L)$ removes the leading bulk contribution to $W=\log Z$ and isolates the part that is sensitive to boundaries, topology, defects, long-range forces, or other sources of nonadditivity. In quantum field theory this thermodynamic idea has two closely related uses. For ordinary finite-volume or spherical partition functions, suitable higher-order versions of the same filter remove local counterterms and extract universal fixed-point data such as the central charge, the sphere free energy $F$, and the Euler anomaly coefficient $a$. For replica geometries with entangling defects, the same filtering principle gives the renormalized defect free energy. In $2+1$ dimensions, its $n\to1$ limit is precisely the entropic $F$-function. We use this perspective to distinguish ordinary finite-size corrections, topology-dependent constants in gapped phases, subextensive fracton degeneracies, and genuinely nonextensive systems with long-range interactions such as self-gravitating thermal matter. Replica energy therefore offers a common thermodynamic language for additivity, defect free energies, and renormalization-group irreversibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum field theory, renormalization group, thermodynamic signature, statistical mechanics。；研究对象：量子场论中非加和性（nonadditivity）的物理效应，具体包括有限体积系统、边界、拓扑、缺陷、长程力以及自引力热物质等体系中的非广延性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复制能量（replica energy）ℰ 是衡量系统非加和性的关键量，它通过微分算子 (1 - (1/d) L ∂_L) 从配分函数的对数中滤除体贡献，从而提取出对边界、拓扑、缺陷等敏感的普适信息，并为可加性、缺陷自由能和重整化群不可逆性提供了统一的热力学语言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复制能量（replica energy）ℰ 是衡量系统非加和性的关键量，它通过微分算子 (1 - (1/d) L ∂_L) 从配分函数的对数中滤除体贡献，从而提取出对边界、拓扑、缺陷等敏感的普适信息，并为可加性、缺陷自由能和重整化群不可逆性提供了统一的热力学语言。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于统计力学与量子场论的桥梁，利用复制能量及其高阶版本作为标度滤波器（scaling filter），分析有限体积或球面配分函数、复制几何中的纠缠缺陷，以及2+1维中熵F函数的n→1极限。

papers.title: Deterministic Single-Photon Emitter Arrays in Hexagonal Boron Nitride by Carbon-Assisted Focused Ion Beam Engineering
papers.abstract: The realization of on-chip photonic circuits requires scalable and deterministic single-photon emitters (SPEs) at room temperature, which remain a challenge in van der Waals materials. In this work, we report a novel three-step fabrication process for the generation of spatially controlled SPE arrays in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). The process comprises site-selective gallium (Ga) focused ion beam milling, nanoscale conformal carbon deposition over the patterned regions, and subsequent thermal annealing. The synergistic combination of these steps resulted in a site-correlated emitter yield of ($\sim 89\%$) across 100 fabrication sites. Second-order autocorrelation measurements revealed pronounced three-level emitter dynamics where the best emitters exhibited high purity ($g^{(2)}(0)=0.15 \pm 0.09$).To the best of our knowledge, this is the first lithography-free, direct-write approach combining Ga-ion milling, selective carbon engineering, and thermal annealing to deterministically generate \hBN{} \SPE{}s. The reproducibility of the method is validated across multiple independently fabricated samples. These results establish a scalable, lithography-free pathway toward on-demand SPE arrays relevant to integrated quantum photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的“三步制备工艺”（three-step fabrication process）和“二阶自相关测量”（second-order autocorrelation measurements）等实验手段。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的确定性单光子发射体（SPE）阵列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一种结合镓离子聚焦离子束刻蚀、纳米级保形碳沉积和热退火的无光刻三步工艺，成功在六方氮化硼中制备了空间可控的单光子发射体阵列，实现了约89%的位点相关发射体产率，并获得了高纯度的单光子发射（g²(0)=0.15±0.09）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一种结合镓离子聚焦离子束刻蚀、纳米级保形碳沉积和热退火的无光刻三步工艺，成功在六方氮化硼中制备了空间可控的单光子发射体阵列，实现了约89%的位点相关发射体产率，并获得了高纯度的单光子发射（g²(0)=0.15±0.09）。；创新点：这是首个结合镓离子刻蚀、选择性碳工程和热退火的无光刻、直写式方法，用于在六方氮化硼中确定性生成单光子发射体阵列。该方法具有可扩展性和可重复性。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法包括：1）位点选择性镓（Ga）聚焦离子束（FIB）刻蚀；2）在图案化区域进行纳米级保形碳沉积；3）后续热退火处理。表征手段为二阶自相关（g²(0)）测量。

papers.title: Effects of microstructural heterogeneity on the macroscopic spectrum of elastically accommodated grain-boundary sliding
papers.abstract: Elastically accommodated grain-boundary sliding (EAGBS) is a plausible source of upper-mantle seismic attenuation and dispersion, yet classical theory predicts a localized Debye-like peak that is absent or only weakly expressed in dry olivine experiments. Here we test whether microstructural heterogeneity can explain this discrepancy using 2-D finite-element simulations on periodic Voronoi tessellations. We find that irregular grain geometry changes the baseline EAGBS response relative to the regular hexagonal benchmark, but increasing grain-size variance alone produces only modest changes in modulus and peak height, with little spectral broadening. In contrast, a broad distribution of grain-boundary viscosities progressively suppresses and broadens the Debye-like loss peak into a weak background spanning a wide frequency interval. This broadening arises from the superposition of many localized relaxation processes with distinct characteristic timescales and motivates a reduced-order 0-D description of the aggregate response. These results suggest that the absence of a pronounced EAGBS peak in dry olivine does not necessarily imply the absence of EAGBS mechanism itself. If grain boundaries sample a sufficiently broad viscosity distribution, the macroscopic EAGBS contribution may appear experimentally only as part of a broad attenuation background, while still remaining relevant for upper-mantle seismic attenuation and velocity dispersion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：2-D finite-element simulations（二维有限元模拟）、periodic Voronoi tessellations（周期性Voronoi剖分）。；研究对象：弹性协调的晶界滑移（EAGBS）机制对地幔上部地震波衰减和频散的影响，具体研究微观结构非均匀性（晶粒几何不规则性、晶界粘度分布）如何改变宏观力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶粒几何不规则性对EAGBS响应影响有限，而晶界粘度的宽分布会显著抑制并展宽德拜型损耗峰，使其变为覆盖宽频段的弱背景。这表明干橄榄石实验中未观察到明显EAGBS峰并不排除该机制本身的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶粒几何不规则性对EAGBS响应影响有限，而晶界粘度的宽分布会显著抑制并展宽德拜型损耗峰，使其变为覆盖宽频段的弱背景。这表明干橄榄石实验中未观察到明显EAGBS峰并不排除该机制本身的存在。；创新点：首次通过数值模拟系统检验了微观结构非均匀性（特别是晶界粘度分布）对经典EAGBS理论预测的德拜峰的影响，解释了理论与干橄榄石实验之间的差异，并提出了降阶的零维（0-D）描述来概括多晶集合体的响应。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维有限元模拟，在周期性Voronoi剖分（模拟多晶微观结构）上计算弹性协调的晶界滑移响应，并与规则六边形晶粒基准结果对比。

papers.title: Phase Transitions in Attention: A Bayesian Theory of Copy Head Emergence
papers.abstract: Attention is the key mechanism underlying in-context learning in transformers, and attention patterns have been observed empirically to emerge abruptly during training. We present a Bayesian theory of feature learning in attention; we then focus on how the copy subcircuit in the first layer of an induction head is learned by analyzing a single-layer softmax attention network trained on a copy task. We derive a closed-form posterior over the attention matrix and reduce it to a low-dimensional order parameter space. This reduction reveals a phase transition in the amount of training data, which we verify using both Bayesian sampling and standard training with Adam. We contrast our results with linear attention and find that softmax attention exhibits a \emph{first-order phase transition} while in linear attention an initial \emph{second-order phase transition} is followed by a smooth, continuous evolution toward the structured attention pattern (\emph{crossover}). Our work provides a first-principles theoretical account of the abrupt emergence of the copy subcircuit, reminiscent of the one observed in training large language models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Bayesian theory”“closed-form posterior”“order parameter space”“phase transition”等理论分析框架，未涉及实验或数值模拟（除验证性采样外）。；研究对象：Transformer注意力机制中的“复制子电路”（copy subcircuit）在训练过程中的涌现行为，具体分析单层softmax注意力网络在复制任务上的学习过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现复制子电路的涌现存在一个由训练数据量驱动的相变：softmax注意力表现出**一级相变**（abrupt emergence），而线性注意力则先经历**二级相变**后平滑演化为结构化模式（crossover）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现复制子电路的涌现存在一个由训练数据量驱动的相变：softmax注意力表现出**一级相变**（abrupt emergence），而线性注意力则先经历**二级相变**后平滑演化为结构化模式（crossover）。；创新点：首次从第一性原理（first-principles）理论角度解释了注意力模式在训练中突然涌现的相变行为，并严格区分了softmax与线性注意力在相变阶数上的本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 贝叶斯理论推导注意力矩阵的后验分布，将其约化到低维序参量空间；结合贝叶斯采样与Adam优化器进行数值验证。

papers.title: Searching for cosmic vortices
papers.abstract: Our study focuses on the strong tidal disruption of a cold helium white dwarf passing a black hole. We model the white dwarf as a Bose-Fermi droplet and use quantum hydrodynamic equations to simulate the binary system's evolution. As the white dwarf passes through periastron, it loses a significant amount of mass. This mass falls onto the black hole and forms an accretion disc. Quantized vortices appear in the accretion disc, manifesting as strong electromagnetic radiation signals that exhibit characteristic flickering patterns changing on a timescale of a few seconds. Meanwhile, the white dwarf moves away from the black hole. As the white dwarf moves through space, vortices run along its surface. This elongates its geometry, causing it to rotate and emit gravitational waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：量子流体动力学方程、模拟、Bose-Fermi液滴模型。；研究对象：冷氦白矮星被黑洞强潮汐瓦解的过程，以及由此形成的吸积盘和白矮星残骸中的量子化涡旋现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在白矮星被黑洞潮汐瓦解后形成的吸积盘中，会出现量子化涡旋，这些涡旋产生具有特征闪烁模式的强电磁辐射信号（时间尺度约几秒）；同时，白矮星残骸表面也会产生涡旋，导致其几何拉长、旋转并发射引力波。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在白矮星被黑洞潮汐瓦解后形成的吸积盘中，会出现量子化涡旋，这些涡旋产生具有特征闪烁模式的强电磁辐射信号（时间尺度约几秒）；同时，白矮星残骸表面也会产生涡旋，导致其几何拉长、旋转并发射引力波。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将白矮星建模为Bose-Fermi液滴，使用量子流体动力学方程模拟双星系统的演化过程。

papers.title: Tensor-Network Algorithm for Many-Body Trace Norms
papers.abstract: Trace norms are fundamental to quantum information theory, yet in many-body systems their evaluation remains a major computational bottleneck, as it generally requires diagonalizing exponentially large operators. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by introducing a controlled tensor-network algorithm for estimating the trace norm of matrix product operators without full diagonalization. The key idea is to combine Zolotarev's rational approximation to the sign function with a variational formulation solved using a density-matrix-renormalization-group-like algorithm. The resulting approximation is systematically improvable, with its accuracy controlled by the rational approximation parameters and the spectral weight near zero. Beyond the reach of exact diagonalization, we demonstrate controlled trace-norm calculations for entanglement negativity, quantum fidelity and quantum Fisher information, achieving substantially improved accuracy over polynomial-based Lanczos approaches. Our results establish trace-norm-based quantities as practical tensor-network observables, opening a route toward tensor-network studies of quantum information in mixed states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tensor-network algorithm、variational formulation、density-matrix-renormalization-group-like algorithm。；研究对象：多体量子系统中迹范数（trace norms）的计算，具体应用于纠缠负性（entanglement negativity）、量子保真度（quantum fidelity）和量子Fisher信息（quantum Fisher information）等量子信息量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种可控的张量网络算法，无需完全对角化即可高效估算矩阵乘积算子的迹范数，且精度优于基于多项式Lanczos的方法，使迹范数相关量成为实用的张量网络可观测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种可控的张量网络算法，无需完全对角化即可高效估算矩阵乘积算子的迹范数，且精度优于基于多项式Lanczos的方法，使迹范数相关量成为实用的张量网络可观测量。；创新点：首次将Zolotarev有理逼近与张量网络变分法结合，实现了对多体系统迹范数的可控、可系统改进的计算，突破了传统需对角化指数级大算符的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 结合Zolotarev有理逼近（rational approximation）符号函数与变分公式，采用类似密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）的算法求解，通过有理逼近参数和近零谱权重控制精度。

papers.title: Breakdown of the classical rupture theory and earthquake propagation in the "forbidden" super-Rayleigh range
papers.abstract: Earthquakes propagating faster than the shear wave-speed are commonly thought to undergo a super-shear transition upon which they discontinuously jump from the sub-Rayleigh regime to the super-shear one. The super-Rayleigh regime, i.e., the range of propagation speeds between the Rayleigh and shear wave-speeds, is regarded as "forbidden" by the two-dimensional classical rupture theory. Here, we revisit the assumptions underlying the classical theory and develop a rupture theory that takes into account the dependence of the fault strength (frictional resistance) on the slip rate. The theory quantitatively agrees with numerical simulations nearly up to the Rayleigh wave-speed. Yet, very close to the latter, two-dimensional rupture solutions change their character due to frictional rate nonlinearity and rupture continuously propagates through the "forbidden" super-Rayleigh range into the super-shear regime, without a sharp super-shear transition. These results demonstrate that frictional rate dependence, generically observed in experiments, can have profound implications for fast earthquake propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“develop a rupture theory”、“quantitatively agrees with numerical simulations”。；研究对象：地震破裂传播中的“超瑞利范围”（介于瑞利波速与剪切波速之间的传播速度区间），以及该范围内断层摩擦强度（摩擦阻力）对滑移速率的依赖性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典二维破裂理论认为超瑞利范围是“禁止”的，但考虑摩擦速率依赖性后，破裂可以连续地通过该“禁止”范围进入超剪切状态，而不发生不连续的跃迁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典二维破裂理论认为超瑞利范围是“禁止”的，但考虑摩擦速率依赖性后，破裂可以连续地通过该“禁止”范围进入超剪切状态，而不发生不连续的跃迁。；创新点：揭示了摩擦速率依赖性（实验中普遍观测到）对快速地震传播的深刻影响，推翻了经典理论中关于超瑞利范围不可通过的结论。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种考虑断层摩擦强度（摩擦阻力）随滑移速率变化的新破裂理论，并通过数值模拟进行定量验证。

papers.title: Range-Aware Bayesian Optimization for Discovering Diverse Designs within Target Property Windows
papers.abstract: In many materials and product design problems, desirable candidates exhibit properties that fall within an acceptable range rather than achieve a single optimum. Recovering multiple, distinct solutions that satisfy such specifications is also practically valuable, as some candidates may be preferred for reasons of cost, processability, or robustness that are difficult to encode directly in an objective function. Here, we develop a range-aware Bayesian optimization (BO) framework in which the acquisition function directly scores the posterior probability that a candidate satisfies a target range. The framework naturally extends to parallel pursuit of multiple distinct specifications over a shared candidate space. Across benchmark tasks, range-aware acquisition consistently recovers larger and more diverse sets of valid designs than standard BO baselines and recent goal-seeking methods. Its utility is further demonstrated in two practically motivated design case studies involving optimizing reaction conditions for polymer synthesis and sequence-defined oligomer discovery for prescribed optical absorption bands, supported by quantum chemical calculations. These results suggest that range-aware BO can provide a practical and sample-efficient foundation for specification-driven design, particularly when design flexibility and solution diversity are important considerations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Bayesian optimization（贝叶斯优化）、acquisition function（采集函数）、quantum chemical calculations（量子化学计算）。；研究对象：材料与产品设计中的候选物（candidates），具体案例包括聚合物合成的反应条件优化以及序列定义低聚物的光学吸收带设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“范围感知”贝叶斯优化框架，其采集函数直接评估候选物满足目标属性范围的后验概率，相比标准贝叶斯优化和近期目标搜索方法，能更高效地恢复更大、更多样化的有效设计集合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“范围感知”贝叶斯优化框架，其采集函数直接评估候选物满足目标属性范围的后验概率，相比标准贝叶斯优化和近期目标搜索方法，能更高效地恢复更大、更多样化的有效设计集合。；创新点：将贝叶斯优化的目标从寻找单一最优值扩展为发现满足目标属性范围（而非单一极值）的多个不同设计方案，并直接利用后验概率进行采集函数评分，同时支持并行搜索多个不同规格。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯优化框架，开发了范围感知的采集函数（range-aware acquisition function），用于并行搜索共享候选空间中的多个不同规格目标。在基准任务和两个实际设计案例（聚合物合成反应条件优化、基于量子化学计算的序列定义低聚物光学吸收带发现）中验证了方法有效性。

papers.title: Diffusive Relaxation of Participation Entropy in U(1)-symmetric Dynamics
papers.abstract: Participation entropy (PE) quantifies the spread of a many-body wavefunction across configuration space. While PE relaxes rapidly in generic chaotic systems, we show that $\mathrm{U}(1)$ conservation laws slow it down by imprinting with the slow hydrodynamic modes. Using a cluster expansion around equilibrium, we show that, after local density inhomogeneities decay, the leading PE deficit is dominated by squared connected density correlations. The long time relaxation is therefore controlled by diffusive correlation spreading, giving $ΔS(t)\sim t^{-1/2}$ in the hydrodynamic regime and crossing over to $\sim \exp[-O(t/L^2)]$ when $t\geq L^2$. We confirm this entropy correlation relation using exact computation and infinite system tensor network simulations in various quantum $\mathrm{U}(1)$ conserving circuits. Our results establish PE as a sensitive probe of hydrodynamic memory and suggest that slow relaxation is a generic consequence of conservation laws.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词“cluster expansion”“show that”“confirm using exact computation and infinite system tensor network simulations”。；研究对象：U(1)对称性量子动力学中参与熵（Participation Entropy）的弛豫行为，具体为U(1)守恒量子电路中的多体波函数在构型空间中的扩散弛豫。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: U(1)守恒律通过将参与熵与慢速流体动力学模式耦合，显著减缓其弛豫速度：在流体动力学区域，参与熵的亏损ΔS(t)按t^{-1/2}幂律衰减；当时间t≥L²时，交叉到指数衰减形式~exp[-O(t/L²)]。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：U(1)守恒律通过将参与熵与慢速流体动力学模式耦合，显著减缓其弛豫速度：在流体动力学区域，参与熵的亏损ΔS(t)按t^{-1/2}幂律衰减；当时间t≥L²时，交叉到指数衰减形式~exp[-O(t/L²)]。；创新点：首次揭示参与熵在U(1)对称动力学中的弛豫受控于扩散型关联传播，建立了参与熵作为流体动力学记忆敏感探针的定量关系，并指出慢弛豫是守恒律的普遍结果。

papers.title: A Cryogenic Uniaxial Strain Cell for Quantum Devices
papers.abstract: Mechanical strain is a powerful resource for tuning quantum systems, but existing piezoelectric strain cells are generally optimized for fragile, high-aspect-ratio single crystals rather than the thick, square-profile chips typical of semiconductor quantum devices. Furthermore, adapting these cells for qubits requires accommodating dense RF and DC wiring while maintaining strict electrical isolation from high-voltage piezo actuators. Here, we present a piezoelectric uniaxial strain cell designed to homogeneously strain thick, square-profile substrates. We introduce a highly symmetric dual-chip loading configuration that effectively suppresses flexural deformation and shear stress. The cell integrates a high-density RF/DC interposer to support standard wire bonding and encloses the actuators in a grounded Faraday cage to prevent unwanted Stark shifts in the device layer. Finite element simulations confirm that combining stiff actuators with this symmetric mounting drastically improves strain homogeneity. Finally, we validate the apparatus experimentally by applying uniaxial strain to a 200 $μ$m thick silicon die. Surface strain measurements demonstrate an applied strain of 215 $με$ for 200 V applied piezo bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：present、validate、experimentally、surface strain measurements。；研究对象：用于量子器件的低温单轴应变装置，具体针对厚方形硅芯片（200 μm 厚硅片）的均匀应变施加。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 设计并验证了一种压电单轴应变单元，能够对厚方形基底施加均匀应变，在200 V压电偏压下实现了215 με的表面应变，同时有效抑制弯曲变形和剪切应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：设计并验证了一种压电单轴应变单元，能够对厚方形基底施加均匀应变，在200 V压电偏压下实现了215 με的表面应变，同时有效抑制弯曲变形和剪切应力。；创新点：针对半导体量子器件常用的厚方形芯片（而非传统脆性高长宽比单晶）设计应变单元；采用对称双芯片加载构型显著抑制弯曲和剪切；集成高密度RF/DC布线并实现与高压压电致动器的严格电隔离，防止器件层发生不必要的斯塔克位移。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：设计并制造压电单轴应变单元，采用高对称双芯片加载构型，集成高密度RF/DC转接板，将致动器封装在接地法拉第笼中；通过有限元模拟优化应变均匀性；在200 μm厚硅片上施加单轴应变并进行表面应变测量验证。

papers.title: Handbook of Error-Correcting Codes
papers.abstract: Barcode scans, clear phone calls, reliable data storage, satellite communication, and large-scale quantum computation are all made possible by error correction. We present a handbook version of The Error Correction Zoo, a curated reference of methods for protecting classical or quantum information from errors during storage and transmission. The handbook includes descriptions of these error-correcting codes and a classification according to the symbols they use. It also catalogues relations among codes and related objects such as sphere packings, lattices, designs, groups, and classical and quantum phases of matter. The collection is intended both as a rigorous reference and as a practical aid for tracing the web of code relationships and uncovering new connections.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：handbook version, classification, reference, relations among codes）；研究对象：纠错码（error-correcting codes），包括经典纠错码和量子纠错码，以及与之相关的球堆积、格点、设计、群、经典与量子物质相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文以手册形式系统整理了“纠错码动物园”（The Error Correction Zoo）中的纠错码，提供了按符号分类的描述，并编录了不同纠错码之间以及纠错码与球堆积、格点、设计、群、物质相等对象之间的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文以手册形式系统整理了“纠错码动物园”（The Error Correction Zoo）中的纠错码，提供了按符号分类的描述，并编录了不同纠错码之间以及纠错码与球堆积、格点、设计、群、物质相等对象之间的关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但本文旨在提供一个兼具严格参考性和实用性的手册，帮助研究者追踪纠错码之间的关联并发现新联系。
papers.method_zh: 文献综述与分类整理，构建关系图谱（web of code relationships），未涉及具体实验或计算手段。

papers.title: Pulse-Duration Scaling of Ultrafast Laser-Induced Damage Threshold in Hybrid Gratings
papers.abstract: High damage threshold gratings are in demand worldwide as critical components for next generation ultrahigh intensity lasers. Here we investigate the pulse-duration dependence of ultrafast laser-induced damage thresholds (LIDT) in hybrid multilayer dielectric gratings, touted to combine superior performance properties of both metallic and multilayer dielectric (MLD) gratings, using a dynamic finite-difference time-domain model incorporated with linear and non-linear absorption models. Simulations agree with reported experimental LIDT values for three representative designs and predict scaling exponents which vary with pulse durations ranging from 10 to 500 fs. The results reveal strong dependence on both material bandgap and grating field distribution, providing guidance for designing high LIDT gratings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：dynamic finite-difference time-domain model incorporated with linear and non-linear absorption models，simulations）；研究对象：混合多层介质光栅（hybrid multilayer dielectric gratings）在超快激光诱导下的损伤阈值（LIDT）及其随脉冲宽度的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合光栅的超快激光损伤阈值（LIDT）随脉冲宽度（10–500 fs）的标度指数会发生变化，且该标度行为强烈依赖于材料带隙和光栅内部的电场分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合光栅的超快激光损伤阈值（LIDT）随脉冲宽度（10–500 fs）的标度指数会发生变化，且该标度行为强烈依赖于材料带隙和光栅内部的电场分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用动态时域有限差分（FDTD）模型，并结合线性和非线性吸收模型进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Mean-field limits for stochastic particle systems on dense graphs
papers.abstract: We study stochastic interacting particle systems whose interaction structure is described by dense weighted directed graphs converging to a graphon. In the thermodynamic limit, we prove a law of large numbers for the empirical measure process and derive a deterministic nonlinear master equation describing the macroscopic evolution. The limiting equation retains the heterogeneous interaction structure of the microscopic system through the limiting graphon, allowing for spatially non-homogeneous behaviors such as localized or community-type interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic interacting particle systems（随机相互作用粒子系统）、law of large numbers（大数定律）、nonlinear master equation（非线性主方程）。；研究对象：稠密加权有向图上的随机相互作用粒子系统，其相互作用结构由稠密加权有向图描述，并收敛于图极限（graphon）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热力学极限下，证明了经验测度过程的大数定律，并推导出一个描述宏观演化的确定性非线性主方程。该极限方程通过极限图保留了微观系统的异质相互作用结构，从而允许出现空间非均匀行为，如局域化或社区型相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热力学极限下，证明了经验测度过程的大数定律，并推导出一个描述宏观演化的确定性非线性主方程。该极限方程通过极限图保留了微观系统的异质相互作用结构，从而允许出现空间非均匀行为，如局域化或社区型相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用图极限（graphon）理论框架，对稠密加权有向图上的随机粒子系统进行热力学极限分析，通过大数定律推导宏观非线性主方程。

papers.title: Color-Rule-Function Encoding for Combinatorial Memory
papers.abstract: Combinatorial memory is a class of memory in which information is encoded in the set of paths through a structured mesh. In this work, we introduce a systematic encoding framework, referred to as the Color-Rule-Function (CRF) approach, for representing information in combinatorial memory. The method consists of four key steps: selecting a sequence of paths in the mesh, assigning values (e.g., colors) to each cell, defining a set of rules based on the values encountered along each path, and constructing a Boolean function that determines the state of each path. . The coding procedure is illustrated by several examples. The design space scales of the CRF scale fundamentally faster compared to conventional memory. This apparent advantage arises from the use of rule-based and functional representations but is accompanied by increased hardware complexity. A possible hardware realization of the CRF framework is discussed. Importantly, the hardware overhead can be substantially reduced through the use of customized modules. The examples of the customized design are described in the text. The combination of CRF coding with customized module design may lead to a practical advantage in data storage density. According to the estimates, the data storage density may exceed Exabit per centimeter squared. A key problem that requires further investigation is related to the minimum Hamming distance between an arbitrary target bit sequence and the closest sequence realizable within the CRF framework under fixed hardware constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：encoding framework, Boolean function, design space scaling, estimates）；研究对象：组合存储器（combinatorial memory），一种通过结构化网格中的路径集合编码信息的存储体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出Color-Rule-Function（CRF）编码框架，其设计空间扩展速度远超传统存储器，在结合定制化模块设计后，数据存储密度可能超过每平方厘米Exabit量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出Color-Rule-Function（CRF）编码框架，其设计空间扩展速度远超传统存储器，在结合定制化模块设计后，数据存储密度可能超过每平方厘米Exabit量级。；创新点：首次提出基于规则和函数表示的系统性编码框架（CRF），用于组合存储器的信息表示，并指出其设计空间扩展速度的根本性优势。摘要未突出说明与已有编码方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架设计：包括路径选择、单元赋值（如颜色）、基于路径值的规则定义、以及确定路径状态的布尔函数构建。通过示例说明编码过程，并讨论了可能的硬件实现方案及定制化模块设计。

papers.title: Observable signatures of exceptional points from left-right eigenstate distinction
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian quantum systems exhibit qualitatively distinct physical behavior compared to Hermitian systems, a prime example being spectral singularities known as exceptional points. Their relevance in, e.g., quantum sensing, unidirectional transport, and robust lasing makes it important to be able to identify exceptional points through observable features of a many-body system. Here, using as an example a one-dimensional complex XY spin chain realizing both rotation-time RT- and parity-time PT-symmetric regimes, we develop a framework for detecting exceptional points based on the distinction between left and right eigenvectors of the Hamiltonian, which in a non-Hermitian system are no longer the adjoint of each other. We first show that a global measure constructed from the difference between the Hamiltonian and its adjoint locates exceptional points via distinct non-analytic behavior. At the level of observables, differences in local spin correlations evaluated on the right and left eigenstates provide a reliable static detection scheme. In contrast, static bipartite entanglement measures fail to capture this distinction, urging us to study the quantum dynamics of the model. Following a sudden quench, we demonstrate that the time-averaged right-left entanglement entropy difference directly encodes signatures of the exceptional point. In the RT-symmetric regime, it exhibits a pronounced peak at the exceptional point, whereas in the PT-symmetric regime it behaves as an order-parameter-like quantity, remaining finite in one phase and vanishing at the transition. Our results establish a direct link between the structure of non-Hermitian eigenstates and observable signatures of exceptional points, providing a practical route to identify them in existing quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“develop a framework”“we demonstrate”“our results establish”等理论推导与数值分析表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：非厄米量子系统中的奇异点（exceptional points），具体以同时实现RT（旋转-时间）和PT（宇称-时间）对称性的一维复XY自旋链为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于非厄米哈密顿量左右本征矢的差异，构建了可观测的静态与动态信号（如局域自旋关联差异、时间平均左右纠缠熵差），这些信号在奇异点处呈现非解析行为或序参量式突变，从而提供识别奇异点的实验可观测途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于非厄米哈密顿量左右本征矢的差异，构建了可观测的静态与动态信号（如局域自旋关联差异、时间平均左右纠缠熵差），这些信号在奇异点处呈现非解析行为或序参量式突变，从而提供识别奇异点的实验可观测途径。；创新点：首次建立非厄米本征态左右矢差异与奇异点可观测信号之间的直接联系，并指出静态二分纠缠熵无法捕捉该差异，从而提出基于动力学纠缠熵的检测方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用非厄米哈密顿量与其伴随算符的全局差异构造非解析性指标；静态检测：比较左右本征态下的局域自旋关联；动态检测：通过突然淬火后的时间平均左右纠缠熵差，区分RT对称与PT对称区域的不同行为。

papers.title: Learning from almost nothing: How neural networks survive heavy input corruption
papers.abstract: Learning from imperfect data is a central theme in machine learning, connecting practical questions of robustness to fundamental questions of learnability. Here we examine attribute noise: learning from corrupted inputs while keeping the labels intact, a setting that has received considerably less analytical attention than its label-noise counterpart. We consider two types of corruption models: additive noise and replacement noise. Through experiments with multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on corrupted classification datasets, we find that neural networks remain robust, maintaining well-above-chance accuracy even when inputs are >90% corrupted -- far beyond human recognition. To understand this robustness, we analyze infinite-width networks in the heavy-corruption regime using a mean-field-inspired approach and derive a leading-order decision rule for the classification outcome: the network implements a prototype rule, the nearest-class-mean, assigning each test point to the class whose training-set average it most closely resembles. This leading-order decision rule is universal across a broad range of MLP architectures, holding for any depth, as well as a wide class of activation functions and noise distributions. The same centroid mechanism closely matches finite-width network behavior in our experiments and provides an interpretable and analytically tractable account of why learning can succeed even when individual training examples carry almost no signal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：mean-field-inspired approach（平均场启发方法）、derived a leading-order decision rule（推导出主导阶决策规则）、experiments with multi-layer perceptrons（多层感知机实验）。；研究对象：神经网络在输入数据遭受严重损坏（属性噪声，包括加性噪声和替换噪声）时的学习行为与鲁棒性机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在输入数据超过90%被破坏的情况下，神经网络仍能保持远高于随机猜测的分类准确率；其鲁棒性源于网络在重噪声极限下实现了一种“最近类均值”原型决策规则，该规则对网络深度、激活函数和噪声分布具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在输入数据超过90%被破坏的情况下，神经网络仍能保持远高于随机猜测的分类准确率；其鲁棒性源于网络在重噪声极限下实现了一种“最近类均值”原型决策规则，该规则对网络深度、激活函数和噪声分布具有普适性。；创新点：首次从理论上严格证明，在输入严重损坏（属性噪声）条件下，神经网络的有效决策规则退化为简单的“最近类均值”原型规则，并揭示该规则对多种网络架构、激活函数和噪声类型的普适性，为理解“从几乎无信息输入中学习”提供了可解析的机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用多层感知机（MLP）在受污染分类数据集上进行实验；利用平均场方法分析无限宽度网络在重噪声区间的行为，推导出分类结果的主导阶决策规则。

papers.title: Lectures on Semiclassical Methods for Composite Operators
papers.abstract: These lecture notes are intended as a coherent introduction to conformal field theory in general, and composite operators in particular, through a semiclassical framework for computing scaling dimensions, with emphasis on operators of the form $φ^n$. In doing so, they aim to fill a gap in the literature and to help decode some of the relevant concepts. The physical idea is that at large $n$ an (heavy) operator creates a highly occupied state. Through the state-operator correspondence, this state lives on the cylinder $\mathbb{R}\times S^{d-1}$, and its scaling dimension is the corresponding energy of the theory on the cylinder. The notes are organized as a self-contained route from conformal symmetry to semiclassical dynamics. Part I reviews the conformal group, primary operators, radial quantization, the state-operator correspondence, and operator mixing. Part II builds the semiclassical framework, first in the free scalar theory, where the dimension of $φ^n$ is recovered in three independent ways, and then through the double-scaling limit, the action variable, and Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization. Part III develops the general machinery of periodic saddles, Floquet theory, fluctuation determinants, the Gel'fand-Yaglom method, and the Gutzwiller trace formula. Part IV applies the framework to the $O(N)$ $φ^4$ theory in $d=4-ε$ at the Wilson-Fisher fixed point, deriving the classical elliptic solution, the Lamé fluctuation spectrum, the zero modes, and the one-loop contribution to the large-$n$ scaling dimensions. Beyond the explicit computation, the notes emphasize the role of composite operators as probes of collective sectors of quantum field theory, with extensions to gauge theories, conformal windows, and asymptotically safe field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lecture notes、semiclassical framework、conformal field theory、state-operator correspondence、Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization。；研究对象：复合算子的标度维度，特别是形如φ^n的算子，以及它们在共形场论（CFT）和O(N) φ^4理论（Wilson-Fisher固定点）中的半经典计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过半经典框架，利用态-算符对应将大n（重）算子映射到圆柱上的高占据态，从而计算其标度维度；在O(N) φ^4理论中，通过椭圆经典解和Lamé涨落谱，给出了大n标度维度的一圈修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过半经典框架，利用态-算符对应将大n（重）算子映射到圆柱上的高占据态，从而计算其标度维度；在O(N) φ^4理论中，通过椭圆经典解和Lamé涨落谱，给出了大n标度维度的一圈修正。；创新点：填补了文献中关于通过半经典框架系统介绍复合算子（尤其是φ^n）标度维度计算的空白，并强调复合算子作为量子场论集体扇区探针的作用，扩展至规范理论、共形窗口和渐近安全场论。
papers.method_zh: 半经典方法：包括态-算符对应、径向量子化、双标度极限、作用变量、Bohr-Sommerfeld量子化、周期鞍点、Floquet理论、涨落行列式、Gel'fand-Yaglom方法、Gutzwiller迹公式。具体应用：自由标量理论中三种独立方式恢复φ^n的维度；O(N) φ^4理论在d=4-ε维Wilson-Fisher固定点下的椭圆解和Lamé谱分析。

papers.title: Exact Entanglement Dynamics Beyond Nearest-Neighbor Dual-Unitary Floquet Systems
papers.abstract: Exact results using dual-unitarity largely rely on nearest-neighbor structures, while finite-range interactions typically lead to complications. Going beyond the usual nearest-neighbor setting, we introduce an analytically tractable family of finite-range kicked Ising models that admit exact closed-form entanglement dynamics. The construction is based on a staggered structure in which dual-unitarity is present on sublattices that are then coupled to each other. The central observation is that these inter-sublattice couplings do not obstruct the dual-unitarity of the resulting model. For the minimal interaction range of $r= 2$, we derive exact expressions for all the $n-$Rényi entanglement entropies at all times and show that the result is the sum of the two coupled sublattice contributions. Our framework extends naturally to larger finite interaction ranges and to systems with heterogeneous local Hilbert spaces, without additional assumptions. It thus provides a controlled setting for studying exact entanglement growth beyond strictly nearest-neighbor dual-unitary models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically tractable、exact closed-form entanglement dynamics、derived exact expressions。；研究对象：有限程（finite-range） kicked Ising 模型中的纠缠动力学，具体为超越最近邻相互作用的双幺正（dual-unitary）Floquet 系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入交错（staggered）结构，构造了一类可精确求解的有限程 kicked Ising 模型，其纠缠动力学可表示为两个耦合子晶格贡献之和，且对于最小相互作用范围 r=2，所有 n-Rényi 纠缠熵均可获得精确闭式表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入交错（staggered）结构，构造了一类可精确求解的有限程 kicked Ising 模型，其纠缠动力学可表示为两个耦合子晶格贡献之和，且对于最小相互作用范围 r=2，所有 n-Rényi 纠缠熵均可获得精确闭式表达式。；创新点：突破了以往双幺正性方法仅适用于最近邻相互作用的限制，首次在有限程相互作用（r≥2）的 kicked Ising 模型中实现了纠缠动力学的精确解析求解，且框架可自然推广至更一般情形。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于交错子晶格上的双幺正性构造，推导有限程相互作用下纠缠熵的精确闭式解，并推广至更大相互作用范围及异质局域希尔伯特空间。

papers.title: Stabilizing Role of Uninformed Participants in Collective Decision Making
papers.abstract: For groups without strict hierarchy, collective decisions often emerge through compromise. We develop a second-order network model of collective decision-making using a dissipative Hamiltonian formulation, in which informed agents introduce preferred directions while uninformed participants contribute only direction-free dissipation. We show that under low conflict, the model admits a locally unique, exponentially stable compromise state. Using a structured modular network we further show that as conflict increases the local compromise branch terminates through a saddle-node fold rather than through a smooth mean-field symmetry-breaking transition. Modular polarized states persist on branches that are locally separated from the compromise branch. Direction-free dissipation does not shift the static structural threshold, but it delays escape from the saddle-node ghost and pushes the observable onset of polarization to larger conflicts. Our work identifies a dissipation-mediated mechanism, complementary to connectivity-based accounts, through which uninformed participants stabilize collective behavior in biological and engineered swarms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“develop a second-order network model”、“dissipative Hamiltonian formulation”等理论建模和数学分析的关键词。；研究对象：集体决策中的共识形成与极化现象，具体研究在无严格等级制度的群体（如生物群体或工程集群）中，知情个体（引入偏好方向）与不知情个体（仅提供无方向耗散）如何共同影响集体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不知情参与者提供的无方向耗散不会改变系统发生极化的静态结构阈值，但会通过延迟“鞍-结幽灵”的逃逸过程，将极化现象的可观测起始点推向更大的冲突强度，从而起到稳定集体行为的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不知情参与者提供的无方向耗散不会改变系统发生极化的静态结构阈值，但会通过延迟“鞍-结幽灵”的逃逸过程，将极化现象的可观测起始点推向更大的冲突强度，从而起到稳定集体行为的作用。；创新点：该工作识别了一种不同于传统基于连通性解释的、由耗散介导的稳定机制，揭示了不知情参与者在集体决策中扮演的稳定角色。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或特定生物系统的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用耗散哈密顿量形式构建了一个二阶网络模型。通过数学分析（如稳定性分析）和结构化模块网络上的数值模拟，研究了模型在低冲突和高冲突下的动力学行为，并识别了鞍-结分岔等关键动力学特征。

papers.title: APTLAS: An Indexed APT Literature Repository
papers.abstract: Atom probe tomography (APT) literature is broad, rapidly growing, and dispersed across a wide range of journals, which can make it difficult to identify prior work on a given material system, instrument, or analytical approach. Conventional search engines (e.g., Google Scholar) excel at general retrieval but do not preserve the domain-specific metadata that often determines the relevance of an APT publication (e.g., analysis mode, laser wavelength, or instrument configuration). Herein, APTLAS is presented, which is an indexed repository of published APT literature. At present, the database contains ~2,300 records, each accompanied by metadata extracted from the source publication. The accompanying web tool, available at https://aptlas.bavleyguerguis.com/, allows users to browse and filter by material system, instrument, application, publication type, or keyword search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：工具/数据库建设类（非传统实验、计算或理论文章）。判断依据：关键词“indexed repository”、“metadata”、“web tool”。；研究对象：原子探针层析技术（APT）领域的文献资料，涵盖材料体系、仪器、分析方法等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明物理结论或发现，主要贡献是构建了一个包含约2300条记录、附带领域特定元数据的APT文献索引库，并提供了在线检索与筛选工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明物理结论或发现，主要贡献是构建了一个包含约2300条记录、附带领域特定元数据的APT文献索引库，并提供了在线检索与筛选工具。；创新点：针对APT领域文献分散、通用搜索引擎无法保留领域特定元数据（如分析模式、激光波长、仪器配置）的问题，首次建立了专门索引库，支持按材料体系、仪器、应用、出版类型等元数据字段进行筛选，弥补了传统搜索引擎在领域内精准检索上的不足。
papers.method_zh: 通过人工或自动方式从已发表的APT文献中提取元数据（如分析模式、激光波长、仪器配置等），构建结构化数据库，并开发了基于Web的浏览与过滤工具（https://aptlas.bavleyguerguis.com/）。

papers.title: Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process Modelling for Expensive Quantum Systems with Heteroskedastic Noise
papers.abstract: Accurate modeling of quantum many-body systems often requires computationally expensive simulations such as Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) or Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) calculations. These methods, while precise, impose significant time and resource constraints, limiting their use in exhaustive parameter exploration. Moreover, these expensive simulations can contain variable errors over the large unknown parameter space, which needs to be quantified and propagated. Thus, predictive modelling is required to estimate the functional space accurately over scarcely sampled data with heteroskedastic noise, while preserving the physical relevance of the estimation. Therefore, we present a Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process (pc-EGP) framework designed to efficiently model complex and noisy quantum systems under physical consistency constraints. The proposed method first enforces physical constraints as a user controlled weighted penalty to the data-driven loss function of the Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates. Then an ensemble of such GP models is trained with variable noisy simulations via numerical quadrature method where these multiple GP(s) at different nodes is integrated as a quadrature weighted average. We first demonstrate the framework on synthetically generated data before applying to quantum systems. In the first case study, we leverage DMRG simulations of the Bose-Hubbard Model to predict the critical interaction parameter Uc governing the superfluid-to-Mott-insulator transition. In the second case study, we demonstrate our method on QMC simulations, of a quantum liquid confined inside a nanoporous silicate with the goal of optimizing a chemical environment to realize a one-dimensional superfluid. Compared to conventional GP, pc-EGP achieves a better balance of accuracy and physically meaningful predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要提及“DMRG”、“QMC”等计算方法，以及“Gaussian Process”、“数值求积”等理论建模框架。；研究对象：量子多体系统，具体包括：Bose-Hubbard模型中的超流-莫特绝缘体相变（临界相互作用参数Uc），以及纳米多孔硅酸盐中受限量子液体的化学环境优化（以实现一维超流）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架，相比传统高斯过程，能在异方差噪声下更准确地建模昂贵量子模拟数据，并保持预测的物理合理性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架，相比传统高斯过程，能在异方差噪声下更准确地建模昂贵量子模拟数据，并保持预测的物理合理性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架。具体包括：1）将物理约束作为加权惩罚项加入高斯过程代理模型的损失函数；2）通过数值求积方法训练多个高斯过程模型，并对其输出进行加权平均。案例中使用了DMRG（密度矩阵重正化群）和QMC（量子蒙特卡洛）模拟数据。

papers.title: Collective Emission in LH2 Assembly Beyond the Point-Dipole Approximation
papers.abstract: Collective emission in light-harvesting assemblies is governed by the local transition dipole and finite geometry of emitting units, a fact that point-dipole approximation obscures. To go beyond this picture, we develop a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian using the quantum electrodynamic dyadic Green's tensor for a purple bacteria. We construct it for the isolated 24-bacteriochlorophyll conical frustum and its P42$_1$2 crystallographic assembly. The P42$_1$2 unit-cell symmetry is found to invert the bright-dark ordering of the single ring, placing subradiant states at the low-energy end and revealing the entire crystal to be the energy-harvesting entity. Tilt-driven switching is activated only in crystal geometries where the finite dipole-carrier (LH2) lies perpendicular to the growth plane. Vacancy and orientational disorder work only in cooperation to renormalize the switching threshold from higher polar angles to lower values.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：非厄米哈密顿量、量子电动力学并矢格林张量、点偶极近似之外的理论框架）；研究对象：紫色细菌的LH2（捕光复合物2）组装体，具体为孤立24-细菌叶绿素圆锥台及其P42₁2晶体学组装结构中的集体发射现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: P42₁2晶胞对称性会反转单个环的亮-暗态顺序，使亚辐射态位于低能端，揭示整个晶体才是能量收集实体；倾斜驱动的开关效应仅在有限偶极载体（LH2）垂直于生长平面的晶体几何中被激活。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：P42₁2晶胞对称性会反转单个环的亮-暗态顺序，使亚辐射态位于低能端，揭示整个晶体才是能量收集实体；倾斜驱动的开关效应仅在有限偶极载体（LH2）垂直于生长平面的晶体几何中被激活。；创新点：突破了传统点偶极近似对有限几何发射单元的描述限制，揭示了晶胞对称性对集体发射态排序的调控作用，并阐明了空位与取向无序协同重正化开关阈值的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子电动力学并矢格林张量构建非厄米哈密顿量，超越点偶极近似，对孤立圆锥台和晶体组装分别建模分析。

papers.title: Scaling law of asymptotic freedom in collective charging of quantum batteries
papers.abstract: We establish a universal scaling law for collective charging of quantum batteries, independent of microscopic details. We prove that the ergotropy-to-energy ratio approaches unity at least as fast as $\sim N^{-1}$ with the number of batteries $N$, implying generic asymptotic freedom. We further show how the universal $1/N$ scaling can be overcome: when the battery state becomes asymptotically pure, the convergence can be substantially faster, including $\sim N^{-b}$ with $b>1$ and even exponential scaling in $N^2$. Rigorous finite-$N$ upper and lower bounds on the ergotropy-to-energy ratio are further derived, providing nonasymptotic guarantees for the universal $1/N$ scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：establish a universal scaling law, prove, derive bounds。；研究对象：量子电池（quantum batteries）的集体充电过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了量子电池集体充电中渐近自由（asymptotic freedom）的普适标度律：ergotropy-to-energy 比值随电池数量 N 的增加至少以 ~N⁻¹ 的速度趋近于1；当电池态趋于渐近纯态时，收敛速度可显著加快，包括 N⁻ᵇ（b>1）甚至 N² 的指数标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了量子电池集体充电中渐近自由（asymptotic freedom）的普适标度律：ergotropy-to-energy 比值随电池数量 N 的增加至少以 ~N⁻¹ 的速度趋近于1；当电池态趋于渐近纯态时，收敛速度可显著加快，包括 N⁻ᵇ（b>1）甚至 N² 的指数标度。；创新点：揭示了集体充电中渐近自由的普适标度律（与微观细节无关），并证明了该 1/N 标度在特定条件下可被超越。摘要未突出说明与已有具体模型或实验的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数学证明。具体包括：建立 ergotropy-to-energy 比值的通用标度律，推导有限 N 的严格上下界，分析不同电池态纯度下的收敛行为。

papers.title: Negative heat capacities in spherically symmetric sectors of $d$-matrix quantum mechanics
papers.abstract: We consider the $SO(d)$ and $O(d)$ invariant sectors of the bosonic $d$-matrix harmonic oscillator with $U(N)$ gauge symmetry. The micro-canonical degeneracy $\mathcal{Z}( N , d , k )$ for fixed energy $k$ is expressed as a pairing between an $N$-dependent vector and a $d$-dependent vector in the space of partitions of the integer $k$. This pairing formula is derived by counting invariant words in multi-matrix variables $X^i_{j,a}$, using properties of Clebsch-Gordan multiplicities (Kronecker coefficients) for the symmetric group $S_k$, Schur-Weyl duality and harmonic analysis on the homogeneous space $U(d)/SO(d)$. Analytic formulae for large $N$ and $k$ with $ k \le N $ are obtained using group integrals over $U(N)$ and $SO(d)$ (or $ O(d)$). The micro-canonical heat capacity in this regime is negative and turns positive, at a critical value $k_{\rm crit}$, due to finite $N$ modifications to the counting, thus forming what we denote as a characteristic caloric fold in the $ E $ versus $T$ curve. Data from the pairing formula is well fitted by $k_{\rm crit} \sim { N^2 \over 4 }$ for small values of $d$. A derivation of this large $N$ formula is given using a matrix model approximation and semi-classical analysis of the eigenvalue density. The large $N,d$ limit of the degeneracies reveals a key role for ribbon graph combinatorics. The caloric fold is also notably a property of black hole thermodynamics in anti-de-Sitter spaces. We propose the spherically symmetric \(SO(d)\) and \(O(d)\) invariant sectors of \(d\)-matrix quantum mechanics as tractable matrix systems for capturing key features of dual descriptions of black-hole thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Schur-Weyl duality、group integrals、semi-classical analysis、matrix model approximation。；研究对象：具有U(N)规范对称性的玻色d-矩阵谐振子的SO(d)和O(d)不变扇区，具体研究其微正则简并度与热容量的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在k ≤ N的大N和k区域，微正则热容量为负，并在临界值k_crit处转变为正，形成E-T曲线上的“热折叠”（caloric fold），该行为与反德西特空间中黑洞热力学性质相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在k ≤ N的大N和k区域，微正则热容量为负，并在临界值k_crit处转变为正，形成E-T曲线上的“热折叠”（caloric fold），该行为与反德西特空间中黑洞热力学性质相似。；创新点：首次在d-矩阵量子力学的球对称扇区中明确展示负热容量及热折叠现象，并将其与AdS空间黑洞热力学的关键特征建立联系，提出该体系可作为黑洞热力学对偶描述的可解矩阵模型。
papers.method_zh: 利用对称群S_k的Clebsch-Gordan重数（Kronecker系数）、Schur-Weyl对偶性以及齐性空间U(d)/SO(d)上的调和分析，推导出固定能量k下的微正则简并度Z(N,d,k)的配对公式；通过U(N)和SO(d)（或O(d)）上的群积分获得大N和k的解析公式；采用矩阵模型近似和半经典分析推导k_crit ~ N²/4的标度律；利用ribbon图组合学分析大N,d极限下的简并度。

papers.title: Quantum statistics in an extended collider coupled to a qubit
papers.abstract: Mesoscopic colliders provide an effective platform for probing the mutual statistics of quantum particles. Recent experiments have successfully extracted the mutual statistics of fermions, and more exotic anyons using quantum point contacts (QPCs). Coupling a point-like collider, such as a quantum point contact, to a two-level impurity or qubit can induce statistical transmutation of fermions, causing them to display boson-like bunching tendencies. Here, we extend the analysis to an extended collider. We investigate the scattering of two incoming fermionic and bosonic wave packets in the presence of post-selection on the impurity state, and systematically analyze the possible benchmarks used to characterize bunching and infer the underlying mutual statistics. We show that only a specific benchmark faithfully captures the mutual statistics of the colliding particles, while alternative choices can produce spurious statistical signatures. Hence, the correct benchmark for probing the quantum statistics depends on the intricate details of the mesoscopic collider.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analysis、systematically analyze。；研究对象：介观对撞机（extended collider）中，耦合到两能级杂质（qubit）的费米子和玻色子波包的散射过程，以及后选择（post-selection）对量子统计行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 只有特定的基准（benchmark）才能忠实反映碰撞粒子的互统计（mutual statistics），其他基准可能产生虚假的统计特征；正确探测量子统计的基准依赖于介观对撞机的具体细节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：只有特定的基准（benchmark）才能忠实反映碰撞粒子的互统计（mutual statistics），其他基准可能产生虚假的统计特征；正确探测量子统计的基准依赖于介观对撞机的具体细节。；创新点：将之前针对点状对撞机（如量子点接触）的统计嬗变分析扩展到扩展型对撞机，并揭示了不同基准在提取互统计时的可靠性差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：研究两个入射的费米子和玻色子波包在杂质态后选择下的散射，系统分析用于表征聚束（bunching）和推断互统计的各种可能基准。

papers.title: Roughness-robust surface altermagnetism in $PT$ antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Surface altermagnetism extends spin splitting beyond bulk altermagnets through symmetry reduction at surfaces and interfaces. An existing classification applies to the local symmetry of atomically flat surface terraces. The present paper addresses the symmetry of macroscopic spin-momentum correlations that survive averaging over compensated rough surfaces. These correlations are governed by the surface antisymmetry Laue point group. Rough-surface altermagnetism is forbidden at any surface of a magnet whose antisymmetry space group contains antitranslations, and the classification therefore reduces to $PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets. By restoring all symmetries leaving the surface normal invariant, roughness can generate compensated surface altermagnets from uncompensated flat terminations, increase the surface symmetry, or suppress spin splitting. By combining bulk switchability with altermagnetic surface transport properties, roughness-robust surface altermagnetism in $PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets provides a route toward spintronic functionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“symmetry”“classification”“group”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：$PT$对称反铁磁体中的粗糙表面交变磁（surface altermagnetism）现象，具体关注宏观自旋-动量关联在补偿性粗糙表面上的对称性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粗糙表面交变磁仅存在于$PT$对称反铁磁体中，且其宏观自旋-动量关联由表面反称劳厄点群（surface antisymmetry Laue point group）决定；粗糙表面可以从不补偿的平坦端面产生补偿性表面交变磁，或抑制自旋劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粗糙表面交变磁仅存在于$PT$对称反铁磁体中，且其宏观自旋-动量关联由表面反称劳厄点群（surface antisymmetry Laue point group）决定；粗糙表面可以从不补偿的平坦端面产生补偿性表面交变磁，或抑制自旋劈裂。；创新点：将表面交变磁的研究从原子级平坦表面扩展到宏观粗糙表面，揭示了粗糙表面下仍能保持的自旋劈裂对称性，并指出粗糙表面交变磁在$PT$对称反铁磁体中的鲁棒性及其对自旋电子学器件的潜在应用价值。
papers.method_zh: 基于群论和对称性分析，利用表面反称劳厄点群对粗糙表面的宏观自旋-动量关联进行分类，并考虑反平移对称性对表面交变磁的禁止作用。

papers.title: Flower-like WO3-modified Vulcan carbon GDEs for photoelectro-Fenton process: Efficient ciprofloxacin degradation and mechanistic insights
papers.abstract: Electrochemical H2O2 synthesis was investigated using a 3 percent WO3 C gas diffusion electrode GDE. The catalyst outperformed bare Vulcan carbon, generating H2O2 concentrations of 423, 586, and 916 mg L at 50, 75, and 100 mA cm2, respectively, maintaining around 70 percent current efficiency. This performance and lower energy consumption are attributed to the WO3 carbon synergistic effect. In electro Fenton EF applications, the WO3 C GDE achieved rapid initial ciprofloxacin CIP degradation of around 70 percent in 30 min, though limited later by slow Fe2 regeneration. Incorporating UV light photoelectro Fenton overcame this constraint, yielding complete CIP removal within 90 min, while a boron doped diamond BDD anode enhanced total organic carbon TOC mineralization to 66 percent. The proposed degradation mechanism proceeds via hydroxyl radical attack on the piperazine ring with or without defluorination and quinolone ring oxidation, with theoretical analysis confirming reduced environmental toxicity of the transformation products. Overall, WO3 C GDEs represent a highly efficient strategy for H2O2 generation and wastewater remediation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electrochemical H2O2 synthesis、gas diffusion electrode、photoelectro-Fenton process、degradation mechanism。；研究对象：WO₃修饰的Vulcan碳气体扩散电极（WO₃/C GDE）及其在光电芬顿过程中降解环丙沙星（ciprofloxacin）的性能与机理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WO₃/C GDE在电化学合成H₂O₂中性能优于纯Vulcan碳，在光电芬顿条件下90分钟内实现环丙沙星的完全去除，且降解产物环境毒性降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WO₃/C GDE在电化学合成H₂O₂中性能优于纯Vulcan碳，在光电芬顿条件下90分钟内实现环丙沙星的完全去除，且降解产物环境毒性降低。；创新点：利用WO₃与碳的协同效应提升H₂O₂生成效率与电流效率，并通过引入紫外光克服电芬顿过程中Fe²⁺再生缓慢的限制，实现环丙沙星的快速完全降解及高TOC矿化率。
papers.method_zh: 电化学H₂O₂合成实验、电芬顿（EF）与光电芬顿（PEF）降解实验、硼掺杂金刚石（BDD）阳极对比、总有机碳（TOC）矿化分析、理论分析（降解路径与毒性评估）。

papers.title: Hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver
papers.abstract: Quantum impurity models, which describe the coupling between interacting orbitals and a non-interacting bath, play a central role in the physics of strongly correlated electron systems. Solving a quantum impurity model in general requires the use of non-perturbative numerical methods. Hamiltonian-based approaches, which rely on an explicit bath discretization, are typically limited to a small number of bath sites or small entanglement, and diagrammatic methods suffer from sign problems, slow convergence, or diagram truncation approximations. Here we show that these two classes of methods can be combined: augmenting diagrammatic methods with a small auxiliary bath can reduce the residual problem to a regime where low-order perturbation theory is highly accurate and rapidly converging. In a simple benchmark, the precision of the hybrid approach surpasses bold-line calculations by several orders of magnitude; for a strongly interacting two-orbital model with a severe sign problem, convergence is achieved at three orders of magnitude lower computational cost than competing methods; and convergence to the unknown exact result is rapidly accelerated in a difficult realistic problem. Our results establish a practical route to high-precision quantum impurity solutions in correlated quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver（混合哈密顿量-图解量子杂质求解器）、non-perturbative numerical methods（非微扰数值方法）、benchmark（基准测试）。；研究对象：量子杂质模型（quantum impurity models），即描述相互作用轨道与非相互作用库耦合的模型，用于强关联电子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将哈密顿量方法（依赖显式库离散化）与图解方法（diagrammatic methods）结合，引入一个小型辅助库，可将剩余问题简化到低阶微扰论高度精确且快速收敛的区域，从而大幅提升计算精度和效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将哈密顿量方法（依赖显式库离散化）与图解方法（diagrammatic methods）结合，引入一个小型辅助库，可将剩余问题简化到低阶微扰论高度精确且快速收敛的区域，从而大幅提升计算精度和效率。；创新点：首次将哈密顿量方法（基于库离散化）与图解方法（基于微扰展开）这两类传统上独立的求解策略进行系统性结合，利用辅助库将问题映射到低阶微扰论高度有效的区域，从而克服各自方法的局限性（如哈密顿量方法受限于小库或小纠缠，图解方法受限于符号问题、慢收敛或图解截断近似）。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种混合哈密顿量-图解量子杂质求解器（hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver），具体为：用小型辅助库（small auxiliary bath）增强图解方法，使低阶微扰论在剩余问题中高度精确且快速收敛。基准测试包括：与粗线计算（bold-line calculations）对比精度，在具有严重符号问题（severe sign problem）的强相互作用双轨道模型（two-orbital model）中对比计算成本，以及在困难的实际问题中对比收敛速度。

papers.title: How to grow a straight filament
papers.abstract: How can a growing biological filament remain straight despite stochastic fluctuations in growth? Motivated by filamentary structures that develop reproducibly across biological systems, we study the stability of a noisy, growing elastic filament regulated by feedback. We formulate a minimal model in which growth responds to the filament's strain, curvature, and orientation through local or nonlocal spatiotemporal feedback laws. Linear stability analysis identifies the conditions under which these feedback mechanisms stabilize a straight configuration. In the presence of noise, we show that purely local feedback requires orientation sensing to suppress long-wavelength instabilities, whereas nonlocal feedback allows stabilization through proprioceptive (curvature) sensing alone. Coupling to an elastic substrate further suppresses large-scale fluctuations. Our results establish minimal control strategies that ensure robust straight growth and suggest experimental signatures for identifying the feedback mechanisms underlying morphogenesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“formulate a minimal model”、“linear stability analysis”、“show that”。；研究对象：受噪声影响的、正在生长的生物细丝（filament）的形态稳定性问题。具体研究如何通过反馈机制使细丝在随机波动中保持笔直生长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文确定了确保细丝笔直生长的最小控制策略：纯局部反馈需要感知方向（orientation sensing）来抑制长波不稳定性，而非局部反馈仅通过本体感觉（曲率感知）即可实现稳定化。与弹性基底耦合可进一步抑制大尺度波动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文确定了确保细丝笔直生长的最小控制策略：纯局部反馈需要感知方向（orientation sensing）来抑制长波不稳定性，而非局部反馈仅通过本体感觉（曲率感知）即可实现稳定化。与弹性基底耦合可进一步抑制大尺度波动。；创新点：该工作系统地比较了局部与非局部反馈机制在稳定噪声下生长细丝方面的不同能力，并揭示了方向感知在局部反馈中的必要性，以及基底耦合的额外稳定作用，为理解生物形态发生中的反馈机制提供了最小控制策略的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 建立了一个最小理论模型，其中细丝的生长响应其应变、曲率和方向，通过局部或非局部的时空反馈定律来调控。采用线性稳定性分析方法，并引入噪声项进行理论分析。

papers.title: Approaching the Limit of Intrinsic Crystalline Thermal Insulation
papers.abstract: Crystalline materials with ultralow thermal conductivity ($κ$) are potential thermal barrier coatings or thermoelectrics, yet the discovery of ultralow-$κ$ materials remains inefficient due to the limitations of trial-and-error approaches. Herein, we propose a state-of-the-art high-throughput workflow that integrates universal machine learning interatomic potentials with high-fidelity phonon transport theories to accelerate the exploration of thermal insulators. Applying this approach, we identify dozens of crystalline materials with intrinsic room-temperature $κ$ values below 0.2 $\rm W m^{-1} K^{-1}$. Among them, we report and experimentally validate CsTlI$_4$, a record-breaking material with an ultralow $κ$ of 0.14 $\rm W m^{-1} K^{-1}$ at 300 K. Structural and bond analyses reveal that a hierarchical bonding framework, consisting of multi-coordinated Cs-I and antibonding Tl-I interactions, leads to weak chemical bonding and a soft lattice. These features reduce phonon group velocities, enhance phonon scattering, and induce strong vibrational mismatch between sublattices, collectively suppressing both particle-like phonon propagation and wave-like tunneling. Beyond this specific system, we establish physically interpretable descriptors based on interatomic force constants that correlate strongly with ultralow $κ$ and capture the role of bonding hierarchy and coordination environments in governing thermal transport. This work demonstrates a robust data-driven strategy for accelerating the discovery of thermal insulators and provides microscopic insight into how hierarchical bonding and strong anharmonicity cooperate to impede heat-carrying vibrations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。关键词：high-throughput workflow、machine learning interatomic potentials、phonon transport theories、experimentally validate。；研究对象：超低热导率晶体材料，特别是CsTlI₄，以及具有本征室温热导率低于0.2 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的数十种晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现并实验验证了CsTlI₄在300 K下具有0.14 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的创纪录超低热导率，揭示了层级键合框架（多配位Cs-I和反键Tl-I相互作用）导致弱化学键和软晶格，从而抑制热传导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现并实验验证了CsTlI₄在300 K下具有0.14 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的创纪录超低热导率，揭示了层级键合框架（多配位Cs-I和反键Tl-I相互作用）导致弱化学键和软晶格，从而抑制热传导。；创新点：提出了一个数据驱动的、结合机器学习势与声子输运理论的高通量策略，显著加速了超低热导率绝缘体的发现，并建立了与超低热导率强相关的基于原子间力常数的描述符，揭示了层级键合与强非谐性协同抑制热载流子振动的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 高通量工作流：通用机器学习原子间势（universal machine learning interatomic potentials）结合高保真声子输运理论（high-fidelity phonon transport theories）；实验验证（experimentally validate）；结构键合分析（structural and bond analyses）；基于原子间力常数的物理可解释描述符（physically interpretable descriptors based on interatomic force constants）。

papers.title: Interplay between photon condensation and electron-electron interactions in molecular systems
papers.abstract: We investigate a minimal molecular model consisting of square planar plaquettes hosting multiple electrons, whose dynamics is governed by a tight-binding Hamiltonian supplemented by on-site Hubbard repulsion. By coupling this system to a spatially nonuniform cavity mode, we analyze the emergence of a magnetostatic instability, namely photon condensation, originating from the paramagnetic Van Vleck mechanism. The global behavior of the system is analyzed for different electronic filling factors, and we find that, except for the special cases of half-filling and single electron, where the transition, if it occurs, is necessarily a second order phase transition, the global system may also undergo a first order transition because of the action of the electron-electron interaction. The polaritonic excitation energies are analyzed, providing clear spectroscopic signatures of the magnetostatic instability and of its order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、minimal molecular model、tight-binding Hamiltonian、analyze。；研究对象：分子系统中光子凝聚（磁静不稳定性）与电子-电子相互作用的竞争关系，具体为包含多个电子的方形平面分子模型（square planar plaquettes）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 除半填充和单电子填充的特殊情况外，电子-电子相互作用可导致系统发生一级相变（而非二级相变），并给出了该磁静不稳定性及其相变级次的明确光谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：除半填充和单电子填充的特殊情况外，电子-电子相互作用可导致系统发生一级相变（而非二级相变），并给出了该磁静不稳定性及其相变级次的明确光谱特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚模型加上在位哈伯德排斥项（on-site Hubbard repulsion）描述电子动力学，并将该系统耦合到空间非均匀的腔模，通过分析顺磁Van Vleck机制研究光子凝聚的磁静不稳定性。

papers.title: In-situ total scattering investigation of crystalline ordering in amorphous ion-beam sputtered thin films for interferometric gravitational wave detectors
papers.abstract: Amorphous tantala is an important optical material used in a number of high-precision optical applications, including gravitational wave interferometry. In this paper, we study in-situ the structural changes that occur in amorphous ion-beam sputtered coatings during an annealing treatment by means of a synchrotron radiation scattering experiment. The scattering signal is measured as a function of time on a large range of the Q-space. X-Ray diffraction and Rietveld analysis are used to study crystallization during the annealing treatment, whereas pair distribution function analysis allows to inspect the structural changes occurring during the amorphous to crystalline transition. Our findings indicate that several structural rearrangements occur in parallel, namely a first quick establishment of a backbone structure in the cationic substructure appearing on a rather extended range (up to 100 Angstrom), followed by a progressive rearrangement of the oxygen atoms environment which gradually increases the crystallinity of the structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synchrotron radiation scattering experiment（同步辐射散射实验）、X-Ray diffraction（X射线衍射）、Rietveld analysis（Rietveld分析）、pair distribution function analysis（对分布函数分析）。；研究对象：非晶态氧化钽（amorphous tantala）薄膜，具体为离子束溅射沉积的非晶涂层，用于干涉引力波探测器等精密光学应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在退火处理过程中，非晶态氧化钽薄膜的结构变化是分步进行的：首先在阳离子亚结构中快速建立长达约100埃的骨架结构，随后氧原子环境逐步重排，逐渐提高结构的结晶度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在退火处理过程中，非晶态氧化钽薄膜的结构变化是分步进行的：首先在阳离子亚结构中快速建立长达约100埃的骨架结构，随后氧原子环境逐步重排，逐渐提高结构的结晶度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原位同步辐射散射实验（in-situ synchrotron radiation scattering experiment），在退火过程中实时测量大范围Q空间的散射信号；采用X射线衍射（XRD）和Rietveld分析研究结晶过程；利用对分布函数（PDF）分析考察非晶到晶态转变过程中的结构变化。

papers.title: On pseudogap phase as precursor to a superconducting dome in high-Tc cuprates: Non-analytic T* as a function of doping
papers.abstract: We generalize the condition under which a quantum material exhibiting a pseudogap phase is a precursor to a superconducting (SC) dome. The result reveals the non-analytic T* as a function of doping. A well-known example is the high-Tc cuprates. Essentially, the SC dome is generated under two conditions: (1) that the pseudogap T* is a decreasing function of doping, due to the decrease in size of extended pairing of doped holes with doping, and most importantly, (2) that the rate of configurational-ordering parameter is an increasing function of doping as a result of the decrease in extended length of the disordered pairs. These two conditions are provided by the new entanglement and confinement pairing mechanism of high-Tc cuprates. This is a theory that has recently been discussed in the literature by Buot et al. It hinges on a novel strong entanglement and confinement hole pairing (ECHP) mechanism that unravels the microscopic features of the entire phase diagram of both electron and hole-doped high-Tc cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“generalize the condition”“theory”“entanglement and confinement pairing mechanism”等理论推导和机制描述。；研究对象：高温铜氧化物超导体（high-Tc cuprates）中的赝能隙相（pseudogap phase）及其与超导穹顶（superconducting dome）的关系，具体关注赝能隙温度T*随掺杂的非解析行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 赝能隙相作为超导穹顶的前驱体需满足两个条件：1）T*随掺杂增加而下降（源于掺杂空穴扩展配对尺寸减小）；2）构型序参数速率随掺杂增加而上升（源于无序对扩展长度减小）。这两个条件由纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制提供，并导致T*作为掺杂函数的非解析性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：赝能隙相作为超导穹顶的前驱体需满足两个条件：1）T*随掺杂增加而下降（源于掺杂空穴扩展配对尺寸减小）；2）构型序参数速率随掺杂增加而上升（源于无序对扩展长度减小）。这两个条件由纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制提供，并导致T*作为掺杂函数的非解析性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有理论的具体差异，但明确指出该工作将赝能隙相作为超导前驱体的条件一般化，并揭示了T*的非解析性，这依赖于ECHP机制对电子型和空穴型高温铜氧化物整个相图微观特征的统一解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用理论分析框架，基于Buot等人近期提出的强纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制，通过推广赝能隙相作为超导前驱体的条件，推导T*随掺杂的非解析行为。

papers.title: Extensible links in a broad class of single polymer chain models
papers.abstract: The physics of polymer chains is often probed using molecular stretching experiments and various idealized single-chain models. The majority of these models consist of a discrete sequence of links, which may be treated as rigid or extensible. Although such models are well established and many specific extensible variants have been proposed, no generally applicable theory has been presented. Moreover, most existing treatments are heuristic rather than systematically and rigorously derived.
